releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6

## Shared profiles and extra touch buttons

- Set global touch/LCD defaults and create named profiles from **Settings →
  Profiles / Global defaults**. Link individual games or assign a profile to
  several prepared games. Edit a shared profile once; linked games use it on
  their next launch.
- Keep per-game exceptions, inspect which profile supplies each setting, and
  reset individual overrides. Existing game settings stay unchanged on upgrade;
  explicitly reset their touch/LCD overrides to adopt shared settings.
- Add up to twelve independent Gamepad buttons in **Edit touch layout → Extra**.
  Choose a key and label, size, opacity and separate portrait/landscape positions.
  Additional buttons are included in shared profiles.
- Library backups carry profile definitions and assignments. Phone backups carry
  portable per-game definitions. Restore preserves destination profiles when
  names or identities conflict.

[Usage and scope](https://github.com/EriArk/JavaEmulator/blob/main/docs/SHARED_PROFILES.md) · [Verification](https://github.com/EriArk/JavaEmulator/blob/main/docs/releases/v0.7.0-beta.6-checks.md).

emulators.latest_body:
LinBox v8.4 前缀架构 · 预构建前缀模板包（arm64ec）

- 构建模式: full（full=无头 wineboot 完整 hive；auto=失败降级骨架；skeleton=纯骨架）
- 布局: both（full=秒开模板【--keep-stamp】；component=drive_c.tar.xz + *.reg.xz【arm64ec 不带 directx】）
- bionic 运行时: Android API29 官方镜像提取（真 linker64 + bionic 库）；wineboot 环境与设备端 EnvSupport 同源（rootfs usr/lib → wine lib → /system/lib64）
- 消费方式（三布局）:
  - `*.tar.zst` —— 独立模板包：放入 `rootfs/opt/prefix/pack/`（生态通道，任意 wine 槽位可用）
  - `*-with-wine.tar.gz` —— 槽位树布局：App「Wine 管理 → 从本地安装」（prefix-pack 自动随槽位落位，成为该槽位一级模板来源）
  - `*-with-wine-rootfs.tar.gz` — data/data 全路径：终端 `linbox-container install-wine <包>` 一键落位
- 设备端四级模板来源与供给链详见 `docs/prefix-architecture.md`

- bionic 运行时: Android API29 官方镜像提取（真 linker64 + bionic 库；NDK 桩库方案已废弃）
- 消费方式（三布局）:
  - `*.tar.zst` —— 独立模板包：放入 `rootfs/opt/prefix/pack/`（生态通道，任意 wine 槽位可用）
  - `*-with-wine.tar.gz` —— 槽位树布局：App「Wine 管理 → 从本地安装」（prefix-pack 自动随槽位落位，成为该槽位一级模板来源）
  - `*-with-wine-rootfs.tar.gz` — data/data 全路径：终端 `linbox-container install-wine <包>` 一键落位
- 设备端四级模板来源与供给链详见 `docs/prefix-architecture.md`

releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

releases.name: LinBox Bionic Wine official-9.2 (x86_64 / X11)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Wine（x86_64 / X11）

- 形态: x86_64（unix x86_64 + PE i386/x86_64 WoW64，aarch64 设备经 box64 加载）
- 源码类型: WineHQ 官方源码 wine-9.2（wine-mirror GitHub 镜像）
- 运行时标识: official-9.2（.linbox-wine-info）
- ※ 过旧自定义树无 arm64ec 支持时自动降级 aarch64+i386（详见构建日志与包内 .linbox-wine-info 的 kind 字段）；official/proton 默认版本均支持完整 arm64ec
- 显示: X11（LinBox 内置 X 服务, 默认 :1）
- 音频: PulseAudio (TCP 127.0.0.1:4713)
- 自包含运行库（v3.1.4）: x86_64-bionic 依赖闭包（opt/wine/lib/x86_64-bionic，box64 仿真加载所需全量 .so + gstreamer 插件）
- Android 兼容（v3.1.4）: fsync futex_waitv 探测 SIGSYS 守卫（proton 树退出码 159 根治）+ bin 工具规整（loader 副本）
- 设备安装: `linbox-container install-wine linbox-wine-official-9.2-x86_64-bionic.tar.gz`
- ※ 需配合 v3.1.4+ App（启动器 wineboot 走 loader + BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH/HODLL 环境默认）

releases.name: LinBox Bionic Mesa main (X11)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Mesa（X11）

- aarch64: softpipe(产物名 swrast_dri.so) + freedreno(MSM/KGSL) + zink + turnip(freedreno vulkan)
- x86_64: softpipe(产物名 swrast_dri.so)
- 设备安装: 解包 `linbox-mesa-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/... 自动就位）

- 图形驱动槽位专用包: `linbox-turnip-driver-*-bionic.tar.gz`（aarch64，App 图形驱动页 ➕ 安装，零 ABI 风险）

releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.2
releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksum of the APK

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

### Files

releases.body:
**Anka 1.1.2** brings a newer second core for Zelda: Ocarina of Time, controller rumble in Switch 2 games, a set of emulation fixes for Donkey Kong Bananza, and launchers that no longer call PowerShell.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `140d784a7e4d12a8361233105a0fd08fa0ab2bfa`; `anka.exe` and `anka-cli.exe` carry this commit. The second core, `core2\anka-core2-cli.exe`, is built from its own commit, `bd5a5f74d519eece6a1ddc05f24bf540c5c03ee6`; its source is `Anka-1.1.2-core2-source.zip`.

## Updating

Close Anka, unzip **`Anka-1.1.2-win64.zip`** into your Anka folder and replace the files. Take the whole zip, the `core2` folder too. Your `user` folder (settings, keys, firmware and saves) stays as it is. `anka-config.ps1` from older versions is no longer used and can be deleted.

New to Anka: unzip into a new, empty folder, start `anka.exe`, and install your own keys and firmware (the [1.0.0 notes](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/releases/tag/anka-v1.0.0) have the quick start).

releases.name: Anka 1.0.1
releases.body:
**Anka 1.0.1** opens games stored as **.nup** packages.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `2d17a71ff0f0cf0c27b3d7207818fade9199b77b`; both programs carry this commit.

## Updating from 1.0.0

Close Anka, unzip **`Anka-1.0.1-win64.zip`** into your Anka folder and replace the files. Your `user` folder (settings, keys, firmware and saves) stays as it is.

New to Anka: follow the quick start in the [1.0.0 notes](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/releases/tag/anka-v1.0.0). Unzip into a new, empty folder, start `anka.exe`, and install your own keys and firmware.

## What's in 1.0.1

### .nup packages
- `.nup` ("Unencrypted (Archival) Package") is a container format from upstream Eglantine. It holds one title's base game, update and add-on content in a single file.
- Anka now **reads** .nup files. You can open them with **File › Load File…**, and they appear in the game list with their icon, name and version. `anka-cli.exe` and its launchers open them too, including from the `Games` folder.
- Mods (LayeredFS) and Anka's game-specific settings apply to games opened from a .nup, the same as for other formats. Anka finds the title ID before the game starts.

releases.name: Anka 1.0.0
releases.body:
First release of **Anka**, a Nintendo Switch 2 emulator for Windows, focused on performance.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `b7542ece8b5c695e2f01d5e46b74c0806d48ae96`; both programs carry this commit.

## Quick start

1. Unzip **`Anka-1.0.0-win64.zip`** into a **new, empty folder**. Do not unzip it into another emulator's folder: its Qt DLLs would replace that program's.
2. Start **`anka.exe`**. Anka keeps its settings, keys, firmware and saves in the `user` folder next to it (portable mode) and does not touch `%APPDATA%\eden` or other installs.
3. Install your own keys and firmware as with other Eden-based emulators. Anka includes no games, keys or firmware; only use what you legally own.
4. Settings: **Emulation › Configure… › Anka**. The first start picks *Recommended*, the setup we measured (with GPU Mode *Fast*, the default; it also turns Reactive Flushing off).

Coming from PokeDinner-Eglantine 2.0.0: back up its `nand` folder (your saves), then copy its `user` folder next to `anka.exe`.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with a current Vulkan driver. Qt and the Visual C++ runtime come with Anka.

## What's in 1.0.0

releases.name: AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41
releases.body:
AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41 brings **PS1 games into the Mac launcher's own window**, through the signed PS1 emulator host that **Settings › Emulators can now download** (anyps5-retro-host 1.1.0 with SwanStation, by B-Howell), with **save states**, an **Internal resolution** choice and the **PS menu** that AnyPS5 Desktop has (B-Howell's Desktop work, ported to the Mac). **A game now starts from its cover** (designed by Lenny4250gh for AnyPS5 Desktop), and **quitting the launcher while a game plays closes the game first** and gives it time to save. **AnyPS5 Desktop 0.1.27** brings save states and Internal resolution to PS1 games on Windows and Linux. The engine has not changed since 0.2.40, and the phone app stays **AnyPS5 Remote 1.23**. Like every release, it is **signed**.

## Mac launcher

- **Settings › Emulators can download the PS1 emulator.** With emulator games turned on, a new row downloads the AnyPS5 emulator host with SwanStation from its signed releases (now anyps5-retro-host 1.1.0). Nothing is downloaded until you select it. The download's signature and every file are checked before it is installed, and again before every game. Select the row later to look for an update.

releases.name: AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41-arm-nightly.20261119.1 (nightly)
releases.body:
Nightly build of main, 2026-11-19, d2a7b88fe8b2. It may have new bugs: the launchers offer it only on their Nightly update channel.

Windows and Linux: the engine for AnyPS5 Desktop. macOS: AnyPS5-macOS.zip and the Mac engine.

It is unsigned until it is signed on the release Mac (tools/release/sign_nightly.sh). The launchers refuse it until then.

AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.39 is a release three days after 0.2.38: **the previous game stays in view on the home tile row**, with the selected game's name and its state as a small icon beside its tile, and **unlocks can be paused and resumed**, with a separate Cancel and a question before quitting while unlocks run (both designed by Lenny4250gh for AnyPS5 Desktop and ported to the Mac), and an **engine fix that runs CLFLUSHOPT and CLWB as CLFLUSH on CPUs without them**, which stopped DOOM 3 BFG on a Haswell PC. **AnyPS5 Desktop 0.1.24** brings the same two launcher features, clearer reports when the launcher stops responding and the engine fix to Windows and Linux. Nothing is downloaded until you select it. The download's signature and every file are checked before it is installed, and again before every game. Select the row later to look for an update.

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

emulators.latest_body:
ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

ares v145 has now been released.

This release contains hefty improvements to a number of ares components. Highlights include Real Time Clock support for the Game Boy Advance, improvements to the experimental PlayStation core, Sega SC-3000 support, important fixes to the Game Boy Color, as well as core improvements to the ares application itself that should improve performance and responsiveness.

Since v144, 8 contributors have created 90 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v144...v145).

**ARM7TDMI (Game Boy Advance CPU, ST018 Super Famicom coprocessor)**

- Implemented many undocumented instruction encodings
- Implemented invalid CPSR modes
- Added support for MRC, MCR, and CDP coprocessor instructions
- Allowed misalignment of the program counter in ARM mode

**Nintendo - Game Boy Color**

- Improved HDMA and GDMA timings (fixes some major graphical bugs)

**Nintendo - Game Boy Advance**

- Added support for the Real Time Clock
- Re-introduced optional Game Boy Player support

emulators.latest_body: # ARMSX2 2.9.5 What's new: ## Memory cards **Folder memory cards keep every save.** If your memory card's Type is Folder, every save is now written whole. A save made just before you left the app could come back blank or as the older version, because the card was written to storage between the save's data and its file entry; that can no longer happen. A new save that reuses a deleted save's space keeps its own name instead of reappearing under the deleted one's. A save file the device won't open for writing is still read, where the game showed it as damaged. New saves are created on storage that needs Android's own file access with the IOP thread on, and leaving the app rewrites nothing when nothing on the card changed. done by @bmdhacks

Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.3 beta
releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

## Black Ops III

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.2 beta
releases.body:
Changes since 0.0.1. Thanks to everyone who sent problem reports, since most of these fixes came from them. This is a beta: the JIT changes ran on an iPhone, and everything else was tested on a Mac. Please send a report if something works worse than in 0.0.1.

## Requirements and install

ARMSX3 for iOS needs an iPhone or iPad with an A14 chip or newer, on iOS 17.4 or later. It isn't on the App Store, so install the IPA with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. JIT needs a pairing file for your device (see Pairing files below).

## Update LiveContainer first

If you run ARMSX3 inside LiveContainer, update LiveContainer to 3.8.13 or later before you install this build. That is the nightly build at the moment: https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly Older versions can't load the JIT helper, and ARMSX3 will fall back to StikDebug.

In LiveContainer, turn on Helper Process Support for ARMSX3, and open ARMSX3 full screen, not in a window.

## Built-in JIT inside LiveContainer

releases.body:
ARMSX3 for iOS is a PlayStation 3 emulator for iPhone and iPad. It runs the same RPCS3-based core as the ARMSX3 Android app, with an app built for iOS around it, and draws through Vulkan on MoltenVK. # WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.9
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on Forever touch controls, launch frame pacing and diagnostics.

Install over 0.0.8 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- Battle.net and the launch screens now run at 30 FPS to reduce rendering work before WoW starts. The cap lifts automatically when WoW starts, so gameplay is unaffected.
- Diagnostics now includes Android's recorded reasons for recent app exits, helping identify low-memory closures and crashes. Available on Android 11 and later.
- Added experimental Turnip Gen8 V38 as a manual graphics driver choice on Adreno 7xx phones.

## Touch control fixes

- Forever now receives the touch layout, with chat, player frames and hotbars positioned clear of the touch buttons.
- Forever's controller and gamepad interface now turn off when launching with touch controls. Turning touch controls off restores your previous controller settings on the next launch.
- Fixed "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" errors caused by the Forever touch layout during combat.
- Fixed Forever's hidden quest tracker and quests disappearing when selecting a target.

# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 4
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 4

Maintenance update focused on clearer Vulkan driver error reporting.

- Improved visibility and consistency of diagnostic messages when a driver cannot start or stops responding.
- Clearer on-device troubleshooting feedback for experimental driver configurations.

Custom driver compatibility remains device-dependent. This hotfix does not guarantee successful driver loading or resolve game rendering issues.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required.

AzaharPlus 2126.2-A is the same as Azahar 2126.2 except for this:

emulators.latest_body:
> [!NOTE]
Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

### Changelog
- Collected Jinjos will be now be permanently saved when collected, just like Notes. A new option has been added to choose only saving Jinjos or Notes if desired. The new default behavior will be to save both Notes and Jinjos as present in the Xbox 360 version of the game. Special thanks to @wedarobi for their work on this major feature!
- Fixed a major memory leak that would occur on MacOS by updating RT64. The game should now be significantly more stable on extended play sessions on Mac.
- Fixed a build system issue for ARM devices that caused mods, especially total conversion mods, to crash during startup. This should finally make total conversion mods like Nostalgia 64 or Jiggies of Time playable in MacOS devices without requiring to use Rosetta as a workaround.

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body:
### Mods
The **Thunderstore** page for Banjo: Recompiled is **now available**! Find, download and update your mods from this website!

https://thunderstore.io/c/banjo-recompiled/

> [!NOTE]
Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

### Changelog
- N64-Style Octagon Input Scaling has been implemented. Controls should now feel significantly smoother.
- Fixed an issue where UI callbacks were not being called for custom UI elements created by mods.
- DS4Windows and similar tools that cause duplicate HIDs should no longer lead to the axis state being accumulated twice and biasing towards cardinal directions.
- Fixed an error where the launcher would sometimes show a glitch when going back from the settings menu.
- Added fallback for outdated AMD driver to use Vulkan.

releases.name: Borked3DS v2024.03.10
releases.body:
This Mar.10 update brings a couple of bug fixes, some minor Vulkan improvements, and ports some fixes and features from Azahar.

### Major Bugs Fixed
* Games crashing on launch with Vulkan on executables compiled with GCC.
* Fixed issue where Circle Pad and C-Stick Up/Down button mappings are
reversed when configured with the "Set Analog Stick" button on Desktop.

### What's Changed
* renderer_vulkan.h: Set PRESENT_PIPELINES = 4 by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/346
* renderer_vulkan: Implement memory type fallbacks and improve logging by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/349
* Make verbose logging the default by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/350
* renderer_vulkan.cpp: Add some framebuffer logging by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/353
* renderer_vulkan: Add initialization checks, prevent null image views from being used in descriptor sets by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/355
* vk_instance.h: Add more tile-based GPUs to the list of ShouldFlush() by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/360

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.02.14
releases.body:
## 🥰 Happy Valentine's Day! 🥰

**NOTE**:  It is recommended that you clear the contents of your `shaders` folder before upgrading to this version.
* On Desktop:  Navigate to `File->Open Borked3DS Folder` and empty the `shaders` folder.
* On Android:  Long press on a game, tap on the folder icon, tap on `Open Shader Cache Folder` and delete the contents.

This release focuses mainly on stability and bug fixes, with a couple of new features which will hopefully improve performance.

### Bugs Fixed
* The MacOS build does not launch properly (x86_64 and AArch64).
* Rotating the display in Android may result in a crash.
* The Android app may not launch correctly on Android 9-11.
* Regression: Launching the Home Menu may not work correctly in Android (NOTE: If it still doesn't work after upgrading to this release, you may need to re-download the System Files or clear out your User Folder and then re-download).
* Regression: There may have been some minor missing textures when using OpenGL.
* Borked3DS now builds with gcc-12 on Bookworm-based Raspberry Pi (or similar aarch64) devices (NOTE: It may still not run properly regardless; this is still being looked at).

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.01.23-sdl-compat
releases.body:
This release is identical to [v2025.01.23](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23) except that instead of being built with SDL2, it's built with SDL3 via [sdl2-compat](https://github.com/libsdl-org/sdl2-compat). The intent is to port the project to pure SDL3 eventually, but in the meantime, this allows users the ability to test the new backend.

## What's Changed
* externals: Switch from SDL2 to SDL3 via sdl2-compat by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/315

Third Party Updates
* SDL 3.2.0 via sdl2-compat

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/compare/v2025.01.23...v2025.01.23-sdl-compat

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.01.23
releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

releases.name: v0.5.12: Hide controls option, Play crash hotfix & GPU hang fixes
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android Recomp v0.5.12

### Español
- **Ocultar controles en pantalla:** Se añadió la opción en el Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) para ocultar los controles visuales. Los controles siguen 100% activos y funcionales al tocar la pantalla, ideal para quienes prefieren la pantalla limpia o juegan con memoria muscular.
- **Corrección de cierre inmediato al iniciar (Play crash):** Se protegió el acceso a JNI y verificación de permisos de almacenamiento en `android_main` para dispositivos cargando directo por NSP/FD (POCO X7 Pro, POCO F6, etc.).
- **Solución al congelamiento en "Preparing game":** Se limitaron los hilos del compilador de shaders a un máximo de 4 durante la importación, solucionando bloqueos indefinidos en procesadores MediaTek Dimensity 8350.
- **Corrección de cuelgues de GPU (GPU Hangs):** Se deshabilitaron las divisiones de renderpass a mitad de pase (`NX_CHUNK_IN_PASS=0`) por defecto en GPUs TBDR (Adreno 830 / Mali).
- **Corrección de texto en mensajes (IM / SNS Chat):** Se corrigió el renderizado del texto en las opciones de respuesta del chat del teléfono móvil (PR #251).

releases.name: v0.5.11: Audio resume, UI pipeline state & Qualcomm movie alignment fixes
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.11

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Audio resume on sleep/lock screen (Fixes #238):**
  Automatically recreates the AAudio stream when disconnected, restoring game sound upon waking or unlocking the phone.
  *Se re-crea automáticamente el flujo de audio de AAudio al desconectarse, restaurando el sonido del juego al desbloquear o reanudar el teléfono.*
- **UI stripes and color banding on tile-based GPUs (Fixes #243):**
  Fixed bound pipeline and dynamic state cache invalidation on render pass end, preventing dull colors and white stripes in menus and dialogue on Adreno, Mali, and PowerVR.
  *Se corrigió la invalidación del estado dinámico y pipelines al finalizar un pase de renderizado, solucionando colores apagados y franjas blancas en la interfaz.*
- **Qualcomm Snapdragon cutscene video alignment (PR #245):**
  Applied proper row alignment independently of stride for Qualcomm hardware decoders, fixing green and distorted lines during opening cutscenes.
  *Alineación de filas independiente de stride para decodificadores Qualcomm, eliminando líneas verdes y distorsiones en cinemáticas.*
- **PowerVR title screen stability:**

releases.name: v0.5.10: PowerVR title screen crash fixed
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.10

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **PowerVR crash at the title screen fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed right after the opening movie, when the title screen appeared. It now reaches the title and keeps going.
  **Arreglado el cierre en la pantalla de título en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba justo después del vídeo de la intro, al aparecer la pantalla de título. Ahora llega al título y sigue.

### Known issue / Problema conocido
- On some PowerVR phones the picture may hold for a few seconds at that point while the sound keeps playing; then the game continues.
  En algunos móviles PowerVR la imagen puede quedarse quieta unos segundos en ese punto mientras el sonido sigue; después el juego continúa.

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.name: v0.5.9: fixed movie stripes and PowerVR crash
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.9

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Movies without diagonal stripes:** since v0.5.7 the videos and some cutscenes showed diagonal colour stripes on many phones (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek and some Snapdragon). The port misread how the phone's video decoder lays out each frame; it now reads it correctly.
  **Vídeos sin rayas diagonales:** desde la v0.5.7 los vídeos y algunas cinemáticas salían con rayas diagonales de colores en muchos móviles (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek y algunos Snapdragon). El port leía mal cómo el decodificador de vídeo del móvil organiza cada imagen; ahora lo lee bien.
- **PowerVR crash at start fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed a few seconds after opening, on the loading icon. It now starts and plays normally.
  **Arreglado el cierre al iniciar en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba a los pocos segundos de abrirlo, en el icono de carga. Ahora arranca y se juega con normalidad.

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.name: Cemu 2.5

**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.0
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Motion sensitivity
- **Motion sensitivity X axis** and **Motion sensitivity Y axis** set how fast turning left and right, and tilting up and down go, from 25% to 500%. They are next to the motion inversion on each controller's page in **Input settings** and in the quick menu under Controls, and work for the motion of the device and of controllers
- They scale the turning speed the game gets, which is what aiming with motion uses. A tilt that is held still settles at the real angle of the device

### Updated to the latest Cemu
Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:
- **Wii U CPU on ARM:** fixes in the ARM64 recompiler that runs every game, for single-precision float stores (now faster too), division by zero, carry flags and a few wrong instructions. The default NaN mode of ARM is turned off to match the Wii U
- **Performance:** smaller Vulkan and GPU optimizations, like checking only the render state that changed, caching shader lookups and using the fast draw path more often

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.3.6
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Input settings, redone
- Each controller has all its settings on one page, the ones used most first: what it emulates, the controller in use with **Set up all inputs**, its buttons and sticks, motion, rumble, profiles, and the stick and trigger sensitivity at the end under **Advanced**. The **Controller settings** dialog and the separate **Device settings** screen are gone
- The controller in use is picked from the connected ones right on the page, and **Set up all inputs** binds that one directly
- **Invert motion X axis** and **Invert motion Y axis** are next to **Use motion** on each controller's page
- The touch screen, sensors and vibration of the device can be moved to a controller from its page, and the vibration strength of the device is set there too
- The inputs are shown as a grid of tiles that say **Not set** when nothing is bound
- The input settings list the controllers in use, with **Add a controller** for the next free one, then **Hotkeys** and **On-screen controls**

### Controller profiles per game

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.3.6-beta.2
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

Frame generation requires the Vulkan memory model, float16 and null descriptor support from the GPU driver.
The FPS overlay shows the displayed frame rate together with the base frame rate while frame generation is active.

**Full changelog:** [v0.3.5...v0.3.6-beta.2](https://github.com/danielcamilo1/cemu-plus/compare/v0.3.5...v0.3.6-beta.2)

# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。
emulators.note: 支持端侧与云端 OCR，可离线运行。

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
# v0.4.7 主要更新

新增：停稳翻译，画面停止变化后自动翻译，翻页后自动更新译文。

新增：划词翻译支持「仅提取文字」，框选即可提取文字，支持复制和朗读。

新增：输入翻译，可翻译输入框中的文字并直接替换。

新增：自动识别设置，可为不同语言选择识别方式。

新增：截屏区域设置，支持控制区域边框显示、截屏时自动隐藏、区域位置与大小调整，以及自定义区域样式。

新增：PaddleOCR 支持韩文识别。

新增：小牛翻译，可在翻译引擎中选择并配置使用。

新增：LLM 服务商预设，支持查看官方文档、测试连接和获取模型列表；API Key 需自行填写。

新增：[Issue #23](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/23) 提出的快捷设置磁贴，可快速启动或停止截屏服务。

新增：[Issue #22](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/22) 提出的画面方向修正，支持手机竖屏但游戏内容横屏等场景。

新增：翻译库支持「全部停用」，无需逐项关闭。

新增：关于页面增加「使用手册」入口，方便查看功能说明和操作步骤。

新增：开发者选项增加全屏共享开关，开启后请求共享整个屏幕。

优化：改善漫画文字识别和译文显示效果。

优化：改善朗读语言判断、权限处理和服务商配置体验。

优化：提取文字支持悬浮窗口的合并强度设置，显示、复制和朗读使用相同的分段结果。

修复：模型下载失败、断点续传异常及配套模型未自动下载的问题。

修复：自动识别韩文时可能识别错误或只返回标点的问题。

修复：多种语言同时出现时，自动识别可能选错识别结果、遗漏部分文字的问题。

修复：切换应用语言后，部分悬浮菜单、翻译卡片和选框按钮仍显示原来语言的问题。

releases.name: v0.4.5
releases.body:
# v0.4.5 主要更新

新增：术语库支持从 JSON 文件批量导入，可在导入前预览、筛选并处理重复内容。

新增：悬浮窗支持点击英文单词查看简要释义，并可打开完整词卡。

新增：实验性支持将当前画面随翻译发送给兼容的 LLM，用于辅助判断阅读顺序、识别内容和画面语境。该功能默认关闭。不同多模态模型的识别能力差异较大，暂时不能保证提高文字识别质量；开启后还会增加等待时间和调用费用，请根据所用模型的实际效果选择。

优化：完善思考模式、推理强度、图片清晰度和自定义请求参数等 LLM 设置。

优化：调整日文、中文、韩文和拉丁文字识别流程，并改进 Paddle OCR 的批量识别与竖排文字处理。

优化：改进同屏、连续和全部合并翻译的顺序、结果对应与异常恢复，减少重复请求和翻译失败。

优化：统一欢迎页与设置页的模型推荐、下载检查和离线方案选择。

优化：提升 Shizuku 及部分兼容实现的适配稳定性。

修复：若干悬浮窗、原文覆盖、设置状态和界面显示问题。

releases.name: v0.4.4
releases.body:
# v0.4.4 主要更新

新增：快速、同屏、连续三种翻译模式，可根据速度、当前画面上下文或前后画面对话选择合适的翻译方式。

新增：更自由的 LLM 控制，可按模型需要调整流式输出、思考模式、采样参数和消息模板。

优化：漫画文字识别与原文覆盖效果。

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.5.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.4.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.4.0): one executable that keeps itself up to date, the game's own menus played with the mouse, prompts that name your keys, and a faster renderer.

## New

- **One file: `CoD3SP_s.exe`.** FFmpeg's libraries for the sound and the films are built into it; nothing else to unpack.
- **Updates itself.** At every start it asks GitHub for a newer release; if there is one, it downloads it, replaces itself and starts the new version. Turn it off with `auto_update = 0` under `[game]` in `CoD3Recomp.ini`, or start it with `--no-update`.
- **New first start.** The console window asks whether this is a fresh install (choose your disc image, then the folder to install into) or the game is already installed (choose the game's main folder, the one with `default.xex`).

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.4.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.3.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.2.3](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.3): the campaign goes on from one mission to the next, a level runs above 60 frames a second, and a row of picture faults is gone.

## New

- **The next mission after a win.** The console restarts the game between missions and hands the next one over; the port does the same, so a finished mission leads into the next one instead of closing the game.
- **A mission's briefing film can be skipped** with Space (A) once its level has loaded. On the console it always plays to its end.
- **Unlimited frame rate in levels** (settings menu, on by default). A level runs at what the machine can do, around 100 to 115 frames a second where it had 60; the menus stay at 60 and the films at their own 30. The game's speed does not change with the frame rate.
- **Model detail** (settings menu): the game's own level of detail, or the finest version of every model at any distance.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

# NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2

Carbon incorpora las mejoras de compatibilidad de Most Wanted 0.5.4, el selector de drivers Vulkan y las actualizaciones opcionales, conservando su launcher, idiomas y controles.

## Mejoras

- Adaptación del renderer y de los shaders para GPU que admiten solo **cuatro conjuntos de descriptores**, presentes en algunos Mali y otros dispositivos.
- Conversión **BC4/BC5 en CPU con Xclipse** y el driver propietario de Samsung.
- **Sincronización ARM adaptada a las funciones de Carbon**: se publican las órdenes completas antes de ejecutarlas desde otro hilo, corrigiendo una causa de posibles cierres al entrar a carrera.
- **Drivers Vulkan externos:** importa, selecciona, prueba y elimina ZIPs Android ARM64. La prueba se ejecuta en un proceso independiente y muestra GPU, Vulkan y funciones disponibles. Puedes volver al driver del sistema.
- **Avisos opcionales de nuevas versiones** de este repositorio con **Actualizar** o **Más tarde**, más **Buscar actualizaciones** en el launcher. Puedes seguir jugando sin actualizar ni tener conexión; no se instalan ni descargan APKs automáticamente.

## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

releases.name: Winlator Cmod v13.1.1
releases.body:
_Minor update v13.1.1 fixed custom icons, default renderer, and warning prompt handling on new installs_ 

------------------------------

-   **`evshim` Rewrite:** The entire controller shim (`libevshim.so`) has been rewritten, **completely eliminating the use of shared memory (`mmap`)**, resulting in a massive reduction in CPU overhead and a significant performance boost, especially on lower-end devices. Box64 3.2 and 3.6 are now compatible, and have been restored.

-   **ALSA-Reflector Improved** The pacer's ring buffer and reconnection logic have been refined, expect better performance and reliability.

-   **Universal CPU Overhead Reduction:** I've gone through the code to find and eliminate performance bottlenecks, once again, big thanks to @Pipetto-crypto as always for the guidance and his improvements to the Graphics Wrapper. 

### ✨ New Feature: VkBasalt Integration

-   **Per-Shortcut Sharpening & Effects:** Thanks to @Pipetto-crypto You can now enable VkBasalt on a per-shortcut basis to apply CAS and DLS to your games.

This update includes a huge number of fixes for a smoother experience.

The old input methods are gone (sorta), replaced by a completely new, from-the-ground-up controller implementation built on a native SDL2 backend. - **Native XInput & DInput Support:** No more switching settings per game! releases.name: Winlator Cmod - Project Status Update - April 2025
releases.body:
### Statement on BrunoSX’s hiatus
Bruno (@brunodev85) announced he’s pausing Winlator development after false virus accusations. There are no viruses in Winlator, at least not intentionally—debug symbols in the bundled Wine builds can trigger antivirus heuristics, but I realize that the latest release had something a bit different that scrambled executable file names. The reality is that these things can happen, it's certainly not intentional. *Update: TestD3D.exe _was_ infected with floxif. Again, this was not intentional, but it should be noted.  

### Where Cmod & the Bionic fork stand
My own Cmod branch has been quiet since Prototype 5 / v12 alpha (Discord-only). Meanwhile, amazing work continues:

@Pipetto-crypto – Bionic & graphics wrappers

@cjxyz – Bionic Winlator fork and new features

### My roadmap
I’m resuming work—slowly, around a busier job—but the plan is:

🔧 Fix Gamepad Configurator

🖥️ Streamline Big Picture Mode (Cmod Big Picture Mode, the frontend looking menu I made a while back. But Steam support is still on my radar)

🍷 Update Wine & core assets

🏷️ Expand on shortcut settings / per-app tweaks

Expect incremental releases rather than one big drop.

- Sign in through the official FFNY Online Discord account service. New connections use the verified account name; the manual player-name screen is removed.
- Saved sessions use encrypted app-private storage. Account sign-out, deletion and privacy controls remain accessible inside the game.
- Fixed the PC build fingerprint used for ordinary room and player discovery. The missing build-number bytes previously separated Android players from compatible PC lobbies.
- Choose Europe or North America from the launcher. Both players must use the same region.
- Added real account statistics and leaderboard access in the native online menu.
- Preserved room codes, native room creation, fighter selection and the existing online flow.

## Room voice chat
- Added PC-compatible room voice with push-to-talk: enable voice, allow microphone access and hold MIC to speak.
- Added a microphone permission prompt on first game entry, playback volume and a Mute/Unmute microphone button.

releases.name: Def Jam v1.2 — Controls & Compatibility Update
releases.body:
Update for the Android ARM64 port, focused on controls, frame pacing and online compatibility.

## Changes since v1.1
- Expanded Xbox/PlayStation-style and custom touch control layouts, including dual analog input and editable menu buttons.
- Improved the online player-name prompt and retained the original in-game online menu with room codes. Removed the extra floating ONLINE shortcut; Enter/Start is retained.
- Updated automatic 60 FPS menu / 30 FPS low-end combat pacing, frame-time statistics and CPU/network diagnostics. Actual performance depends on the device and scene.
- Reduced repeated missing-file lookups and refined online input waiting and delay handling.
- Updated the public relay connection handshake and corrected misleading password errors and repeated connection attempts after rejection.
- Included experimental, opt-in rollback support. It is not certified for stable cross-device play and respects the relay's rollback permission.

Existing saves, the built-in ISO/XISO extractor, gamepad support, English/Portuguese/Spanish interfaces and asynchronous Vulkan rendering are retained.

## Important online notice

releases.name: Def Jam v1.1 — The Online Update
releases.body:
The Online Update brings online play, more flexible controls and focused performance improvements to Def Jam on Android.

## Added
- Integrated FFNY Online lobby, public rooms, room codes, fighter selection and arena voting.
- Spanish interface alongside English and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Editable menu controls: move and resize A, B, the grouped D-pad and Enter/Start, with individual opacity settings.
- An always-visible ONLINE shortcut with editable position, size and opacity.

## Fixed and improved
- Fixed touch controls remaining hidden after a gamepad is disconnected.
- Touch controls stay visible during online sessions; the 15-second inactivity timeout applies offline. The ONLINE shortcut stays visible in both modes.
- Improved access to the built-in Xbox ISO/XISO extractor on smaller screens.
- Vulkan synchronization fixes for Mali devices, including the presentation and gamma/FXAA paths.
- Reduced repeated Vulkan pipeline lookups, diagnostic clock reads and temporary touch-input allocations. Actual FPS gains depend on the device and scene.

emulators.name: Copperline
emulators.description: Amiga 模拟器，Rust 编写。
emulators.latest_body:
Copperline 1.1.0 is the first feature release of the 1.x series. Hard drives can now run at the speed of the period drives each Amiga shipped with. The MMU-less 68EC030, 68EC040 and 68EC060 are new CPU choices. The JIT is much faster on fast-RAM code and heavy disk I/O, and has a new "fastest" speed. A500 CIA, interrupt and bus timing are corrected against measurements of a real A500. It also includes every fix made on the 1.x branch since 1.0.1.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.1.0.** Players and spectators need the same build.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version.
- **Desktop save states from 1.0.x still load.** The CIA chunks are migrated to their new layout. A resumed 1.0.x state continues under the corrected timing, so it can drift from what 1.0.x would have produced (a factory A500 state from 1.0.1 still renders byte-identical frames). States saved by 1.1.0 do not load in 1.0.x, which reports that the state comes from a newer Copperline.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.1
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.1 is the first maintenance release for 1.0. Most of it fixes problems reported against 1.0.0: an AGA display fetch error, a blitter race on fast CPUs, warm reboots on the A3000 and A4000, the 68060 FPU at reset, the copperhf hard-disk driver, and a window-resize hang on Windows. Menu settings are now remembered between launches, and screenshots save the picture as you see it.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.1.** Players and spectators need the same build.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files still load: the save-state format has not changed, and a 1.0.0 state resumes byte-for-byte as it does in 1.0.0.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.0 is the first stable release. It follows two weeks of testing of 1.0.0-rc.1 and is the 23rd release since the source went public on 14 June.

This release adds Smart framing and native 1:1 screenshots, more control over where and how the window opens, VHD hard-disk images, a fix for AGA sprites that use scan-doubling, and a Check for updates button that only contacts GitHub when you press it.

## Copperline 1.0 at a glance

- **Machines:** A1000, A500, A500+, A600, A1200, A3000, A4000, CDTV and CD32, with OCS, ECS and AGA chipsets and 68000 to 68060 CPUs, FPUs and MMUs.
- **Accuracy:** the CPU and custom chips run on one colour-clock timeline, with the chip bus shared out cycle by cycle. Timing is checked against a real A1200, A4000 and CD32, and 45 test programs are compared pixel for pixel on every change.
- **Ready to run:** the open AROS ROM is bundled, as are ROMs for the A2091, A4091 and IDE boards, the CD32 FMV module and the HRTMon freezer. WHDLoad packages and Amiga programs boot directly.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0-rc.1: the first release candidate for 1.0
releases.body:
This is the first release candidate for Copperline 1.0. If testing does not turn up problems that need a second candidate, the next release will be 1.0.0.

This cycle brings three- and four-player netplay on the desktop, debugger watchpoints on device registers with a timed trace of CD32 drive commands, a refreshed AROS ROM, and a review of the whole manual against the program, which also found and fixed a few mismatches in the program itself.

Please try your usual games, demos and configurations with it. Anything that worked in 0.21.0 and does not work here is exactly what a release candidate is for: [open an issue](https://github.com/CopperlineHQ/Copperline/issues) with the configuration and the software involved.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.0-rc.1.** The wire protocol moved to version 3 to carry up to four players, so a 0.21.0 peer cannot join.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files from 0.20.0 and 0.21.0 still load; states from 0.19 and earlier do not.

releases.name: Copperline 0.21.0: spectators, four controllers and desktop fixes
releases.body:
Copperline 0.21.0 adds spectators to Netplay, connects four local controllers on desktop and in RetroArch, and reduces the work needed to put each frame on screen. It also fixes file-picker crashes and changes two defaults that could upset otherwise working games.

## Before upgrading

- **Clipboard sharing is now off by default.** It fits an extra autoconfig board, which changes the Amiga's memory layout. That caused a hang in Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge under 0.20. Enable it explicitly with `--clipboard` or `[clipboard] share = true` when you want it. An existing configuration that explicitly enables sharing keeps doing so.
- **The CD32 FMV cartridge is now optional.** A stock CD32 starts with an empty cartridge slot. To use the bundled open FMV ROM, select **Fit** in the launcher's FMV row or set top-level `fmv = true`. A named `fmv_rom` still fits that ROM. Configurations that relied on the old implicit default need this setting for FMV playback; ordinary CD32 games no longer inherit the cartridge's changes to memory layout and boot timing.
