Before, it crashed right after the splash screen on every phone tested: at 0.5x resolution, render targets were freed while a cached scaling helper still used them.
- **Ocarina of Time on 12 GB phones:** Ocarina of Time will no longer be optimized for 12 GB devices. It needs more memory than a 12 GB phone has free and can be closed for low memory there. 16 GB of RAM is recommended.
- **Speed and memory** (upstream)

releases.name: Hokkaido 0.6.5
releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.6.5

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and, for the first time, a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), both on Android 17. The performance work tested on the S26's Exynos carries over well to Snapdragon.

## Highlights

- **Fast Fusion** now gets past its title screen and into races, but at low frame rates (the game runs in slow motion) and with a shimmering image. Before, it crashed right after the splash screen on every phone tested: at 0.5x resolution, render targets were freed while a cached scaling helper still used them.
- **Ocarina of Time on 12 GB phones:** Ocarina of Time will no longer be optimized for 12 GB devices. It needs more memory than a 12 GB phone has free and can be closed for low memory there. 16 GB of RAM is recommended.
- **Speed and memory** (upstream)
  - GPU address space is reused and given back when the allocator runs out.
  - Command list copies are reused instead of made again.
  - Occlusion query lookups, frees and locks are cheaper.
  - Game file sections open when they are first used.
  - Memory write traps skip the texture cache on pages that hold no texture.

releases.name: Hokkaido 0.6.4
releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.6.4

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB), both on Android 17.

## Highlights

- **Game compatibility** (upstream)
  - A texture slot that is still empty when a shader is built now compiles as a 2D texture. Upstream this fixed Pokémon Legends Z-A's blank screen.
  - Shader translation no longer runs out of stack on Kirby Air Riders' loops.
  - More shaders translate: shifts with a uniform shift amount (SHF), and more texture gather and call forms.
  - Ocarina of Time 1.0 (without the update) works with the "No Sharpening" anti-aliasing setting.
- **Snapdragon:** Adreno's early depth test (LRZ) is turned off where it drew wrong, on Qualcomm's own driver (upstream).
- **Memory** (upstream)
  - ASTC textures with uneven mip levels stay compressed on phones and other GPUs with shared or small memory.
  - A new buffer no longer joins a large buffer it only shares a page with. Upstream this caused slowdowns and a crash on Yoshi's book pages.
  - Memory hints skip placeholder addresses.
- **Stability** (upstream)
  - Closing a game while its shaders load no longer hangs, and the next launch works.

emulators.description: 在 iOS 上运行 Steam 大屏幕模式与 Windows 游戏。

releases.name: iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.6 — Build 145 · Steam64 setup, one step at a time
releases.body:
# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

## Install and test

releases.name: iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.5 — Build 143 · Smoother Steam UI (experimental)
releases.body:
# iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.5 · Build 143

**Experimental checkpoint — known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit.**

## What changed

- Smoother Steam home/library browsing reported on the test iPhone after reducing periodic diagnostics and pausing hidden log parsing.
- Steam menu now uses the existing window instead of starting a second Steam client and potentially blocking the control helper.
- Improved consistency when reopening the selected Steam64 runtime and its separate saved-login environment.
- VM maintenance and safety guards stay enabled. Experimental GPU-auto and V8 JIT are not promoted to defaults.

## What was tested

Build143 was installed on an iPhone15ProMax/A17Pro. The user confirms the Steam menu works and browsing is more fluid. Hot Roads launched and exited three times; **Steam froze after the third return**. This bug remains open. Full build/native37, focused host checks, final-binary markers, package audit and portable relinking passed. Other games, Bluetooth, older devices and prolonged stability are not validated here.

## Install / upgrade

releases.name: iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.4 — Build 99 · Steam, one download away
releases.body:
## One button closer to your Steam library · Build 99

**Download & Install Steam — directly inside iDeck.** After preparing the local
runtime, download the complete pinned Windows Steam client and CEF/browser files
from Valve's HTTPS CDN. No computer or manual ZIP transfer is needed for acquiring
Steam files. JIT/signing setup may still require a computer on older OS versions.

### What's new

- Full 19-package Steam/CEF download with real byte progress, SHA-256 and complete
  6,233-file verification; not just the Dock component bootstrap.
- Cancel, Retry and verified-package caching. Safe streaming ZIP extraction,
  storage/session checks and recoverable public-file installation transactions.
- Repair incomplete or incompatible client files while preserving accounts,
  installed games and saves. Manual import remains available. Fully reopen iDeck
  after installation/repair before enabling JIT.
- iOS/iPadOS26 pipe creation compatibility: fixes a weak-null system API call
  which crashed the runtime before Steam started.
- Browser-thread compatibility: handles the signed ARM64 TEB load captured
  terminating a Steam browser thread after entering Big Picture.

releases.name: iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.3 — Build 67 · Repair, re-sign, play
releases.body:
## iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.3 · Build 67

**iDeck brings the Steam Big Picture experience to iOS.** Genuine Windows Steam
runs locally through Madeira/Wine/FEX and Metal. This does not install Linux
SteamOS and is not PC streaming.

### What's new since Build 56

- **Repair Steam inside iDeck.** The launcher now identifies missing/incompatible
  client/browser files and provides **Repair Steam files**. Existing account data,
  games and saves are preserved; replaced public program files are backed up.
  Reopen iDeck after repair. A compatible user-supplied client is required when
  no bundled repair source exists: `iDeck/Steam32OfficialRepair` in Files.
- **64-bit game installation detection.** Wine now exposes the existing AMD64
  capability correctly to the legacy Steam client. The user confirmed Ratatan
  could download/install. This does not make every 64-bit game compatible.
- **Ratatan startup/display work.** Preserve emulator allocation headroom and
  Steamworks image space; restore fullscreen preferences with an original-value
  backup; enable the existing WGI controller route for isolated Steam sessions.

releases.name: iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.2 — Build 56 · Six checks before takeoff
releases.body:
# iDeck — six checks before takeoff

**iDeck brings the SteamOS experience to iOS.** This developer alpha runs genuine

releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 — Release Notes

**2026-11-14 · Windows x64 · Linux x86_64 · macOS Intel**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 is a performance release. Nothing in the emulation model changed: every
game still renders the same picture it did in v0.9.9.6, and the same save states still load. What
changed is how much work the CPU and the GPU have to do to get there.

The headline is that the hybrid JIT now translates **more than 80 % of the guest instruction
stream to native x86-64**, the Vulkan renderer stopped paying for a redundant depth write that was
silently disabling hardware Early-Z / Hi-Z culling, and UMA GPUs finally get zero-copy geometry
upload. Together those turn the integrated-GPU experience from "lock it to 496×384" into a picture
that can actually be played at native resolution.

## 📦 Packages

| Platform | File | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.Windows.zip` | Windows 10/11, Vulkan 1.3 |
| Linux x86_64 | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.Linux.tar.gz` | glibc 2.38+, Vulkan 1.3 |
| macOS Intel | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.macOS-Intel.tar.gz` | macOS 13.0+, bundled MoltenVK 1.3 |

**2026-11-07 · Windows (this download) · Linux / macOS builds from the same tree are produced by CI**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.6 is the biggest release this fork has shipped. It is not a maintenance
build: the emulation core now has a PowerPC → x86-64 hybrid JIT, the audio path can drive a real

stabilizer, direct-drive wheels finally get real force feedback and live pedal calibration, and the

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.8.6a — Windows hotfix

**Windows only.** This release contains a single asset for Windows x64. Everything else is
v0.9.8.6 unchanged.

---

## Why the v0.9.8.6 Windows package refused to start on AMD graphics cards

On Windows, AMD's Vulkan driver reports **128 bytes** of push constants — the amount Vulkan itself
guarantees. Every driver this renderer had been developed against reports 256.

The 3D scene shader packed 208 bytes into that block: the projection matrix, the light parameters
and the fog colour, re-sent on every single draw call. The renderer's device selection therefore
required 256 bytes, found 128, rejected the GPU, and the program exited — the start-up artwork
flashed and disappeared, no settings window, no game, no message. Nothing in the picture was wrong;
the renderer simply refused to open the device.

The report that surfaced this was a Steam Deck running Windows 11, whose AMD APU driver reports 128
as well — but the same limit applies to Radeon cards and Ryzen APUs on Windows generally, not to one
machine.

## What is fixed

**The scene shader now fits in the 128 bytes Vulkan guarantees.** The projection matrix, the light

releases.body:
# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.8.6x — Linux and macOS

**This release replaces both `v0.9.8.6l` (Linux) and `v0.9.8.6m` (macOS).** It contains three
assets: Linux, macOS for Apple Silicon, and macOS for Intel Macs. There is no Windows package: the
Windows build is unchanged since v0.9.8.6 and does not need this update.

---

## Fixed in both packages

**The in-game settings panel ignored the mouse and the keyboard on Linux and macOS.**

Press Tab and the panel opened, but nothing in it responded: no hover highlight, no clicks, no arrow
keys, no Enter. The panel's input feed was Windows-only — the whole block that reads the pointer
position, the mouse buttons and the key states sat behind `#ifdef _WIN32`, with no equivalent for the
other platforms, so on Linux and macOS only the mouse wheel was ever delivered. It now reads the
platform's per-frame input snapshot, which both backends already maintain: pointer position, three
mouse buttons, Ctrl/Shift/Alt and a full key table (arrows, Tab, Enter, Escape, Home/End, Page Up/Down,
Insert/Delete, Backspace, Space, A/C/V/X/Z, digits and the keypad).

**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.

# PS5PCEM 0.3.4

**This release fixes a launcher regression that prevented games from starting
in packaged installations. Updating both the launcher and runner is recommended.**
It also adds working font rendering, fixes Jurassic Park's font-atlas startup,
implements MemoryPool and AMPR counters, and expands RDNA2 shader support.

These are the changes since **0.3.3**, covering the October 7–9 development

releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.
- **A libretro core** runs izapple2 inside RetroArch and the other libretro frontends, with diskette swapping from M3U playlists and saves as overlays. It is built from source and is not in the release archives. See [the libretro page](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro.md) and [the Mac guide](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro_macos.md).

* **Install with Homebrew** on macOS and Linux:
  ```
  brew install ivanizag/tap/izapple2
  ```
  The formula is now updated automatically on every release

## Other changes and fixes

* Mockingboard listed among the supported cards in the README
* Updated dependencies and npm packages of the WASM frontend

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8
Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8-test1 (test build for issue 39)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test4 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test3 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It does not fix the crash. It records it. [1.1.7-test2](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test2) answered the first fault on the Thor, a table of textures the driver refused. The app still closes a moment later, and the log has no line for it. This build writes the reason into `snap64.log`:

- When the app closes on a fault, it writes the signal, the thread, the graphics call that thread was in, and the code addresses.
- At the next start, it copies in Android's own report of how the last run ended.

To help: install it over what you have, open it, let it close, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test2 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is 1.1.7 with one file of the renderer changed. On a Qualcomm graphics driver, the renderer's table of textures now gets its full declared size, and on any driver a table that is refused is asked for once more. Three guards came with it: a refused table is no longer written to, and clears and scissors are kept inside what Vulkan allows. The log says more about what the driver answers. The change is attached as `plume-issue36.patch`.

The APK is signed with the project's key, so it installs over 1.1.7 and saves stay. Android's app info shows it as 1.1.7-test2.

It has been checked on Android's emulator only. The same game code passed the Android checks, 114 of 114. The signed file installed over 1.1.7 with its files kept, and passed the fix's own check, which plays the Qualcomm driver's rule, 23 of 23. It has not run on a Thor yet. That is what this build is for.

releases.name: v0.3.2
releases.body:
## Eden NX2 Android v0.3.2

  ### New: [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) Container Format Support

  Added support for the [`.nup` (NX Package)](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) file format — a clean-room container for unencrypted Nintendo Switch and Switch 2
  game dumps.

  **What it does:**
  - Load games directly from `.nup` files — base, updates, and DLC bundled in a single file
  - Supports raw and zstd-compressed content
  - Game metadata (title, icon, publisher, version) extracted automatically from [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) packages
  - `.nup` files appear in the game library like any other supported format

  **Supported features:**
  - ExeFS + RomFS loading from [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) packages
  - Per-package metadata via TLV blocks (NPDM, NACP, icon, title, version)
  - Zstandard decompression for compressed extents
  - Full integration with the Android game scanner

  **Technical details:**
  - [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) format v1 spec compliant (magic `NUP\x01`)
  - New `AppLoader_Nup` loader with `DeconstructedRomDirectory` delegation
  - Container validation (superblock, TOC integrity, codec checks)

# RMG-K v0.9.16

## Jump into games already in progress
- **Late join:** if a match has an open seat, you can join the room mid-game. The host clicks **Add to Game** and you're in after a pause of a few seconds. Nobody else's game restarts.
- **Rejoin after a drop:** if you get disconnected, the host can add you back the same way.
- **Start solo:** hosts can start a match alone and add friends as they show up.
- Hosts can turn late join on or off for each room.

## Save files
- Matches now start from the host's save file, so everyone has the same unlocks.
- You can also start from a fresh blank save without picking a file.

## Better replays
- **New playback controls:** a timeline you can click or drag to skip anywhere, 10-second jump buttons and playback speed from 25% to 400%.
- **Bookmarks:** mark your favorite moments. They're saved inside the replay file.
- **Faster video export,** with the option to show chat in the exported video.
- **Faster catch-up** when you start watching a live match partway through.
- Spectators now see the right player names, even when people join or leave mid-match.
- Everyone in the room when a game starts can save a replay of it.

releases.body:
PanVK V3, a global patch library, native NGS2 audio, and wide performance and compatibility fixes

## Highlights

- PanVK V3 3.2.0 ships for supported Mali GPUs, with faster God of War III textures.
- Global patch library with XML import, and new patches for more than a dozen games including P.T., Driveclub, UFC and Uncharted.
- Native NGS2 audio fixes Gravity Rush 2 audio glitches and silent dialogue, with a rewritten AJM path.
- Games folder prompt with autosync, a default save data location and in-game Pause.

## Game Compatibility & Patches

- Gravity Rush 2 audio now works properly: native NGS2 fixes the glitches and the silent dialogue
- P.T. renders streamed textures correctly, with checked 60 FPS, resolution, half-resolution shadow, lens flare, camera blur and SSR patches
- Driveclub 540p, 360p and high performance presets, with smoother frame pacing
- Second Son quality floor with a longer view distance and correctly lit scenes
- Galak-Z boots reliably and no longer deadlocks, and Elden Ring, UFC and Uncharted receive rendering and stability fixes
- Horizon Zero Dawn no longer runs out of memory when large buffers grow

releases.name: Bachata S4 v0.2.4
releases.body:
Uncharted and The Order: 1886 boot, Gravity Rush 2 optimizations, and PanVK for Mali

## Highlights

- Uncharted and The Order: 1886 now boot, with new graphics and resolution patches.
- Gravity Rush 2 optimizations and patches, including guarded low-resolution presets.
- PanVK driver support for a limited set of Mali devices.
- A proper two-finger touchpad, off by default and enabled from the in-game menu.

## Game Compatibility & Patches

- Uncharted boots, with fixed character rendering and new graphics and resolution patches
- The Order: 1886 boots, with rendering and stability fixes
- Gravity Rush 2 optimizations, guarded low-resolution presets, and a fixed mining movie transition
- Dark Souls Remastered and God of War III performance improvements

- Synced the published patch catalog

## GPU Drivers

- PanVK V2 2.2.0 bundled as the production driver for supported Mali GPUs
- MediaTek devices default to PanVK where supported
- Faster memory budget queries and fewer redundant GPU barriers on PanVK
- Simplified Drivers screen with a single PanVK entry

releases.name: BachataS4 v0.2.2
releases.body:
# BachataS4 0.2.2

This changelog covers the work completed after the 0.2.0 release through 0.2.2.

## Highlights

- Added the native Android/Bionic runtime alongside the managed glibc/FEX runtime, with runtime-aware Vulkan driver selection.
- Added Storage Access Framework game folders, direct-folder launching, persisted folder permissions, and selective game removal/extraction flows.
- Added multilingual UI support, language settings, landscape orientation controls, touch profiles, controller themes, custom D-pad geometry, and a substantially improved touch-layout editor.
- Improved compatibility and performance for God of War III, The Last of Us, WipEout, and other titles through renderer, readback, image-layout, MSAA, and video-playback fixes.
- F-Droid and Play Store builds now ship the same six offline Turnip packages: three glibc drivers and three Android/Bionic drivers.

## Vulkan drivers and runtimes

- Added and qualified the native Android/Bionic host runtime.
- Added selectable glibc and Bionic runtime drivers with separate per-runtime profile selections.
- Preserved driver choices when switching runtimes and prevented incompatible ABI selections.

emulators.latest_body:
### Fixed

- Ghost of Yōtei no longer freezes after its shaders are compiled (#3). Two causes:
  - Planning the resources of a shader walked the shader's whole value graph again for every word of every buffer descriptor; on this game's largest shaders that took minutes on the GPU command thread, with nothing submitted meanwhile. Each value is now walked once per shader.
  - A few compute shaders became SPIR-V modules of 2.7-3.2 million words that the GPU driver compiled for 15 minutes and more while the game waited (the driver keeps the result, so only the first run on a machine stalled). The largest is now 0.6 million words and builds in about 40 s on an RTX 5090, once; the results are the same, bit for bit (device tests over every buffer format, page-crossing elements and partial EXEC):

releases.name: 0.1.7-alpha - 2026-11-13
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Ghost of Yōtei no longer freezes after its shaders are compiled (#3). Two causes:
  - Planning the resources of a shader walked the shader's whole value graph again for every word of every buffer descriptor; on this game's largest shaders that took minutes on the GPU command thread, with nothing submitted meanwhile. Each value is now walked once per shader.
  - A few compute shaders became SPIR-V modules of 2.7-3.2 million words that the GPU driver compiled for 15 minutes and more while the game waited (the driver keeps the result, so only the first run on a machine stalled). The largest is now 0.6 million words and builds in about 40 s on an RTX 5090, once; the results are the same, bit for bit (device tests over every buffer format, page-crossing elements and partial EXEC):

releases.name: 0.1.6-alpha - 2026-11-12
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Windows: controllers work out of the box. The release archive now carries `SDL3.dll`: the emulator loads SDL at run time and Windows has none of its own, so no controller was found ("SDL3 not available") unless the file was added by hand. The message for a missing library now says where to put it ([#4](https://github.com/keklick1337/rps5e/issues/4)).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/keklick1337/rps5e/compare/v0.1.5-alpha...v0.1.6-alpha

releases.name: 1.0.5-alpha
releases.body:
### Changed

- The automatic choice of the recording thread (`RPS5E_GPU_RECORD_THREAD=auto`) no longer turns it off while the command interpreter also has to wait for room in its queue (`RPS5E_POLICY_FULL`). SILENT HILL: The Short Message's heavy room about 10 fps instead of 8; GTA V with `RPS5E_BDA=1` 47 fps instead of 42.
- `RPS5E_BDA=1` (experimental direct guest memory reads) no longer changes the default of `RPS5E_LABELS_AT_EOP`: with its old default (`1`) GTA V never left its start menu. GTA V's city in Performance mode with `RPS5E_BDA=1`: 47-48 fps against 37 without it; still off by default.
- The emulator's own small writes into GPU-watched guest memory (memcpy/memset inside one page, packets of the command-buffer builders) mark the page written before the store instead of taking a page fault (`RPS5E_PREMARK_SMALL`). GTA V's city in Performance mode: write faults per frame ~1550 → ~320; over the same stretch of the scene the frame rate rises by about 2.5 % (36.6 → 37.4 fps).

releases.name: 0.1.4-alpha
releases.body:
### Added

- On-screen keyboard for games' text input dialogs (sceImeDialog), drawn over the game: type on the keyboard (Enter accepts, Esc cancels) or use the controller (D-pad and Cross on the keys, Circle cancels, Triangle space, Square delete, L1 / R1 move the caret, L2 shift, R2 or Options accept), or click the keys. The game's pads read released while it is shown, and buttons still held when it (or the in-game menu) closes reach the game only after they are released. Before, the dialog was accepted at once with a default text (Demon's Souls' character name). Runs without a window, scripted runs and input recordings and replays still finish the dialog by themselves; `RPS5E_IME_HEADLESS=1` does so with a window too.

### Changed

releases.name: 0.1.3-alpha - 2026-10-31
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Frame captures (`RPS5E_CAPTURE_FRAMES`) of GTA V replay again instead of hanging the GPU. While a capture recorded, GPU results copied straight into guest memory were later taken for CPU writes and recorded; the replay wrote them over its own GPU results, which differ where GPU work orders its atomics differently, and the mixed ray-tracing tree sent a shader into an endless loop. GPU results now reach guest memory through copies the capture sees while it records.
- Silent Hill 2 (Remake) no longer hangs the GPU after START GAME. A small compute write (a 4-byte counter in reused transient memory) at an address where a render target once kept its fast-clear metadata was taken for a metadata clear, which overwrote the counter and left a GPU loop running for billions of iterations; only writes that cover a whole metadata slice count as clears now (`RPS5E_WHOLE_METADATA_WRITES`).

|---|---|---|

emulators.name: SavedataSync
emulators.description: 局域网内跨设备快速同步存档文件夹，用于视觉小说进度接续。
emulators.latest_body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。
emulators.note: 需在同一局域网内的设备间配对。

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。
> 直接升级将导致旧备份永远保留在设备上。
> 卸载会清除应用数据和旧备份，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。

- **旧备份不能带到 0.3.0。** 如果还要用旧备份里的存档，请在升级前先恢复。
- 电脑端的旧备份不再显示，也不会自动清理，可以点备份页的“打开文件夹”手动删除。电脑端的备份开关和保留份数会恢复默认。
- 电脑端和移动端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。
- **备份页可以删除单份备份。** 备份页还会显示实际文件数和不完整备份的占用，并可以清理不完整的备份。
- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。
- **开屏动画从后台返回时也会播放。** 回到桌面或切换应用后再打开都会播放。为了不闪过离开前的页面，Android 13 及以上的最近任务不再显示页面缩略图。

## 改进

- **移除游戏时会一并删除这个游戏的备份。**
- 启动时进入设备页；从后台返回时留在原页。
- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。
- 两端分别统一动效。移动端切页改成两页一起整屏平移，按钮和列表项使用相同的按下反馈；电脑端的列表项和卡片使用相同的悬停和按下效果。
- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。
- 比较结果过期后不再报错，会显示黄色提示并自动重新比较，确认后才开始传输。

releases.name: 0.2.0 UI Refactor
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- **Android 需要先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.2.0 起安装包改用固定发布密钥，无法覆盖安装 0.1.0、0.1.1。卸载会清除应用数据，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。
- 电脑端和手机端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **双端界面重做。** 设备、游戏、任务、传输、备份和设置页换成同一套布局与视觉。各页面分离主次信息。
- **加入 i18n 支持。** 简中、繁中、英语、日语，默认跟随系统，也可以固定一种；Android 的通知会使用所选语言。
- **手动切换主题。** 跟随系统、浅色、深色，保存在本机。
- **备份份数可调。** 默认保留 3 份，可在 1 到 10 之间调整；每个游戏可以跟随全局，也可以单独设置。
- **Android 开屏动画。** 希望各位喜欢~

## 改进

- 手机传输页重新设计，高亮展示两端文件差异，按新增、减少、覆盖、保留等着色。
- 同步计划页顶部汇总文件操作数量，下方明细分组列出文件。
- 传输详情改成进度环加五步进度条，以及详细信息。
- 游戏设置页关联设备显示更直观了。
- 设置页重新设计 UI，更耐看了。
- 备份页显示当前策略和每次备份的时间线。

## 修复

- 修复自动备份存档时，只备份当次传输所变更的文件的问题。
- 修复清除系统浏览器数据可能造成应用数据丢失的问题（手机端的配置改到 Android 原生存储）。
- 修正文字选择、设备地址显示和启动失败时的提示。
- 修复路径显示分行的分割点。
- 修复不能覆盖安装更新 App 的问题（发布工作流使用固定密钥构建 APK）。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- **On Android, you must uninstall the old version before installing.** Starting with 0.2.0, the installer uses a fixed release key, so it cannot be installed over 0.1.0 or 0.1.1. Uninstalling will clear app data, so you will need to re-add games, link devices, and authorize directories.
- Desktop and mobile must be upgraded together.

releases.name: 0.1.1 E2E Expansion
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- 由于传输方式更改，电脑端和手机端要一起升级到 0.1.1。
- Android 可以直接覆盖安装 0.1.0，游戏、目录授权和备份都会保留。

## 新功能

- **在电脑上发起传输。** 在电脑的“传输存档”里选好方向，点“扫描并预览”，手机会扫描两端目录，把计划发回电脑。你在电脑上确认后，手机开始传输，完成后电脑显示“传输完成。”。手机 → 电脑、电脑 → 手机都可以。手机需要开着应用并连上电脑。

## 改进

- 两端改用 Websocket 连接。电脑浏览手机目录、发起传输都不用再等，手机目录打开就显示，不用手动刷新。
- 在电脑上修改游戏配置后，手机会马上同步更新。
- 手机关闭应用或断开连接时，电脑会立即提示。如果这时传输已经开始，会提示到任务列表查看结果。

## 修复

- 手机传输详情里，同一个文件的结果会重复出现，切换到其他页面后还会残留。

## 开发

- 桌面开发模式的页面服务改为监听 127.0.0.1 上的随机空闲端口。
- 在不搜索当前目录可执行文件的 shell 中（设置了 `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath`），`pnpm android:build` 也能找到 Gradle Wrapper 了。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- The computer and phone must both be upgraded to 0.1.1. The connection method between the two ends has changed; 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 cannot connect to each other.
- On Android, you can install 0.1.1 directly over 0.1.0. Games, directory authorizations, and backups will be preserved.

## New Features

emulators.name: Lichii Enhanced
emulators.description: Lichii 的增强版，内置超分与 mod 管理器。

releases.body:
# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.4
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* The libretro core now supports API extensions to retrieve additional metadata and create more portable battery save files
* The iOS frontend has been updated with improved iOS 27 support
* iPhone Duo support was added to the iOS frontend
* The CRT scaling filter has been updated with an improved look
* A new Pixelated/Sharp Bilinear scaling filter
    * This new filter is now the default filter in the Cocoa and SDL frontends
* VFS support was added to the libretro core
* Logging support was added to the libretro core
* The libretro core will now render audio directly in the frontend's audio sample rate, if supported
* Recording audio to a VGM log file is now possible in the Cocoa and SDL frontends
* Minor UI improvements in the Cocoa frontend

## Accuracy Improvements/Fixes
* Workboy emulation now correctly reports the current weekday
* Fixed a bug that made certain small ROM files be incorrectly detected as MMM01 cartridges
* More accurate emulation of SGB command processing

## Bug Fixes

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.3
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* Added support for more controllers in the iOS frontend, including singular Joy-Cons
* Pressing buttons while in a locked rewind state now exits rewind mode in the iOS frontend
* The iOS frontend now handles save conflicts with a dialog, making syncing saves across different machines and emulators easier
* An `examine`/`x` command can now use the `/s` modifier to change its output style to RGBDS-compatible assembly
* An `examine`/`x` command can now use `$` in its modifier to use hexadecimal count values
* It is now possible to adjust the maximum rumble strength
* It is now possible to modify and save a running ROM file from the Memory Viewer in the Cocoa frontend
* Controller buttons can now be assigned to one of 4 hotkey commands in the iOS frontend
* Periodic saves were added to the iOS frontend
* A new screenshot hotkey was added to the SDL frontend
* Controller UI hiding in the iOS frontend can now optionally disable the centering of the game screen

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.2
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* New `usage` debugger command, displaying the Game Boy CPU's time outside of halt/stop modes
* The debugger window in the Cocoa frontend now has a CPU usage graph
* The debugger `print`/`eval` command no longer adds zero padding by default
* The Cocoa frontend now has an option to force an integer scaling factor with black borders, similar to the SDL frontend
* The iOS frontend can now configure rapid A and rapid B buttons on a controller
* The SDL frontend now supports two optional V-sync modes
* The Cocoa and iOS frontends were updated with UI and UX improvements for macOS and iOS 26, respectively
    * This also includes new icons when using on these operating systems, as well as on watchOS 26
* Minor UI improvements were also done for older versions of macOS and iOS
* SameBoy now supports the new menu bar on iPad OS 26
* Improved frame skipping during turbo mode
* Turbo mode can now have a configurable speed cap on all frontends

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.1
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* UI improvements to the Cocoa palette editor
* Improved audio quality on libretro; audio is now rendered by SameBoy at 2MHz, and downsampling is now handled by the libretro frontend itself
    * In the Wii U build, downsampling is still done by SameBoy
* With the meaning of register `$FF75` discovered, it is now referred to as `rPGB` in the debugger
* The output of the `watchpoint` debugger command now includes the watchpoint type (read-only, write-only, or read-write)
    * This makes the default watchpoint type (write-only) more obvious
* Windows 11 users can now optionally disable rounded corners in the Graphics Options menu
* Official Windows builds no longer require installing MSVC runtimes by linking against `mvscrt.dll`
* Major improvements to debugging in the SDL frontend:
    * The main emulator window is no longer unresponsive when the debugger is stopped
    * Pressing keys in the emulator window while the debugger is paused now triggers a terminal bell

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.3 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
## What's New
#### Added
- Added **MIDI** support, allowing some games to play MIDI audio. The software comes with an open-source soundfont by [default](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/1517), and you can also install your preferred soundfont in the `Settings` (currently, only SF2 format is supported). Download Windows MIDI Soundfont [here](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/713).
- Improved **OpenXR** suooport. Many thanks to **Luboš V.** , his work making OpenXR support possible and better.
- Improved Game Controller Support, you can now selectively use **XInput** or **DInput** mapping. Linear triggers now work with both mapping modes. For trigger button, if it’s not working correctly, try adjusting the trigger button mode in the `Settings` to match your controller.
- Added the feature to automatically set the container's **Locale**. You can now also adjust `LC_ALL` settings in the container editing interface.
- Added Landscape And **Portrait Mode** switching features. You can now switch to portrait mode using the container's resolution settings or `Toggle Orientation` button of the left-side navigation bar.

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.2 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added support for `Box64rc`, allowing different Box64 parameters to be set for each process.
- Added `virtual touchscreen` support, also referred to as `direct cursor` support. True touchscreen support requires implementing the XInput2 extension.
- Added support for Chinese. And any corrections to the translation are welcome.
- Added an `content manager`, allowing you to install Wine, graphics drivers, or DX wrappers externally.
- Added the ability to reinstall system files, allowing recovery even if the system files are accidentally damaged.
- Added more VKD3D feature level options.
- Added android `file provider` feature, allowing access to the Winlator data directory through the file manager.
- Added the ability to add `shortcuts` to the home screen, allowing you to launch your programs directly from the desktop. Shortcut changes will be synced in real-time.

#### Fixed
- Fixed the crash issue that occurred when running programs with long Japanese or Chinese titles.
- Corrected the button styling in the DXVK configuration dialog.
- Fixed certain abnormal issues on some SoCs (such as 870), by compiling Box64 with the `BAD_SIGNAL` parameter enabled.

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.1 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added `dxvk-2.4` and `dxvk-gplasync-2.4`, and set dxvk-2.3.1 as the default dxvk. 
- Added version switching and configuration support for `vkd3d`.
- Added `vkd3d-2.13`.
- Added an older version of `box64` (`box64-2.8`).
- Added support for linear triggers. (currently only for Xinput)

#### Fixed
- Fixed the path for the dxvk configuration file.
- Fixed the path for the Virgl server; `VirGL` is now working.
- Fixed keyboard input issues for some games.

#### Changed
- The `AVX` extension for box64 is **disabled** by default. It needs to be manually enabled by creating a new `box64 preset` in the settings.
- Enabled all cores by default for experimental wow64.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1

**Note**: Please uninstall previous versions before installation to avoid potential errors. Remember to **back up** your data.

emulators.latest_body:
## OpenROM v4.1.0

Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit for retro gaming enthusiasts.

Each download includes:
- **OpenROM** — Flutter desktop GUI
- **openrom-core** — headless CLI (used internally by the GUI)

### CLI usage
```
openrom-core --detect game.iso
openrom-core --input game.iso --format CHD
openrom-core --folder /roms/ --format CHD --compression Max
openrom-core --list-formats
```

### Supported Formats
- PS1/Dreamcast/Saturn/Sega CD: BIN/CUE → CHD (createcd)
- PS2/GameCube/Wii: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO, RVZ
- Xbox: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO (XISO via community extension)
- PSP: ISO → CSO
- Universal: ZIP/7Z compression, IPS/BPS/xdelta3/DCP patching

### Downloads
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| 🪟 Windows (Portable) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0_Windows_Portable.zip` |
| 🪟 Windows (Installer) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0-Setup.exe` |
| 🐧 Linux x86_64 (AppImage) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0_Linux_x86_64.AppImage` |
| 🐧 Linux ARM64 (AppImage) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0_Linux_arm64.AppImage` |

## OpenROM v3.9.8

Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit for retro gaming enthusiasts.

Each download includes:
- **OpenROM** — Flutter desktop GUI
- **openrom-core** — headless CLI (used internally by the GUI)

### CLI usage
```
openrom-core --detect game.iso
openrom-core --input game.iso --format CHD
openrom-core --folder /roms/ --format CHD --compression Max
openrom-core --list-formats
```

### Supported Formats
- PS1/Dreamcast/Saturn/Sega CD: BIN/CUE → CHD (createcd)
- PS2/GameCube/Wii/Xbox: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO, RVZ, XISO
- PSP: ISO → CSO
- Universal: ZIP/7Z compression, IPS/BPS/xdelta3/DCP patching

### Downloads
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| 🪟 Windows (Portable) | `OpenROM-v3.9.8_Windows_Portable.zip` |
| 🪟 Windows (Installer) | `OpenROM-v3.9.8-Setup.exe` |
| 🐧 Linux x86_64 (AppImage) | `OpenROM-v3.9.8_Linux_x86_64.AppImage` |
| 🐧 Linux ARM64 (AppImage) | `OpenROM-v3.9.8_Linux_arm64.AppImage` |
| 🐧 Linux x86_64 (Core CLI) | `OpenROM-Core-v3.9.8_Linux_x86_64.zip` |
| 🐧 Linux ARM64 (Core CLI) | `OpenROM-Core-v3.9.8_Linux_arm64.zip` |
| 🍎 macOS Apple Silicon | `OpenROM-v3.9.8_macOS_arm64.dmg` |
| 🍎 macOS Intel | `OpenROM-v3.9.8_macOS_x86_64.dmg` |

emulators.latest_body:
**Beta 39.** O mapa e o minimapa não ficam mais escuros com a Economia de RAM ligada, chega a opção Vídeo > Sombras, e o jogo espera menos por shaders. Várias mudanças vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo e HallanBR!).

## Correções

- **Mapa e minimapa escuros com a "Economia de RAM" ligada (#471, #478):** com o zoom no mapa, ou no minimapa, a imagem ficava escura.
  - **Causa:** com a Economia de RAM, depois de enviar uma textura à GPU o app devolvia a memória dela ao Android, e essa memória passava a ler zeros. Mas o jogo às vezes cria a textura de novo sobre a mesma memória sem carregar o arquivo outra vez, e ela era enviada a partir dos zeros.
  - **Agora:** a memória vai para o swap do Android com o conteúdo guardado: a economia continua, e nada vira zero. Se você tinha o problema, conte se resolveu.
- **Frame rate 40 / 45 em telas de 120 Hz (#455):** o HyperOS deixa o jogo em 60 Hz até ele pedir mais, e o modo caía para 30. Agora o app pergunta ao Android a maior taxa que a tela oferece e pede 120 Hz. Contribuição do HallanBR.

## Novidades

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.7 (beta 39): mapa certo com a Economia de RAM, opção de sombras e menos esperas por shaders

## Correções

- **Mapa e minimapa escuros com a "Economia de RAM" ligada (#471, #478):** com o zoom no mapa, ou no minimapa, a imagem ficava escura.
  - **Causa:** com a Economia de RAM, depois de enviar uma textura à GPU o app devolvia a memória dela ao Android, e essa memória passava a ler zeros. Mas o jogo às vezes cria a textura de novo sobre a mesma memória sem carregar o arquivo outra vez, e ela era enviada a partir dos zeros.

- **Frame rate 40 / 45 em telas de 120 Hz (#455):** o HyperOS deixa o jogo em 60 Hz até ele pedir mais, e o modo caía para 30. Agora o app pergunta ao Android a maior taxa que a tela oferece e pede 120 Hz. Contribuição do HallanBR.

## Novidades

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.6 (beta 38): a água tem colisão de novo, e menos lentidão depois de carregar
releases.body:
**Beta 38.** O Link não atravessa mais a água dos rios depois de um tempo jogando, o jogo volta à velocidade normal 1 s depois de cada carregamento, e vários fechamentos foram corrigidos. Várias correções vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo!).

## Correções

- **Água sem colisão depois de um tempo (#296, #438):** depois de 30-60 min, o Link afundava nos rios e andava no fundo, com a água ainda desenhada por cima. Só reiniciar o app resolvia.
  - **Causa:** um pedaço da textura de altura da água era recriado em branco e escrito de volta por cima do que o jogo usa para a colisão.
  - **Agora:** o conteúdo é carregado antes. Correção do Propinbo (#461).
- **Lento por ~10 s depois de cada carregamento (#465):** depois de carregar o save ou de uma viagem rápida, o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) ficava desligado por 300 quadros. Em GPUs mais fracas isso eram ~12 s a 17-20 fps.
  - **Agora:** ele volta depois de 1 s. A água continua certa (era o motivo da espera longa); conferido na torre do Grande Platô.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.5 (beta 37): menos memória presa e melhorias vindas do TOTK
releases.body:
**Beta 37.** Os shaders do jogo deixam de ficar para sempre na memória, o FXAA ficou mais leve, e chegam quatro melhorias do [TOTKDroid](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid): o relógio do modo Nativo nos aparelhos MediaTek, mais dois efeitos de áudio do jogo, e texturas e vértices no modo cópia (Mali, Xclipse).

## Memória

- **Shaders liberados ao reiniciar o jogo:** cada vez que o jogo era reiniciado ou voltava à tela inicial pelo menu do app, ficavam na memória todos os shaders e pipelines já montados. Agora eles são liberados. Num teste com 16 trocas de cena, a memória terminou em 1075 MB em vez de 1646 MB.
- **Shaders sem uso liberados na Mali e nas outras GPUs não Adreno (#450):** os shaders nunca eram liberados durante o jogo (1513 vivos depois de 30 min, quando uma Mali-G720 fechou no limite de memória do Android). Agora, passados de 1000, os que ficaram 10 min (depois 3 min) sem uso são liberados e montados de novo quando o jogo voltar a usá-los. Deve reduzir os fechamentos em sessões longas na Mali, mas ainda falta confirmar num aparelho Mali: se você tinha esse problema, conte se melhorou.

## Vindo do TOTK

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus
releases.body:
# BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus

**Beta 36.** O jogo volta à velocidade normal logo depois de um menu, e a geração de quadros chega a mais GPUs Mali.

## Correções

- **Queda de fps depois de qualquer menu (#374, #439, #433):** por uns 12 s depois de fechar o menu de pausa, o inventário ou a troca de runas, o jogo ficava em 20-27 fps e depois voltava ao normal.
  - **Causa:** ao fechar o menu, o app desligava o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) por 300 quadros, como depois de uma tela de carregamento.
  - **Agora:** o menu não conta mais como saída do mundo. No POCO F7 Ultra, os trechos de 2 s abaixo de 29 fps depois dos menus caíram de 12 para 0.
- **Preso em 20 fps depois de um engasgo:** um engasgo isolado (save, menu, shaders compilando) não leva mais o jogo para 20 fps. E, se ele estiver em 20 fps, tenta voltar a 30 a cada poucos segundos, em vez de esperar o trabalho por quadro cair muito.
- **Geração de quadros: "no Lossless.dll" com o arquivo no lugar certo (#437, #385):** o Android mostra o arquivo em Download/ para o app, mas não deixa abrir sem a permissão de acesso a todos os arquivos.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.3 (beta 35): geração de quadros em telas de 120 Hz ou mais
releases.body:
**Beta 35.** A geração de quadros (LSFG) agora funciona em celulares em que o Android deixava o jogo a 60 Hz mesmo com uma tela mais rápida, como no ROG Phone 8.

## Correções

- **Geração de quadros sem efeito em telas rápidas:** com o jogo a 40–50 fps e a tela a 60 Hz, não sobrava espaço para nenhum quadro gerado, e o jogo continuava igual. Isso acontecia mesmo em telas de 120 ou 165 Hz, porque o Android deixa o jogo a 60 Hz se o app não pede outra taxa.
  - Agora, com a geração ligada, o app pede ao Android uma taxa com espaço para os quadros gerados: a taxa de quadros escolhida vezes o multiplicador (60 fps × 2 = 120 Hz). O sistema escolhe o modo mais próximo que a tela tem.
  - Se ainda assim não couber nenhum quadro, Vídeo > Geração de quadros agora diz isso, em vez de "gerando". Para abrir espaço, aumente a taxa de atualização nas configurações de tela ou do modo jogo do celular (no ROG, o Game Genie), ou baixe a Taxa de quadros.

> **Não precisa compilar o código do jogo de novo:** é só instalar por cima.

## Problemas conhecidos

- **4 GB de RAM:** perto de 20 fps no mundo, mas ainda abaixo disso na média, e o fps cai quando o aparelho esquenta.

emulators.latest_body:
**Beta 0.3.4.** Acaba a **queda de fps depois de fechar o inventário** ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)) e melhora a **geração de quadros (LSFG)**: importar o `Lossless.dll`, funcionar em mais GPUs Mali e pedir à tela a taxa de atualização que os quadros gerados precisam.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Queda depois do menu ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)):**
  - A queda de 12-14 s depois de fechar o inventário, de escolher uma arma ou de salvar não era o clock da GPU, como eu tinha dito.
  - O app desligava o "sync lag" por ~10 s sempre que o jogo saía do mundo, para proteger os carregamentos. Só que ele não distinguia um menu de uma tela de carregamento, e nesses segundos a CPU ficava esperando a GPU.

## O que mudou

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.3 (beta): FSR 1 e FXAA mais leves
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.3.** O **FSR 1** e o **FXAA** ficaram mais leves para a GPU, com a mesma imagem.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **FSR 1 (EASU) na metade do tempo:**
  - A análise de borda roda uma vez por pixel, em vez de quatro.
  - Onde não há borda, o pixel sai direto da interpolação bilinear.
  - As contas de cor usam meia precisão, que vira fp16 onde o driver aceita.
  - No POCO F7 Ultra (Adreno 830), o upscale de 1280x717 para 1920x1080 caiu de 1,00 para 0,50 ms por quadro. Não vi diferença nas bordas lado a lado.
  - Ideias do artigo "Optimizing FSR", de atyuwen, reescritas a partir do FSR 1 original.
- **FXAA ~18% mais leve:**
  - Usa meia precisão e o limiar padrão do FXAA 3.11, em vez do "ultra".
  - A busca da borda é mais curta: 5 passos em vez de 10.
  - No POCO caiu de 0,51-0,59 para 0,43-0,44 ms por quadro, sem diferença de serrilhado visível.

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.2 (beta): magenta com Economia de RAM e 2-3 fps na Mali corrigidos
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.2.** Corrige dois problemas da 0.3.1: os **quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ligada** ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)) e a **queda para 2-3 fps no mundo aberto em algumas Mali** (Dimensity 9500, [#41](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/41)).

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)):**

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.38.3
releases.body:
New in 1.38.3: Controller rework: 10 buttons per player, numbered naming and savestate fixes

- Two extra gamepad buttons per player (10 total), for pads with back paddles
  or a full face cluster.
- Buttons renamed from letters to numbers (BTN1..BTN10) in the mapping screen,
  the on-screen art and the OSD, so they no longer clash with the pad's A/B/X/Y.
- Deleting a savestate now goes through SAF, so it really disappears from
  MAME's list instead of lingering as a stale cache entry.
- Save/load state menus: every face button can name a slot, BTN1 and BTN2
  included.

NOTE: custom controller mappings reset to defaults on upgrade, since the
  added buttons shifted every stored index.

****

New in 1.38.2: Netplay menu/Lua, touch lightgun fixes, full emulation area and vector polish

Netplay
- MAME's menu and Lua plugins now work during netplay: the menu combo is
  intercepted through a side channel and stripped from the synced input.
- New "Allow Lua plugins in netplay" preference, off by default

Touch lightgun
- Aiming maps to the game screen inside the canvas instead of the whole view,
  fixing the drift towards the edges with artwork or the full emulation area.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.288) 1.37.6
releases.body:
New in 1.37.6: Added support for frame pacing and ADPF for improved performance on compatible devices. Fixes.
****
New in 1.37.5: Refactor the OSD layer.  Some bug fixes and improvements.
****
New in 1.37.4: New native system font rendering. Smarter haptics. Fixes.
**** 
New in 1.37.3: NetPlay IPv6 support — connects straight through CGNAT, ideal for playing over mobile networks (4G/5G)
****
New in 1.37.2:   SAF concurrent persistent cache with lazy loading for improved start time
****
New in 1.37.1: i18n & fixes
****

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

### Two sync modes:
- **Rollback** — save-state resimulation for near-zero input lag, ideal for fighting games and fast action titles. Boot is fully deterministic (RTC, samplerate, disk/NVRAM state pinned), so only inputs ever cross the network — nothing bulky to transfer at connect time.
- **Lockstep** — simple guaranteed sync for titles where rollback doesn't apply cleanly.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.288) 1.36.6
releases.body:
New in 1.36.6:

- Added Full-Screen Vector CRT Monitor Glow. Simulates the physical off-screen light scattering of the original arcade hardware (Starwars).
- Optimizations.

****

New in 1.36.4:

Replaced the vector CPU-generated geometric glow with a pure GPU optical post-processing pipeline (Dual-Filter Kawase 13-taps/9-taps via FBOs). This shift in vector rendering unlocks the true potential of the HDR engine. By physically scattering raw light energy rather than faking it with geometry.

****

**Core Update:**

- Updated to MAME 0.288 (For a full list of changes, visit the official MAME website).

**Major GLES Graphics Overhaul:**

Major overhaul of the MAME4droid GLES graphics pipeline, introducing a significantly improved rendering architecture for both raster and vector games.

1. Advanced Vector CRT Simulation:

    - Complete rewrite of the vector rendering engine to replicate the physical and optical properties of classic arcade CRT monitors.
    - Physically-inspired electron beam simulation with enhanced optical bloom and light diffusion effects.
    - Improved phosphor persistence, realistic color blending, and accurate crosstalk behavior.

emulators.description: 专为《魔兽世界》3.3.5a 定制的 Winlator 分支，内置触屏操作方案。
emulators.latest_body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

releases.name: WoW Mobile v0.1.1
releases.body:
First public release.

**WoW Mobile** runs World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) on Android with touch controls designed for [ConsolePortLK](https://github.com/leoaviana/ConsolePortLK). It is a single-purpose fork of [Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) (LGPL-2.1).

## Install
1. Download and sideload `wow-mobile-v0.1.1.apk` (installs alongside stock Winlator — separate app id `it.wowmobile`)
2. Put your own WoW 3.3.5a (build 12340) client folder on the phone's storage — **no game files are included**
3. Open the app → allow storage → *Select game folder* → PLAY

On first launch the app installs the bundled ConsolePortLK addons, calibrates the bindings, sets the realmlist (changeable in WoW Settings) and creates a tuned Wine container. After your first login, log out once so it can finish per-account calibration — then everything just works.

## Highlights
- One-tap play: folder validation, addon install, key bindings, realmlist and graphics config are all automatic and idempotent — an already-configured folder is never damaged

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ3
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ3** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ3 — Graphics API option, shader optimizer, crash fix, the Mali regression and the frame-drop round (same graphics)

- **New: Graphics API setting (Vulkan / OpenGL ES) — the compatibility backend.** Settings → Graphics (also per game). Vulkan remains the default: it renders and presents directly, the fastest path. The new OpenGL ES mode is for devices whose Vulkan present path is broken while offscreen Vulkan and EGL work: the final frame is drawn into a 3-image AHardwareBuffer ring (`VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer`) and a fully runtime-loaded EGL/GLES renderer (no build-time EGL dependency) presents it to the same SurfaceView — same pixels. Frames stay in the UNORM variant of the guest format so sRGB-encoded bytes reach the screen untouched. The core falls back to the Vulkan swapchain automatically when the device lacks AHardwareBuffer import, EGL fails at runtime, or after five present failures; the Vulkan path is untouched while the setting stays on Vulkan (`debug.capy.gl_back

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ2
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ2** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ2 — heavy-game crash fix, 90/120 Hz unlock, hot-pipeline compilation, deeper Snapdragon + Mali profiles (same graphics)

- **Fixed: heavy Unreal Engine titles no longer crash seconds into gameplay.** GPU-driven draw batches (DrawIndirectMulti) read their draw counts and argument buffers from game memory that the game is free to release; a read that landed on freed memory faulted inside libc and ended the session with "Unhandled host exception ... in DrawIndirectMulti". Every such guest read is now guarded: the count goes through the fault-safe reader, and the two raw copies of the guest read path run behind a fault guard that unwinds cleanly - a batch whose arguments vanished is skipped, exactly like a real GPU reading zero from an unmapped address, and the page is evicted from the thread's cache so the next read probes instead of faulting. GPU-tracker-protected pages still download and resume first; only truly unreadable memory takes the recovery. `debug.capy.guarded_reads=0` restores the raw copi

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ1
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ1** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ1 — crash fixes, import/storage fixes + much deeper GPU optimization (same graphics)

- **Fixed: the app could crash right after importing a game.** Importing the same executable twice (typically a retry after the game crashed) added two library entries with the same key, which the game grid cannot render — the app died with "Key ... was already used". Imports now run one at a time (a second pick while a multi-GB copy is still running no longer races the first), a completed import reuses the existing library entry instead of adding a twin, and the grid list itself is deduplicated as a last line of defence.

releases.name: v2.0.1
releases.body:
v2.0.1 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

A stability and hygiene patch for v2.0.0, focused on the crash and antivirus reports from the first few hours.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Stability

- Fixed a crash on Linux and macOS where the game could die suddenly during gameplay when world streaming revoked memory the renderer was reading
- Fixed distant demoted tree trunks rendering with a flat blue texture

#### Antivirus false positives

- The Windows executable and runtime DLL now carry proper version metadata, and the runtime no longer contains any ability to create executable memory (it never used it - all game code is compiled at build time); both changes target the machine-learning heuristics some antivirus engines were tripping on
- A false-positive report has been filed with Microsoft for the v2.0.0 files; if your antivirus quarantined the runtime, restore it or re-download this release

#### Diagnostics

- The game now logs its exact build version at startup, so support logs identify the build they came from

releases.name: v2.0.0 (use new v2.0.2)
releases.body:
Use the new v2.0.2 release for critical fixes.

v2.0.0 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

Skate 3 now renders natively. This release replaces the emulated Xbox 360 GPU with a new renderer built directly on Direct3D 12 and Vulkan: more than double the frame rate at around a quarter of the GPU power draw, and on macOS a jump from roughly 25 FPS to 250 FPS at 4K. The entire game renders natively at close visual parity with the console output, with a set of optional modern graphics enhancements that seek to go beyond it.

The new native renderer is early and is likely to have issues, I haven't tested the game all the way through.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Native renderer

- New native renderer on Direct3D 12 and Vulkan, enabled by default, replacing the emulated Xbox 360 GPU
- More than 2x the frame rate at about a quarter of the GPU power draw; macOS goes from ~25 FPS to ~250 FPS (at 4K render scaling, excluding the optional enhancements like PCSS shadows)

releases.name: v1.0.5

## Notes

- Implemented fixes for glitchy / crackling / crunchy audio and sound effects.
- Asynchronous shader compilation is now disabled by default on macOS to prevent glitched visual states.

releases.name: MeloCafe 1.2
releases.body:
## What's Changed
- Fix/ios motion by @jkcoxson in https://github.com/stossy11/MeloCafe/pull/6
- Updated Interpreter
- Improved Support for A9+
- Fix Vertex Buffer OOB Reads
- Improved Settings UI
- External ROM Folder support
- Improved RAM Limit Bypass (AppStore Compliance requires iOS 26+, Swap has been added for iOS 18 and below)
- Fix Auto CPU Mode
- Improve Recompiler Handling
- Add Thread QoS
- Update Worker Event Handling 

## New Contributors
* @jkcoxson made their first contribution in https://github.com/stossy11/MeloCafe/pull/6

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stossy11/MeloCafe/compare/1.1...1.2

releases.name: MeloCafe 1.1
releases.body:
# Changelog
- Updated Threaded Interpreter
- Pre-decode Interpreter Cache 
- Single Core CPU Mode options
- Guest RAM NSExtension offloading
- Experimental A9+ compatibility (mileage may vary, support for devices with A13 and below is limited)
- Move Virtual Controller to Safe Area
- Add No ROMs View
- Direct Jumping support for the JIT Recompiler
- Fix Page Fault with older GPUs
- Make Statistics Overlay Asynchronous
- Improved Cube map support (#3)
- Fix Controllers with analogue triggers triggering incorrectly
- UI bug fixes

**Make sure to assign the Universal Script in StikDebug**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stossy11/MeloCafe/compare/1.0...1.1

This is the first release of MeloCafe, there **WILL** be bugs, glitches, performance issues and unintended behavior which will get fixed in the future

Make sure to assign the Universal Script in StikDebug
