releases.name: shadps4 v0.20.0 - codename Dead Or Stephen 5 - The Comeback
releases.body:
That was close wasn't it? I know you are not used to so close releases but we have a lot of new things to demonstrate so why not? This release is following the first official stable release of shadNet 0.1.0, so we have some online playability available (yes Bloodborne fans, online Bloodborne is now officially available). There are also a tons of fixes to different areas of emu , you can check the list below. The release is dedicated to our friend Stephen, who is taking a break from shadPS4 due of his studies. Stephen if you are reading this we already miss you ;/

## Core
* cpu_patches: Apply comprehensive SSE4a CPU patches on macOS 
* Shutdown NpHandler before restarting
* cpu_patches: Enable static patching on Linux
* cpu_patches: Patch (V)RCPPS and (V)RSQRTPS on Intel
* Speed up game ID resolution
* Anchor the FPS counter at startup and refactor counter movement check
* address_space: Restore protections after splitting a mapped region on Windows
* kernel: Implement POSIX file attribute and sync APIs
* file_sys: Normalize guest paths and fix mount matching
* Do not expand host mmap range during POSIX AddressSpace::Unmap

releases.name: shadps4 v0.19.0 - codename The Shadoween special
releases.body:
Welcome back to another shadPS4 release . It is over one month since our previous release and guess what we are back again with a lot more fixes and a lot more playable games . Rapid work has been done in different areas of the emu, but i guess the glory goes to the huge amount of GPU fixes that improved so many games, some of them are really playable now . I won't steal the fun of discovering these, so here is a brief list of changes.

### Core
- Rewrote signal emulation again 
- Fixed incorrect error return on attempting to create a file in a nonexistent folder in a writable mount 
- Fix reserved region coalescing in POSIX address space code 
- Support loading entitlements from RIF licenses 
- Optimized logger by replacing hash map with table lookup and hide implementation details 
- Support loading DLC as ZAR 
- Reworked slot vector 
- Fixed sceKernelReserveVirtualRange alignment and add ClearName 

### Libraries
- Use present scheduler for blank frame prepare 
- np_auth : Change default GetAuthorizationCode returns to be valid 
- np_trophy: Fixed displaying of trophy name 
- http2 : Fixes and cleanups
- np_tss : Added TSS support

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

# Game Boy

# Emulation

## Voicer-kun
   - Play Voicer-kun enabled games by attaching the included audio CDs with the game (can be in cue/bin files format,  or .zip containing cue/bin); 
   - Voicer-kun IR peripheral is fully emulated so the games drive the CD themselves.
   - Menu placed under Sound => "Voicer-kun"
   - Only one disc can be attached in the drive at a time (EMIT requires to change CDs during the game).
   - Port 2 is forced to a joypad as attached device so that the voicer-kun device is detected.
   - IR burst looped so the learn wizard registers keys automatically, port 2 reports only the device id, not player buttons.
   - IR burst will work when selecting the game's automatic mode (not manual)
   - Supported voicer-kun games:
     - EMIT Vol. 1 (CD1, CD2)
     - EMIT Vol. 2 (CD1, CD2)
     - EMIT Vol. 3 (CD1, CD2)
     - Angelique (CD1)

## GB / GBC / SuperGameBoy
   - Optional `no-sprite-limit` for the BIOS-less GB/GBC core added to `Hacks...` window. This fixes the sprite limitation of the actual hardware.
   - `Allow Invalid VRAM Access` override for games that need it, surfaced in Win32/GTK/Qt with proper enable/gray-out handling.

# Pine Developer Diagnostics v1.3 — 开发预览

**这是诊断增强，不是 ART GC/堆损坏根因修复。** 复用已审查的 Debug APK，不重建、不重签；main 与旧预览 tag 不变。

源提交：`99115d70560c4872a094462bb179e0b772484d7f`；[草稿 PR #2](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/pull/2)。

releases.body:
This is a Diagnostics v1 developer preview, packaged as a Debug APK for owner testing.
It installs alongside Pine and the old diagnostics app as **Pine Diagnostics Preview** (`io.github.pine.emu.diagnostics.preview`),
version `2.1.2-diagnostics-v1`. Diagnostics is off by default.

The old and initial fixed CI APKs have different Debug signing certificates.
This fresh application ID avoids requiring an uninstall or clearing old data.
It does not migrate another app's private settings, files, URI grants or exit
history. Configure lawful local content in the new app; do not share keys.
Continuous in-place Debug updates still require a stable development signer.

This revision repairs the identified VMA mapped-allocation contract and safe
failure for missing/revoked SAF content, including ACTION_VIEW metadata entry.
Controlled regressions pass; restored device game startup remains unverified.

It adds bounded asynchronous JSONL/PineDiag events, actual content selection and
storage observations, guest message/DFX forwarding, developer settings, redacted
export and Windows ADB collection. Main and emulation process logs are isolated.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.4
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.4

Source revision: `c57e7f5d7608691bde97bc1c523c22ddf25604c6` (version code 7, version name `0.2.4-stable+c57e7f5`). A small update to 0.2.3.

### Fixes

- **Frame generation is smooth again when the game runs below half the screen's refresh rate.** The FPS counter used to double, but each generated frame and the real one reached the screen on back-to-back refreshes (about 8 ms apart, then a 25 ms gap), so motion looked no smoother than without frame generation. This was reported on a OnePlus 11 with BeamNG 0.34. Now the frames are shown evenly spaced, for example every 16.7 ms when 30 FPS is doubled to 60 on a 120 Hz screen. Checked for Linux games on Box64 + bionic and FEX + bionic. Windows games with frame generation go through the same code, but were not tested.
- Frame generation now caps the game's own frame rate at the screen's refresh rate divided by the multiplier (60 for 2x on a 120 Hz screen), since the extra frames could not be shown anyway.

Game profiles and the other registry files are read from the tag `v0.2.4` of the components repository (the same content as `v0.2.3`).

### Download and installation

| File | Package |
|---|---|

### Fixes

- Frame generation (Lossless Scaling) now works for Linux games on Box64 + bionic, the route BeamNG 0.34 uses. The frame generation layer was never loaded on that route, so FG had no effect.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.2
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.
  - Windows games get the driver mapped to your GPU when they start, or the system driver when none is mapped.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.
- BeamNG 0.34 now starts on Box64 + bionic without PRoot. It used to crash about a second after start with exit 134 (seen on a OnePlus 11).

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.1
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.0
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. A Box64 + bionic + no PRoot preset starts BeamNG 0.39 reliably.
- Games run directly from shared storage: FEX retries file mappings that Android's noexec storage refuses, so BeamNG no longer needs staged copies. The old staging code is removed, and its leftover files are deleted when a Linux session starts.
- Steam libraries on shared storage (`SkyNetEmu/Games`): installs work, installed games get shortcuts, and a fresh install finds games that are already downloaded there instead of offering to download them again.
- Tomb Raider (2013, 32-bit) runs from a shared-storage library on the PRoot glibc FEX.
- Android 16: FEX and the shim emulate `openat2` and `faccessat2` (BeamNG exited with SIGSYS).

emulators.latest_body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.1.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.1.0

- **Selevet support:** the emulator patcher now supports Selevet Eglantine performance build 4, including both normal and 30 FPS Windows downloads.
- **Future-build matching:** minor Selevet updates can be recognized when the reviewed loader and metadata-reader fingerprints still match. Unverified matches are labeled experimental; changed or ambiguous hooks are refused.
- **Settings preserved:** adding or removing the metadata patch keeps `nx2_switches.txt` and the existing 30 FPS setting unchanged. Exact original executable backups remain available for removal.
- **Supported-build list:** added Selevet and adjusted the patch dialog so its full compatibility list remains visible.
- **Validation:** both Selevet downloads passed byte-exact patch removal, isolated native hook checks and real startup timing comparisons. Patched startup without a companion matched the external-NPDM path at 31.25 MHz. These checks do not establish gameplay compatibility or FPS gains.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.0.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.0.0

- **New branding:** NSP Box, with redesigned icons and a new app logo.
- **Smoother UI:** subtle animated background, fluid transitions, and improved spacing.
- **NSP-only packaging:** removed XCI output from games and DLC.
- **Dedicated DLC tab:** create separate DLC NSPs for compatible emulators. Thanks [@ryzendew](https://github.com/ryzendew) for requesting separate packages in [#1](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/1).
- **Expanded patch support:** Eglantine build 98, AMD Experimental build-99, and PokeDinner 2.1.0a. Supported builds are now listed in the patch panel.
- **Fixed drag-and-drop crashes:** artwork and folder drops no longer crash the app. Thanks [@WicCaesar](https://github.com/WicCaesar) for reporting [#2](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/2).
- **Windows x64 portable release**, with source code included as a separate download.
- **Existing game packages don't need rebuilding** to use the expanded emulator patch support.

**Experimental build — limited real-world testing.** Emulator and DLC compatibility varies. Supported patched emulators can load packages without an external `main.npdm`.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0

- **New Emulator patch panel:** select a Windows x64 emulator folder, check compatibility, add the patch and remove it later. Eglantine build 96 standard/PGO and PokeDinner 2.0.0 GUI/CLI profiles are recognized; matching future builds and forks can be tried experimentally without a new menu entry.
- **No separate `main.npdm` needed after patching:** compatible emulators read Switch 2 metadata already embedded inside this packager's plaintext XCI/NSP. Restart the emulator after applying the patch. Existing packages do not need rebuilding, and the packager need not remain open while playing.
- To create only a single XCI/NSP, uncheck **Create package folder**. The option remains on by default for unpatched emulators; without the patch, retain each game's exact external companion in its own folder. Selecting 12 GiB alone can still use incorrect timing and reduce performance.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4

- Add the reported performance drop without an external `main.npdm` to the startup caution, Notes & compatibility, README and release notes.
- Recommend keeping **Create package folder** enabled and retaining its companion beside the game. The performance observation is user-reported, not a controlled benchmark.
- Refresh remembered-caution preferences so the new warning is shown after an older notice was dismissed.
- Retain the 12 GiB guidance, default-on package-folder option and single-file output when unchecked. Packaging behavior is unchanged from 1.4.3.

## What's new since beta 9

A beta about how the game feels and how the top screen behaves at scene changes.

- **Snappier controls.** Button presses and the stick reach the game sooner, and Roxas turns more smoothly (the PC port's newest input work, brought over). On the Thor, the time from pushing the stick to Roxas moving went from about 68 ms to about 29 ms.
- **The visions of Sora show their static on the lower screen only**, as on the DS. With two screens it flickered on the top screen too.
- **A widescreen top screen keeps its picture at camera cuts and crossfades.** It could flash an empty 4:3 room or black bars for a few frames.

releases.body:
Ninth beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

Coming from an earlier beta? The game offers this update itself on the title screen, or install the APK below by hand; your game, HD files and saves are kept.

## What's new since beta 8

A beta about speed at high resolutions, mostly for the Thor.

- **The HUD, menus and text are drawn much faster at 3x and above.** They were worked out again at every pixel of the picture; now only where something finer than a DS pixel is drawn. The picture is the same. On the Thor in the Grey Area at 4x: two screens went from about 69 to 94 frames a second, and one screen runs at about 92.
- **Each screen has its own resolution: Settings > Video > Upper screen and Lower screen.** The upper screen's setting covers its 3D and its HUD together. The lower screen at 2x costs far less and leaves the upper screen at full detail.
- **The Thor now starts at upper 4x, lower 2x** (it started at 2x). If you had chosen your own resolution, it is kept.

A small beta of fixes, mostly for two screens (the Thor).

- **Two screens: the visions of Sora no longer flicker.** During a vision the other screen dropped to the DS's small picture every few frames, and the flickering could go on afterwards until you switched to one screen and back. Seen fixed on the vision at the Coliseum's Games; if another vision still flickers, please say which mission.
- **Two screens at 120 Hz: the KH2 lock-on mark, the heart counter with its CHAIN and the prize drops no longer flicker.** They were missing from about half the pictures.
- **A setting changed with the settings menu still open is kept** when the game is put away and closed by Android. It was only written when the menu was left.

What's new:

## 🖥️ X++

\- Added **X++**, a native X server in C++ with asynchronous presentation for Android
\- X++ is now the default. The Java backend remains available as **X11**.
\- Reduced repeated scene work and improved Support for OpenGL, offscreen windows, XInput, and ARGB cursor handling.

## 🎮 Steam Integration

\- Added Steam support, downloads, library, online, Cloud saves.
\- Added friends, chat and achievement features
\- Improved offline setup, play your steam games offline without steam client
\- steam can be disabled in store settings.

## 💻 DisplayX

\- Rewrote Backend, updated transport, buffer completion and presentation scheduling.
\- Added SDR/HDR Support for compatible games/devices.

## 🎞️ Frame Generation

\- Added **LSFG**, adapted from Eden, and optional **WFG** (Winlator Frame Gen).
\- Added engine selection, quality and multiplier controls, adaptive pacing and refresh-rate limits.
\- WFG supports Vulkan 1.1 and direct output where supported, with a fallback path.
\- LSFG may need Turnip driver on renderer selection on A6xx devices.
\- Frame generation requires the Vulkan renderer. Compatibility and performance depend on the GPU, driver and game.

releases.name: Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.6
releases.body:
# Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.6

What's new since 1.9.8.4.

## Picture fixes
- **Smeared picture fixed (two causes):**
  - After a load, the game sometimes rewrote a command buffer it had already handed to the GPU. The picture then stayed broken or smeared until the game was restarted. Every submitted command buffer is now copied first (`BB_COPY_GPU_BUFFERS=0` turns this off). The same cause was behind "Unimplemented PM4 type 0" and "PM4 header ... rest of the buffer dropped" in logs.
  - After a start with an empty shader cache, one saved pipeline could be lost for the whole next session. The game's motion blur then kept blurring the last frame, so the picture looked smeared and frozen from the first camera turn on.
- Rainbow tiles on hit enemies and a light line along the top in cutscenes are fixed.

Seamless co-op is BBSC by CLSAMG22. The source of this release's bb-probe-seamless (GPL) is `bb-probe-seamless-1.9.8.4-source.zip` (unchanged since 1.9.8.3).

releases.name: Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.3
releases.body:
## Online
- **Russia route** (Online page, SuperMedo Server): for players whose network in Russia cannot reach the SuperMedo server. The game and the launcher connect through a relay to the same server and the same players. Leave it off if online already works for you.

## Seamless co-op
- Your own world's progress stays yours: after helping in another hunter's world, your world came back with their world's state (bosses, doors, Chalice items they did not have). The host's world written into the guest is no longer kept as the guest's own progress.
- The Bath Messengers in the Hunter's Dream talk again in seamless co-op.

Seamless co-op is BBSC by CLSAMG22. The source of this release's bb-probe-seamless (GPL) is `bb-probe-seamless-1.9.8.3-source.zip`.

releases.name: suyu v0.1.4
releases.body:
# suyu v14.1.0

This minor update fixes two graphics compatibility problems while retaining the
safer defaults introduced in v14.0.1.

## Graphics corrections

- Fixed corrupted NVIDIA rendering with graphics pipeline libraries enabled.
  Fragment-output libraries now retain the full pipeline state when cached.
- Fixed stretched character geometry in Tears of the Kingdom on macOS MoltenVK.
  Packed vertex weights use a supported three-component format when the unused
  fourth component would cross the vertex stride.

Graphics pipeline libraries, Fast GPU Time, async shader building and SPIR-V
optimization remain off by default. Explicit user settings are preserved.

**Re-export existing Static and Hybrid packages** to receive the corrected host.
Translated game code remains part of those exports; official downloads contain
no games, keys or firmware.

## Tested scope

MK8D 4.0.0 and TOTK 1.4.3 native Static opening replays completed on Linux
RTX 3090 (NVIDIA 580.159.03), Windows Radeon RX 9070 XT and macOS Apple M5.
The 6,001-frame MK8D and 12,001-frame TOTK checks used default settings and
optional pipeline-library/Fast GPU settings. All Static cases exited normally

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta

Swap2-Native now speaks the Switch 2's 16 languages, works with a controller from the library to the in-game panel, has a redesigned in-game panel, and offers a frame rate cap in every game.

**Install over 0.1.9.1-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **The app in 16 languages.** Every menu, dialog and the in-game panel follow your phone's language: English (US and UK), Japanese, French (France and Canada), German, Italian, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). To use another one, pick it in **Settings › Interface › App language** (or in Android's own app language setting).
- **Controller navigation.** In the library, with a game selected: **A** plays it, **Y** opens its Game settings, **L / R** switch tabs. Buttons follow the Nintendo layout (A right, B bottom) by default; **Settings › Interface** keeps the Xbox layout if you prefer it.

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.9.1-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.1-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time can run at 30 fps in its heaviest scenes, and every game can be played in your language.

**Install over 0.1.8.9-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **Mesh geometry** (Game settings › Graphics, and the in-game panel, where it applies at once). Turned off, the game's mesh-drawn geometry is not drawn: in Zelda that is much of the foliage, the falling leaves and some objects. The scene gets much lighter: at Link's porch in Kokiri Forest on our POCO F7 Ultra the GPU went from 38-40 ms to about 30 ms a frame.
- **Game language** (Game settings). The language the game gets from the system: the default (English, US, as before), your phone's language, or any of the 16 Switch languages. A game shows it where it has that language. It applies the next time the game starts.

## Faster

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.9-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.9-beta

The frame rate cap of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can be chosen again, so the game keeps real time.

**Install over 0.1.8.8-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## Fixed

- **Zelda's frame rate cap was greyed out.** Its Game settings and the in-game panel said the game picks its own frame rate and offered no cap. A Zelda left at "The game's own" then moved forward 1/30 of a second each frame, so below 30 fps it ran in slow motion (about 0.7 of real time at 21 fps on our POCO F7 Ultra).
  - The cap now offers **30 fps** and **60 fps** for Zelda again, in its Game settings and in the in-game panel. Pick 30 fps (the default) to keep real time; 0.1.8.8-beta's fix makes it hold down to 20 fps.
  - Switching back to "The game's own" while the game runs now takes effect at once.
- If Zelda still runs slowly after updating, open Zelda once: the app then sees the new cap choices. Then set **Frame rate cap** to **30 fps** or **Default** in Zelda's Game settings.

## If your game stops

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time no longer runs in slow motion where the phone cannot hold 30 fps.

**Install over 0.1.8.7-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change: if you already updated them for 0.1.8.7-beta, nothing is translated again.

## Fixed

- **Slow motion below 30 fps with the 30 fps cap.** Where the phone drew fewer than 30 frames a second, each frame still moved the game forward by only 1/30 of a second, so the game ran slower than real time. It now moves the game forward by 1/20 of a second there, and the game keeps real time.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: before, about 22 fps at three quarters of real time; now a steady 20 fps at real time, with fewer stutters. By Mido: 30 fps, as before.
  - The 60 fps setting and the uncapped setting are unchanged.

## Tips

- **Frame generation** (Settings › Performance, with your own Lossless.dll) works well with the 30 fps cap on the POCO F7 Ultra: it costs about half a frame a second by the scarecrow and shows twice the frames on screen.

## If your game stops

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time runs faster where there is a lot of grass and foliage, and the app uses less memory in a few places.

**Install over 0.1.8.6-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept.

**Zelda's shaders are updated once after installing.** Only the 500 shaders of grass and foliage change. The app starts the update by itself when you open Zelda and does it in the background: about 30 minutes on our POCO F7 Ultra (most of it reading the game's shaders again). You can play during the update with the old shaders; the gain below comes once it finishes. Keep the phone charging.

## Faster

- **Grass and foliage in Zelda: Ocarina of Time.** The game draws them with mesh shaders, which phones run through compute. Those computes kept every output in a slow on-chip copy, and the GPU could keep only a few of them busy at once. They now write their outputs straight to memory.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: about 18.6 fps before, 22.8 now. By Mido: 34 fps before, 41.9 now. The picture is the same.

Adds ShizukuPlus compatibility to Aether while retaining stock Shizuku support.

- Discovers supported managers in the current Android user and verifies Binder callbacks against the manager UID.

Updates the Android app and coordinated Aether suite to 1000.0.1 while preserving existing application IDs, signing identity, guest data and configuration.

- Adds immediate Gboard dictation insertion, Ctrl-tap handling for wrapped URLs, one-line selection copying, and a wider drawer gesture area.

- Includes persistent Arch launcher defaults and the updated API companion. The suite reuses the unchanged Exec 1000.0.0 package.

Download the Pacman suite and matching checksum for the coordinated upgrade. The APKs, matching Aether source archive, installer, component provenance and checksums are also included.

releases.name: Termux-Aether 1000.0.0
releases.body:
## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. No wildcard overwrite or editing of checksum-protected scripts is needed. Use `aether-update` for later protected upgrades, or install new suite packages with `pacman -U` directly.

However, its current notification implementation is buggy, and a notification sent from one session is duplicated by every other running opencode session. emulators.latest_body:
## 中文

本期新增 termux-ui 模块，为 Windows 应用、Linux 桌面、文件和运行组件提供统一图形界面。

- Windows 应用与游戏：通过独立的 Wine 环境导入、配置、管理和运行程序。
- Linux 桌面：创建、启动、管理和重新安装 Native 与 PRoot 桌面环境。
- 运行组件：下载和管理 Wine、Box64、图形及配套组件，支持自定义 Wine 和 Box64 版本。
- 文件管理：浏览文件、批量操作、查看文件信息，并将检测到的 Windows 程序导入程序库。
- 输入与显示：按程序配置显示设置、键盘鼠标输入、虚拟按键和游戏手柄。
- 备份与恢复：导出和恢复 PRoot 桌面容器、Wine 环境及 Wine C 盘。

## English

Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Windows apps and games: import, configure, manage, and launch programs with dedicated Wine environments.
- Linux desktops: create, launch, manage, and reinstall Native and PRoot desktop environments.
- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.
- File management: browse files, perform batch operations, view file details, and import detected Windows programs.
- Input and display: configure per-program display settings, keyboard and mouse input, virtual controls, and game controllers.
- Backup and recovery: export and restore PRoot desktop containers, Wine environments, and Wine C drives.

releases.name: Version 5.10.2
releases.body:
Changes:

- Fix authentication for registries without token service: Nexus, Artifactory and htpasswd-protected servers.
- Report bad `PD_DOCKER_AUTH` credentials before initiating install or push session.

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

## BannerHub Lite v1.0.1

First stable on the BannerHub API.

> ⚠️ **URGENT — read before first launch.** If you see **"Failed to initialize the simulator"** when launching a game, your firmware is still on the old version. Open **Settings → Components → Firmware** and **manually update / install firmware 1.3.7**, then launch the game again. The auto-update prompt may not fire on every install, so do this manually if the error appears.

### Known issues

- **Proton 11 hangs on "Initializing…" when launching Steam games with a Steam client.** The launch never proceeds past the initializing screen. Workaround: use a different Wine/Proton component for Steam-client launches until this is resolved.

### What changed since v1.0.0

- **BannerHub API switch** — all 9 variants now point at `https://bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev/` instead of the EmuReady worker. Components, firmware, and the in-app catalog are all served from the BannerHub Components release on this org.
- **Firmware bumped to 1.3.7** — the in-app firmware update prompt will offer `imagefs_137.zst` (171.9 MB). 5.x clients (BHL) and 6.0 clients (BannerHub 3.7.x) now receive the same firmware.

emulators.latest_body:
# NgpCraft Emulator v3.15 - what's new

This release is mostly about the built-in BIOS, the one the emulator uses when you have no
`bios.bin` (and the one the web player always uses). It now behaves much more like the real
console BIOS. macOS users also get proper app packaging and Finder support.

## Built-in BIOS: much closer to the real one

Many thanks to **Napomex**, who compared our built-in BIOS with the real one game by game and sent
us a detailed report with a fix for each problem. This work started from that report.

We then ran 123 cartridges for one minute each, with button presses, under both the real BIOS and
the built-in one, and compared every frame. About 70% of them now play frame for frame like they
do with the real BIOS, up from about 25%.

# NgpCraft Emulator v3.15 - what's new

This release is mostly about the built-in BIOS, the one the emulator uses when you have no
`bios.bin` (and the one the web player always uses). It now behaves much more like the real
console BIOS. macOS users also get proper app packaging and Finder support.

## Built-in BIOS: much closer to the real one

Many thanks to **Napomex**, who compared our built-in BIOS with the real one game by game and sent
us a detailed report with a fix for each problem. This work started from that report.

# NgpCraft Emulator v3.12 - what's new

New features, netplay fix attempt. **If you play mirror matches online,
both players must update**: this version cannot play a mirror match with 3.9.1 or older.

## New features

- **Updates from inside the emulator.** *Settings ▸ General ▸ Check for updates* tells you if a
  newer version is out. On Windows and Linux, *Install and restart* downloads it, installs it and
  starts it: no more trip to the GitHub page. On macOS the button opens the download page. The
  emulator also checks by itself at startup, at most once a day, and never interrupts a game
  (untick *Check for updates at startup* if you would rather it did not). Your saves, settings and
  library are kept: only the program file is replaced. **This is the last version you need to
  download by hand.**
- **Run-ahead (optional, off by default).** *Settings ▸ General ▸ Run-ahead*: shows the picture the
  game will draw 1 or 2 frames from now, with the buttons you are holding, so the delay built into
  the game itself disappears from the screen. In *Sonic*, a jump now shows up 4 frames after the

releases.name: v3.9.1
releases.body:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tixul/Ngpcraft_emulator/compare/v3.8.9...v3.9.1

NgpCraft Emulator v3.9.0 - what's new
This release is about playing two players over the internet. It is still being tested, but the
first results are encouraging. If you play online, both of you should update, and please tell us
how it goes.

Online play in mirror mode should be smoother
Less input lag at the start of a match. The player who finished loading first used to start alone and wait for the other one. That wait made the emulator think the connection was slower than it really was, and it could add noticeable delay to that player's controls for several minutes. Both sides now start together. This idea comes from Blueteemo, who proposed it in pull request #26. Thank you!
Fewer freezes on a connection that loses packets. Your button presses are now also sent a second way, repeated several times, so a single lost packet should no longer freeze both screens. In our tests on a deliberately bad connection, most of the short freezes went away.
If the other player has an older version, the match should still work, just without these improvements.

releases.name: v0.2.1: All treat, no trick! 🎃
releases.body:
Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a new release, two months after the previous one. 

Before I get to the changelog, some special notes:

- From this release onwards, the old list of supported apps is replaced by the new, crowdsourced [touchHLE app compatibility database](https://appdb.touchhle.org/).
- In case you missed it, the [touchHLE app archive](https://touchhle.org/app-archive/) was recently launched. It only has one app at the moment, but that's hopefully just the start. If you were an indie developer in the early iPhone days, please get in touch!
- If you want to get notified about future releases, you might want to join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sVMXc8z3eS). You can't post there, but you'll be @'d with updates. There's also a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@touchHLE) where I post short gameplay videos with new releases.
- If you want to help me keep working on this full time, please consider [supporting me financially](https://liberapay.com/hikari_no_yume).

Finally, a big thanks to all the other contributors who made this release what it was! If it weren't for them, there might not have been any new game support in this release.

releases.name: v0.2.0: touchHLE on Android!
releases.body:
At long last, it's here: the first release to work on Android, the first release with an app picker UI, the first release with (very limited) UIKit support, and much more!

This release required a lot of effort, and not just from me! I want to especially thank @ciciplusplus, who dared to try to port touchHLE to Android and somehow succeeded. I also want to thank @KiritoDv and @LennyKappa, who also made big contributions to this release.

Thank you all for your continued patience and support. I hope you enjoy!

~ hikari

[Update 2023-09-01: When the release was tagged and uploaded yesterday, two changelog entries were mistakenly in the v0.1.2 section rather than v0.2.0. The copies of the changelog below and in the release zip files have now been corrected. Additionally, the `OPTIONS_HELP.txt` file was mistakenly absent from the Android release zip file, but it has now been added.]

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body:
The first release of Odin.

Odin (ᚨ) is a low-level emulator of the SEGA Hikaru arcade board. It runs the programs of the real chips wherever they are known, and draws with OpenGL or Vulkan. It is a hard fork of Valkyrie, by Stefano Teso.

## Games

All six Hikaru games, two of them in two versions:

- Air Trix (`airtrix`, `airtrixo`)
- Brave Firefighters (`braveff`)
- Planet Harriers (`pharrier`)
- NASCAR Arcade (`sgnascar`, `sgnascaro`)
- Star Wars Racer Arcade (`swracer`)
- Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force (`von4`)

They play with a keyboard, mice, gamepads, wheels with force feedback (NASCAR) or light guns (Brave Firefighters). Each game is a MAME ROM and needs the BIOS `hikaru.zip` and `mie.zip` too.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| odin-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip | Windows 10 or 11 |
| odin-x86_64.AppImage / odin-v0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | Linux PC with glibc 2.38 or later (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04) |
| odin-aarch64.AppImage / odin-v0.1.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz | Linux ARM64 with glibc 2.38 or later and OpenGL ES 3.1 |
| odin-macos.dmg | Mac with Apple silicon, macOS 13.3 or later |
| Odin-Artwork.zip | The title screens and bezels of the games |

## Changes

- On Windows, store settings in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coffee GB\coffeegb.properties`. Existing settings are imported from the user profile without changing the old file.
- Add `--portable` to keep settings beside the JAR or an unpacked application launcher. The application directory must be writable; saves and other application data retain their existing locations. The single-file Windows EXE extracts to a temporary directory, so use the JAR or an unpacked application image for persistent portable settings.

## Known platform limitations

- On macOS, game controllers require a compatible system SDL2 installation. Keyboard input and emulation remain usable without it.

## Merged pull requests

- [#697: Move Windows settings to LocalAppData and add portable mode](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/697) by [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek).

- [#691 Add Android pressed control artwork and touch feedback](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/691) — show held buttons and directions in the Android touch controls. [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek)
- [#693 Fix Renju Club link startup](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/693) — start two-player sessions with both cable endpoints attached so the game can negotiate its link. [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek)

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.6
releases.body:
Coffee GB 2.1.6 adds BESS save-state interchange, expands Game Boy peripheral support, and brings connection choices and device controls together in the desktop menu.

## Changes

- Load and save BESS-compatible states from the File menu, with validated ROM matching and interchange for supported DMG, CGB, and SGB configurations.
- Use HuC-1/HuC-3 cartridge infrared and send or receive GBKiss GBF files.
- Scan EAN-13 barcodes with the separate Barcode Taisen Bardigun reader.
- Run Pocket Sonar with MBC1S sensor emulation and simulated sonar input. Scene changes now end active input recording, and the mapper is included in state coverage checks.
- Use Turbo File GB internal memory and removable cards, including import/export, persistence, and write protection. The GBA-only Advance choice is no longer exposed in the menu; legacy state and storage support is retained.
- Emulate Singer and Jaguar sewing machines, including the JN-2000 embroidery arm, live stitch preview, and PNG export.
- Organize Peripherals into Link port, Cartridge, and Infrared. Device submenus combine Connect with their controls; Mobile Adapter configuration moves from Preferences into its device submenu.

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.5
releases.body:
This release fixes Razor Freestyle Scooter multiplayer startup and race disconnects, and keeps netplay input logs available only as an internal diagnostic feature.

- Starting netplay in Razor now lets the host coordinate a fresh boot of both games with the link connected. The reboot explicitly bypasses autosave loading on both machines.
- Opposing directional inputs are resolved consistently, preventing the race disconnect reproduced from a supplied input log.
- Netplay diagnostic logs capture every player's input and rollback timing. They are hidden and disabled by default; developers can opt in with `-Dcoffeegb.netplay.inputRecording=true`. Ordinary input recording and playback are unchanged.

## Merged pull requests

- [#673](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/673) — Fix Razor netplay startup and race disconnects, by @trekawek.
- [#678](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/678) — Hide netplay input diagnostics behind an opt-in flag, by @trekawek.

releases.name: v2.0.0
releases.body:
Dusklight 2.0 is here! This update brings **mod support**, **an in-game mod browser**, and **our own built-in randomizer**, alongside more polish, performance improvements, and ways to play. Thank you to everyone who helped make it happen!

## Mods and built-in mods

- **Added:** Mod support! Install gameplay mods, asset replacements, and texture packs as `.dusk` bundles, and manage them from the Mods menu. (Modders: check out our [modding documentation](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/blob/main/docs/modding.md)!)
- **Added:** An in-game mod browser: search for mods, view information and screenshots, and download and install without leaving Dusklight.
- **Added:** Mod update checks, release notes, and a quick way to update all mods.
- **Added:** Drag and drop `.dusk` mods onto the Dusklight window to install them.
- **Added:** Enable, disable, and reload mods in-game, with dependency handling and per-mod settings and logs.
- **Added:** Built-in Dusklight Randomizer, our own randomizer with seed generation, settings presets, shareable
  permalinks, and more.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.5 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.5 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's spider rooms run at full speed (chapter 7 ran at 10-15 FPS on the Retroid Pocket G2), a rare hang or crash of Uncharted 3 is fixed, and the app now says what is wrong with a copy of the game instead of crashing or stalling without a word. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: the rooms with the spider swarm ran at 10-15 FPS** - chapter 7, "Stay in the Light", and the swarm's return in chapter 11; on the Retroid Pocket G2 at 1280x720 the room now holds the 30 FPS limit (15.0 and 13.2 FPS before, 30.0 and 30.0 after, in two pairs of runs). One pixel shader of the swarm's material picks values from a small table by an index. The translated shader chose among all 84 of its registers at each of twelve such reads, more than the shader compiler of an Adreno has registers for, so it kept values in memory: 52 ms of GPU time a frame for a small part of the screen. The reads are now limited to the table (0.5 ms a frame); the picture is the same

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.4 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.4 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's desert chapters are drawn right - Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were stretched across the screen, on every device. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were drawn as stretched triangles** (#35). The port runs the game's many small skinning jobs in batches, and that code knew one vertex layout for each of the game's skinning shaders. From chapter 16 on the game has a second one (32-bit normals and tangents) for the models with cloth or morph targets - Drake's desert outfit, the horses' blankets and reins - and the batch wrote those vertices at the wrong places. It reads the layout of every job now and batches both; a layout it does not know goes the ordinary way and is named in the log. Thanks to @sergeymetallic, who traced the glitch to the batch, and to @tranhuythang1704 for the save the horses were checke

releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.3 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: the games' translated code is kept between runs, so a start and a loading no longer translate it again, and Uncharted 2 no longer crashes after some chapters are started from Chapter Select. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**New**
- **The games' translated code is kept between runs.** The games' x86 code is translated for the device's ARM processor while they run, and until now every start did that again: about 1.4 s of processor time in Uncharted 3 on the Retroid Pocket G2, most of it in the first seconds and when a level loads. The port now keeps the translated code in a file per game (about 130 MB for the three games and the collection's menu, in the app's own storage, removed with the app). The first run after this update plays as before and writes the files in the background; from the next run on that work is about 0.13 s instead of 1.4 s in Uncharted 3, and the longest frame while an Uncharted 2 level starts went from 0.27 s to 0.09 s. **New**

While the window is open, pressed buttons light up and the sticks move, to check the result; **Reset** removes the setup. emulators.latest_body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.1 [REVOKED]
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> This APK has been withdrawn. Install [version 0.5.2](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/releases/tag/v0.5.2) instead.

Version 0.5.1 unintentionally shipped with always-on GPU performance instrumentation that added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead. Its APK asset was removed to prevent further installations.

All legitimate 0.5.1 changes and its full changelog are preserved in the 0.5.2 release and in `CHANGELOG.md`. The tag and this release page remain available for project history.

emulators.latest_body:
Vita3K Android release 12 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- SD card support: Allow any folder to be specified as the OS/game data folder (inspired by the PR from nurunuruslime)
- Allow the overlay to be used at the same time as the touchscreen
- Fix black bands appearing sometimes at the top and bottom of the application on some devices
- Fix bug causing game installation to be 10x slower than expected
- Fix accelerometer and gyroscope on android game consoles
- Some crash fixes
- Add controller opacity (dima)



Rebase on PC version:
- Fix audio regression (bookmist)
- Code cleanup, refractoring and small optimisations (bookmist, Nishinji and GermanAizek)
- Improved error messages (croden)
- GUI improvements (Zangetsu)
- Improve depth-stencil retrieval, fix Ratchet and Clank (Macdu)
- Add support for module unloading/reloading, allows FFX to be playable (Macdu)
- Improve ffmpeg dependency (KhoraLee)
- Improve Transfer downscale/copy, fix graphical issues in Phantasy Star Nova (Macdu)
- Improve Polish localization (mavethee)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 11
releases.body:
Vita3K Android release 11 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- Revert part of the shader optimisations from the last release (because of turnip driver bugs...)
- Fix some issues with the handling of MSAA 2x, fix graphical issues (partial blur) in some Nihon Falcon games
- Allow custom drivers and renderer to be set differently for each game
- Fix some crashes when installing games / custom drivers
- Use a static version of ffmpeg now that the Android version is open source

Rebase on PC version:
- Implement fractional upscaling, allows game to render at 1.25x, 1.5x (or 0.5x) the original resolution (Macdu)
- Add a FPS hack option which allows some games running at 30 FPS on the PS Vita to run at 60 fps on the emulator (Ys 8, GoW, Uncharted...) (Macdu)
- Language updates (Corden, nishinji)
- Multiple fixes (bookmist)
- Use hardware accelerated decryption: speed up game installation by almost 10x (Macdu)
- Improve depth/stencil identification: Fix shadows in Gravity Rush (Macdu)
- Use paths instead of wide strings for paths (bookmist)
- Improve path support on Linux (Steveice10)
- Put audio parameters in a new audio tab (Zangetsu)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 10
releases.body:
Android v10 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Fix crash on Android 14 (thanks to Kazuki/Adrien for their help)
- Graphical fixes for double buffer (fix the rendering in Terraria)
- Fix some io-related Android specific crashes
- Implement asynchronous shader compilation: reduces significantly stutter caused by shader compilation (at the cost of temporary graphical glitches) and speed up by 2x-3x shader compilation time
- Shader performance improvements
- Fix some performance regressions from v9

PC rebase:

- Use guest pointer for the gxm alloc space, allows FIFA to go ingame with native buffer / page table (Macdu)
- gxm and renderer refractoring (bookmist)
- Improce codec/renderer YUV support, fixes the FMV in Ys origin (Macdu)
- Plenty of shader fixes: Fix graphical issues in 2D ubisoft games (child of light, Rayman) (Macdu)
- Fix kernel thread end callback, allows Tearaway to go ingame (Macdu)
- Page align the stack top, allows spiderman to go ingame (Macdu)
- Decrease the rendertarget size, allows Killzone to go ingame (Macdu)
- Update Indonesia/Malaysia translation (Croden, kitakata, darkhash)
- Update Japanese translation (nishinji)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 9
releases.body:
Android v9 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Improvements to double buffer: Fix graphics in games like J-Star victory, Gravity Rush...
- Overlay joystick improvements: You can now run diagonally
- Touchscreen fixes: Fix regressions and touchscreen issues
- Overlay improvements: Should use a lot less GPU power
- Overlay: The overlay button size can now be modified
- App pausing: Re-enabled and no longer freezes the application
- Fix gxm alignment issues: Fix regressions in Tokyo Xanadu, Trails of Cold Steel 2
- Texture replacement support: Support png, uncompressed textures, BCn compressed textures (Snapdragon only), ASTC compressed textures (any phone). Textures have to be manually places in /Android/data/org.vita3k.emulator/files/textures/import/game_id


PC Rebase:
- Kitakata/Zangetsu: Add Indonesian and Malaysian languages
- ExtremeExploit: Use curl for http request, should fix issues preventing the compatibility database to be updated
- redpolline: Refractor the filesystem architecture (not relevant for Android but still a lot of work)
- Macdu: Improvements and fixes to the ngs player, fix the Audio in Borderlands 2, Mickey Power of 2, Valhalla Knights 3

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 8
releases.body:
Android V8 Changelog:

- Implement motion sensor: If you have a connected controller which has motion sensors, these will be used. Otherwise your device motion sensors will be used
- Add renderer accuracy option
- Add an option to create a shortcut for each game. The shortcut will be added to your home screen and use the game name and icons.
- Make sure clang does not optimize function calls it thinks are useless (fixes fmv flickering)
- Improve memory trapping (fixes freezes when using double buffer)
- Memory mapping can now be configured for each game (and can be modified before starting a game without rebooting)
- Rewrite the texture cache architecture, should fix games becoming slower over time
- Update to NDK 26
- Update SDL to 2.28.3 (improve controller support)
- Multiple performance improvements (using faster data structures and less mutex locking)

PC rebase (non exhaustive list):

- Zangetsu: Add support for controller touchpad (PS4/PS5 controller), not tested on Android
- Croden, HuanJiCanShang: Translation improvements
- Scribam: Code cleanup and update dependencies

# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc4 Local DS multiplayer comes to Android in this release. Open a room over Wi-Fi Direct to race with friends, battle another trainer, or draw and send notes in PictoChat. WatermelonDS and SeedlessDS players can share a room. Four handhelds, one copy of Mario Kart DS. Each view is from the same Download Play race on Cheep Cheep Beach.

## Set up your first multiplayer room ### 1. Make your player card Open **Multiplayer** from the library. Tap your name in the upper right or press **Select** to open **DS profile**.

Choose your nickname, message, birthday, favorite color, and symbol. The card previews your choices as you edit. Choose **Save** to use them in your next room. The DS menu and PictoChat use the name saved in your DS firmware.

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc3
releases.body:
# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc3 is here!!!

This release brings a large collection of game compatibility and graphics fixes, more flexible controls, audio improvements, and easier management of save states and DSi configurations. Highlights include **optional Vulkan low-latency mode**, **independent A/B/X/Y touch controls**, **DSi profiles**, **improved save-state access**, and the new WatermelonDS icon!

--- ## Controls and Gameplay ### Optional Vulkan low-latency mode A new optional Vulkan mode improves touch responsiveness, including in affected gameplay scenarios in **The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass**. This can make touch-driven gameplay feel more responsive, but enabling it may reduce smoothness in demanding games. **It is disabled by default.** ### Multitouch fixes

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2: Vulkan, Audio and Library Stability Update!
releases.body:
# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2 is here!!!

This release focuses on smoother high-resolution Vulkan performance, audio and graphics fixes reported by the community, and quality-of-life improvements for libraries, saves, and RetroAchievements. --- ## Vulkan performance improvements Vulkan has received major performance and stability improvements in this release. Repeated calculations and redundant reads were reduced, and rendering work is now grouped more efficiently. These improvements benefit different internal resolutions and are not exclusive to a single chipset or device family. Tested results include: | Device / SoC | Internal Resolution | Result in tested sections | |---|---:|---| | T820 | **6x** | Close to **60 FPS** in the tested sections of Spirit Tracks, Phantom Hourglass, and Dragon Ball Origins. Smoothness was also confirmed in user testing. | | Snapdragon 865 | **8x** | Close to **60 FPS**. Spirit Tracks and the reviewed sections of Golden Sun now hold pacing better, with both technical and user validation. |

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.7.0 is finally here!
releases.body: ## This is a very special release. After several release candidates under the **melonDualDS** name, the project is now officially renamed to: # WatermelonDS This is the final **0.7.0** release and the first public release with the new WatermelonDS identity. WatermelonDS keeps the same goal as before: providing a powerful Nintendo DS emulator experience on Android, with modern Android features, RetroAchievements support, Vulkan rendering, shader support, and a lot of customization.

releases.name: melonDualDS 0.7.0 RC5: RetroAchievements Stability Update!
releases.body:
# Next release will be WatermelonDS!

This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options.

This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name.

The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases.

However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible.

For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

# Minimum System Requirements for Winlator WB64:
- __OS (Operating System):__ Android 7.0 or later
- __Processor/CPU (Central Processing Unit):__ Qualcomm Snapdragon 460 or higher
- __GPU (Graphics Processing Unit):__ Adreno 610 or higher 
- __Graphics API:__ Vulkan 1.1 or higher
- __Internal Storage:__ At least 2GB of free space
- __RAM (Random Access Memory):__ At least 1GB of free RAM available, depending on the game requirments
- __Root Access:__ Not required
- __Gamepad:__ Optional (xinput/xbox recommended)


__NOTE: Recommended for game titles released before 2013 or DX9-based, Some games especially those from 2013 onwards, may experience performance issues.__
__Results can vary based on the device used, environmental conditions, and other factors, such as simultaneous processing, and different processor capabilities.__

__Please be careful when downloading from other websites. We recommend downloading only from this GitHub repository or official.__

✅ __[WINLATOR.ORG](https://winlator.org) is the original site.__

releases.name: Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0
releases.body:
# Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0

基于 [Winlator 11.1](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) 深度定制:

## 主要变化
- **Wine 10.10 -> Wine 11.15**: 移植 brunodev85 全部定制补丁 (Android 存储符号链接、GPU 信息上报、X11 窗口属性等) 至 Wine 11.15 新 WoW64 模式 (x86_64-unix + i386/x86_64 双架构 PE)
- **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好
- **完整中文支持**:
  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名
  - rootfs 注入 zh_CN.UTF-8 locale (glibc + X11)
  - Wine 前缀注册表中文字体替换 (宋体/SimSun -> Noto Sans CJK SC)
  - 新建容器默认中文环境

## 下载安装
直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。

## 技术说明
- APK 为 debug 签名, 与官方 Winlator 签名不同, 两者不可互相覆盖安装
- 由 GitHub Actions 全自动云端编译: Wine (约 50 分钟) -> rootfs 注入中文化 -> Gradle 打包
- 构建配方见仓库 `wine/`、`chinese/`、`.github/workflows/build.yml`

# 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

Here's the full summary:

---

## ⚔️ NEW — LAN Multiplayer Bug Fixes

### 🐛 Bug: Crash when entering Cities
- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.
- **Fix:** Problem fixed, and you can now teleport and enter cities perfectly.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

## What's New

- **Root performance profile:** device-aware, root-manager permission-gated CPU/GPU governor and I/O scheduler controls, with restoration of previous settings when gameplay pauses or exits. Device information is available in Settings and the Performance dialog. Supported controls depend on the device kernel and root manager.
- **Steam integration and download improvements:** browse the Store and library, install Windows depots, manage downloads, view friends/chat, profile, achievements, badges, and Steam News, and create game shortcuts. Download progress now reflects compressed bytes transferred separately from installed size; removing the app from Recents pauses active downloads Experimental Need Feedback.
- **Import graphics wrappers:** import local `.tzst` wrappers through Android's file picker. Archives are validated before they are added to the driver list.
- **PanVK release tracking(Auto Update):** browse release feeds from zenithblue-oss, GunaCharanTeja, FristOneRR, Noysz, and Faux123.
- **Liquid Glass Enhanced:** dialogs and custom popups use adaptive backdrop blur, falling back to app-side blur when Android disables cross-window blur.

- **Steam integration:** sign in with Steam Guard or QR authentication; browse the Store and library; install Windows depots; manage downloads; view friends/chat, profile, achievements, badges, and Steam News; and create game shortcuts. Steam ownership and game DRM requirements still apply.
- **Import graphics wrappers:** import local `.tzst` wrappers through Android's file picker. Archives are validated before they are added to the driver list.
- **Six selectable themes:** Midnight Navy, Neon Amethyst, Vanilla Pearl, Graphite Shadow, Ruby Flare, and Black AMOLED.

## Changelog & Fixes

- **PanVK release tracking:** added release feeds from zenithblue-oss, GunaCharanTeja, FristOneRR, Noysz, and Faux123.

releases.body:
This update brings Winlator Mali+ up to the Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1 source, along with Mali+ improvements to the interface, artwork handling, and virtual input compatibility.

## Mali+ updates

- Refined Liquid Glass styling across dialogs, dropdowns, cards, and in-game surfaces.
- Enhanced Liquid Glass is enabled by default on fresh installs. Toggle it in **Settings > Appearance & Themes > Theme & Colors > Enhanced Liquid Glass**; turning it off disables the enhanced animated-backdrop treatment, while popup/dialog blur remains available.
- Improved game cover-art loading and refresh handling.
- Fixed container-list refresh after creating a container.
- Improved container loading safety while shortcuts are being loaded.
- Improved virtual evdev gamepad discovery for games that scan `/dev/input`.

releases.name: Winlator Mali 1.2+ Update — Vulkan, PanVK & Shortcut Enhancements
releases.body:
Winlator Mali+ 1.2 update, based on Winlator Mali 1.2 Bionic Latest. This update keeps the upstream EGL/Gladio renderer and ZeroFG path while adding optional Vulkan and game-library improvements.

## Highlights

- Optional Vulkan host renderer with renderer configuration, native-rendering/scanout support, and Vulkan LSFG/Win-FG controls.
- Online Bannerlator wrapper catalog with installed-wrapper selection and archive validation.
- Live PanVK release browser in Adrenotools GPU Drivers. Refreshes GitHub releases from three projects, filters for recognized Adrenotools ZIP packages, verifies downloads, and imports drivers directly.
- Shortcut-library improvements: full-cover portrait and landscape cards, per-game artwork handling, executable shortcut creation with container selection, and selected-game graphics details.
- Animated PlayStation-inspired backgrounds and liquid-glass styling across application and in-game menus.

## Experimental PanVK notice

releases.name: Winlator Mali 1.2+ Bionic
releases.body:
## Winlator Mali+ 1.2 Bionic

A customized Winlalor mali from [GunaCharanTeja](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja) an improved console-inspired game library, downloadable graphics wrappers, and an experimental Vulkan rendering/frame-generation path.

### Highlights & Features
- Winlator Mali+ branding and an animated, responsive launcher with portrait/landscape game cards, selectable shortcuts, game cover art, and a compact per-game summary of Vulkan wrapper, FEXCore, Box64, and presets.
- Cloud-fetched and custom game cover art, with local fallback behavior when online artwork is unavailable.
- Bannerlator wrapper catalog integration: browse, download/update, checksum-verify, and select wrappers per container or shortcut; saved selections are restored and applied when launching a game.
- Vulkan host renderer settings for color order, present mode, and installed host driver, plus optional Native Rendering/low-latency scanout.
- Experimental native Win-FG frame generation and optional LSFG Native after importing and validating the user's own `Lossless.dll`; the DLL is not bundled. Compatibility depends on the Vulkan driver/device.
