releases.name: WinLite v1.4.0
releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

releases.name: Android v0.4.0
releases.body:
Pre-release. Same app and signing key as before: install over it (or UPDATE NOW in the launcher), your data stays. **Tested on my own phone (OPPO Find X8 Ultra, Snapdragon 8 Elite / Adreno 830).** This build draws the whole game with my own renderer (nothing is replayed from the Xbox 360's graphics commands any more), and the 30 Years page's PLAY THIS MATCH now goes straight to the match on phones too. On my phone I played a 30 Years match this way to the end, with the titantron, the season video and every cutscene working.

## What's new in 0.4.0
**v0.4.0: the whole game is now drawn by my own renderer, and it runs about twice as fast on a weak laptop.**

This is the biggest change the project has had since the game first started on a PC. Until now, every picture still went through the
Xbox 360's way of drawing: the game wrote out its list of graphics commands for the 360's graphics chip, and my renderer read that list back
and replayed it, or redrew what it already understood and took the rest from the list. That middle step cost a lot of time on every frame,
most of all on weak machines, and it tied every fix to how the 360 did things.

releases.name: v0.4.0
releases.body:
**You need your own copy of WWE 2K14 for the Xbox 360.** This download contains no game files: the launcher asks for
the files you copied from your own disc, or a disc image of it.

## Install

1. Download **wwe2k14-recomp-v0.4.0.zip** below and unzip it anywhere, e.g. `C:\Games\WWE2K14`.
2. Start **`wwe2k14_launcher.exe`**. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the program isn't signed: click **More
   info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. The first-run wizard asks for your game files, checks them, finds your save and suggests settings for your PC.
4. Click **PLAY GAME**, **QUICK MATCH** to start straight into a match, or **30 YEARS OF WRESTLEMANIA** to
   pick any match of that mode.

The full guide (copying your disc and your DLC, controls, settings, mods, reporting problems) is `README.md` inside the
zip.

**What you need:** Windows 10 version 1803 or newer, or Windows 11 (64-bit), a graphics card with Vulkan support, and your WWE 2K14 Xbox 360 disc
(version 0.0.0.2, no title update), copied to your PC. A controller is recommended.

## What's new in v0.4.0

**v0.4.0: the whole game is now drawn by my own renderer, and it runs about twice as fast on a weak laptop.**

**v0.3.2: the game now draws with a renderer I wrote, and it brings your own music.**

Until now the game's scenes were replayed from the Xbox 360's graphics commands, one by one, through an emulated 360 graphics chip. Now the crowd, the arena, the ring, the wrestlers,
the lights, the shadows, the effects and the post effects are built from the game's own data and drawn by my own renderer, which also owns the window and the pacing. Whatever it
does not know yet, it still gets from the game, so nothing is dropped. The picture should look the same. The point is that it is mine to fix and to improve. It is on for everyone.

### New

emulators.latest_body:
Pre-release. Same app and signing key as before: install over it (or UPDATE NOW in the launcher), your data stays. **Tested on my own phone (OPPO Find X8 Ultra, Snapdragon 8 Elite / Adreno 830).** This build draws the whole game with my own renderer (nothing is replayed from the Xbox 360's graphics commands any more), and the 30 Years page's PLAY THIS MATCH now goes straight to the match on phones too. On my phone I played a 30 Years match this way to the end, with the titantron, the season video and every cutscene working.

## What's new in 0.4.0
**v0.4.0: the whole game is now drawn by my own renderer, and it runs about twice as fast on a weak laptop.**

This is the biggest change the project has had since the game first started on a PC. Until now, every picture still went through the
Xbox 360's way of drawing: the game wrote out its list of graphics commands for the 360's graphics chip, and my renderer read that list back
and replayed it, or redrew what it already understood and took the rest from the list. That middle step cost a lot of time on every frame,
most of all on weak machines, and it tied every fix to how the 360 did things.

releases.body:
Title: v2.6 – Xbox 360 games through Xenia, Xbox and Xenia settings tabs
Repository description:
Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu (original Xbox emulator) with a console-style dashboard, Xbox 360 games through your own Xenia, one-click 60 FPS patches, upscaling filters, CPU/GPU boost with per-game settings, and tools for finding out why a game is slow. Not supported by the xemu project.
---
Release body (paste into the GitHub release):
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.6
Xbox 360 games, through your own Xenia. xemu does not emulate the Xbox 360, and this fork still doesn't include or change any 360 emulator. If you download Xenia or Xenia Canary yourself, the library can now list your 360 games and start them in it.
Turn on Show Xbox 360 games on the new Xenia tab and choose your `xenia.exe` / `xenia_canary.exe`. Your game folders are scanned for disc images (.iso), extracted games with a `default.xex`, .xex files, Games on Demand and Xbox Live Arcade packages.

releases.name: v2.5 – Tron Red theme, sphere emblem, holographic covers, DOA3 color fix, Linux AppImage
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.5

Tron Red. A third dashboard color next to Neon and Green, red with amber. It works on every dashboard style. Pick it under Settings > Dashboard theme or the Library menu.
Sphere and fins is the default dashboard, with an X emblem on the sphere. New installs start on Original Blades in the original green. The sphere, fins, web, orbs and bars take the theme color you choose (cyan for Neon, red and orange for Tron Red), and so does the emblem. If you already picked a style or theme, nothing changes for you.
Holo and Aurora dashboards. Two more styles. Holo is a hologram terminal, and now has a light-cycle fight in its arena: two cycles meet, one is wounded and breaks into cubes of light, the other runs on and a new pair appears.
Holographic covers. Settings > Home screen covers has a third choice, Holographic: cases float over a projector ring, bob and turn slowly, with scanlines, a sweep of light, an occasional glitch and a tint in your theme color.

releases.name: v2.4 – Faster library scanning, Clear library, version in the title bar
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.4
Version in the title bar. The window now reads "xemu Modern GUI v2.4 | xemu v0.8.139", so it's easy to tell which build you're running.
Faster library scanning. Games appear as soon as they're found instead of after the whole folder has been read, several disc images are read at once, and extracted game folders (any folder containing `default.xbe`) are no longer searched file by file. Recycle-bin and hidden folders are skipped.
Clear library. Library > Folders has a new "Clear library..." button. It empties the game list and forgets your game folders, individually added games and hidden games, so you can add them again from scratch. Your game files are never touched. Play time, favorites, custom names and per-game settings are kept.

1.4 GHz CPU option. Real hardware speed can pace to 733 MHz (stock) or 1.4 GHz (like a modded console), under Settings > Performance. Real hardware speed is off by default.

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

releases.name: v2.2: four new dashboard styles, stick drift test, achievements that unlock themselves
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.2
Four new dashboard styles (Settings > Library style, or the Games menu). They are original artwork inspired by the look of old consoles: no Microsoft or Xbox artwork is used.
Original Xbox: black and green with a glowing wireframe globe. The list of sections slides to the left and a section opens in a window over the globe, so the list stays visible.
Original Blades: a bright green web, a glowing sphere with fins and an arc of orbs, one for each section, like the first Xbox's menu.
Glossy Blades: silver blades on glossy green, in the spirit of the Xbox 360's first dashboard. Every blade stays visible and the active one rises, with its window beside the row.
Modern: a calm side menu with icons and one card at a time.
The two Original styles use the Russo One font (SIL Open Font License) and have their own animations. All the tabs work in every style, from a controller too.

releases.body:
Scheduler and file I/O fixes from upstream Xenia Edge: file reads and writes finish the way they do on the console, and kernel timers and DPCs behave like the console's.

Adds ZeroFG frame generation: the screen shows twice the game's frame rate (30 → 60, 60 → 120).

Halo: Reach runs much faster and shows the characters' faces again: from 17 to its limit of 30 fps in the first mission on a POCO F7 (Adreno 825).

Game folder management after initial setup, a 40 FPS frame rate cap for 120 Hz displays, lower power draw and heat on Android, and improved physical controller trigger and remapping support.

Upstream Xenia Edge synchronization (batch 16) bringing 40 audio, kernel, scheduler, threading and CPU fixes, plus an ARMv8.0 JIT fix for older Snapdragon chips.

Improves Vulkan startup compatibility on older Adreno GPUs, ports rendering accuracy fixes from Xenia Edge, and reduces vertex shader overhead when software round-toward-zero emulation is active.

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — Launcher Fix
releases.body:
# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — launcher startup fix

Preview 1 could close immediately without showing the launcher. Its rebuilt APK omitted 146 original artwork files required during application startup. Preview 2 restores those files, preserves their authentication and touch icons, and adds checks using the final signed APK's own resources.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-Preview2.apk** over Preview 1; the app ID and release key are unchanged, and the version code is newer. There is no need to uninstall first. **XHYN V Bridge stays at 0.1.0**; an already installed copy does not need updating.

All 0.3 features remain: the 1.7.57 multiplayer base, LAN free roam, room chat, shared vehicles, street races, themes, XHYN graphics/DXVK controls and diagnostics. See the full [changelog and multiplayer guide](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/blob/v0.3-preview2/README.md).

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 1 — Superseded
releases.body:
> **Superseded — install [XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/releases/tag/v0.3-preview2).** Preview 1 omitted artwork required during startup and cannot open the launcher. Preview 2 restores the files and passes startup/launcher checks using the final APK resources. Install it over Preview 1 without uninstalling. Bridge remains at 0.1.0. Physical-device gameplay and multiplayer remain untested.

# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 1

## What's new in the 1.7.57 base

- **Experimental LAN free roam:** create or join rooms for **2–10 players, including the host**, using Wi-Fi, a hotspot or a virtual LAN.
- **Room tools:** room discovery, player names, a member list, connection/latency information, chat, host announcements and host-controlled friendly fire.
- **World synchronization:** character clothing/accessories, nearby vehicles and shared vehicle seating, with time, weather and nearby traffic following the host. Visual synchronization has not been verified on devices.
- **Street races:** record checkpoint routes, save recent tracks, choose sprint or circuit races, enter races and view results. Spawning/teleporting restrictions apply during races.

releases.name: XHYN V 0.2 Hotfix 2
releases.body:
This update adds more control over graphics and DXVK settings, with help explaining what each option does and when it may help or hurt performance.

- DXVK tuning for reported VRAM, shared memory, allocation budget, shaders, caches, filtering and advanced compatibility settings. Controls follow the selected bundled renderer.
- Tuning buttons, the dxvk.conf editor and effective configuration stay synchronized. Custom memory values and a tuning reset are included.
- Information buttons explain purpose, potential benefits and tradeoffs across graphics, performance, drivers and diagnostics. Advanced DXVK options start collapsed.
- Adjustable 0–100% render scale and graphics-quality reset actions. Zero uses the game resolution; positive scales retain a 320 × 180 minimum.
- Simpler Diagnostics: Record next game, reproduce the problem, then Save report to share. Recording stops automatically.
- Optional driver compatibility advice, display-refresh matching, experimental Android 12+ scheduling hints and improved memory/graphics reports.

releases.name: XHYN V 0.2 Hotfix 1
releases.body:
0.2 Hotfix 1 fixes the launcher and startup problems reported in 0.2.

- Fixed System navigation and restored Diagnostics and Game Resources.
- Moved About inside System, directly below Game Resources.
- Matched new controls to the launcher and split them across Display, Performance, DXVK and Diagnostics.
- Removed the duplicate driver picker; use the existing Vulkan Drivers page.
- Fixed graphics settings saving and setup failures mislabeled as invalid game folders.
- Kept old configuration text when its overrides cannot be applied.

Install **XHYN-V-0.2-Hotfix1.apk** below. It updates 0.2 without changing the app ID or signing key.

This is a development prerelease. Native gameplay and GPU compatibility still need device testing. Older memory/driver crashes are not claimed fixed; [review notes](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/blob/main/docs/issues/2026-10-30-crash-triage.md) describe the findings.

The APK does not bundle GTA V game data. Use your own compatible Legacy files. [Buy GTA V](https://store.rockstargames.com/game/buy-gta-v).

# YukiHub v0.4 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。
- **大屏模式新增回首页按钮**：右上角可直接退出大屏模式回到首页；原设置按钮同步改为图案化设计，并增加点击动效。
- **Yuki社区新增收藏集功能**（萌萌点回收计划二期）。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。
- **KRKR 内部存储启动**：属实验性功能，效果因游戏而异，如遇异常可改回原启动方式。
- **FVP 引擎更新仅涉及引擎侧**：不改变存档格式，原有存档可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.3.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**新引擎支持 · 大屏体验 · 社区互动 · 在线状态 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **新增 PC 引擎**：支持兼容 **Winlator-CN** 快捷启动。使用方法：手动选择 PC 引擎 → 添加游戏文件夹 → 选择 exe 文件启动即可。（请确保已安装 **Winlator-CN 1005 或更新版本**）
- **新增 FVP 引擎兼容启动**：FVP 引擎正式可用。
- **大屏模式新增搜索功能**：位于分类栏最上方，支持按游戏名与会社名搜索。
- **社区接入 NextMoe 贴纸表情包**：现在可以更愉快地带表情包发言了（bushi）。
- **在线状态区分手机 / 电脑端**：在线标记已区别化显示，为 PC 端接入做好准备。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **FVP 引擎新增虚拟鼠标按钮**：复用 KRKR / Artemis 的虚拟鼠标方案，操作更顺手。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复扫描入库的游戏固定使用 VNDB 源的问题**：扫描入库后现在会按设置中选择的资料源进行匹配，与手动添加保持一致。
- **修复大屏模式游玩时长不计入网页端每日任务的问题**：大屏游玩现在会正常上报服务端，经验与每日任务均可正常结算。
- **修复设置面板上下滑动时选项被误判为点击、导致界面被"硬控"的问题**。
- **修复 FVP 引擎视频播放问题**：需手动将原游戏视频转换为标准 MP4 格式 —— 编码 **H.264 (AVC)**、音频 **AAC**；720p 推荐 4000 比特率，1080p 推荐 6000 比特率。
- **移除 Bangumi 镜像源**：因镜像源频繁失效，已正式下线；此前使用镜像源的用户升级后将**自动切换为 Bangumi 官源**（官源访问可能需要一点 🔮）。

## 📌 说明

- 网络类静默失败已补充日志记录，开启日志后更便于排查问题。
- 以上修复均不涉及引擎存档镜像逻辑，原有存档数据不受影响。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.3 更新简介

> 本次更新聚焦：**UI 全面焕新 · 大屏模式 · 展厅功能 · 资讯与正版导购 · 账号体验 · 大量稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **大屏模式（主打）**：全新大屏播放体验，支持在大屏上畅享游戏 PV；新增从**文件夹**选取视频的来源（部分设备受系统限制无法从相册正常浏览图集，只能按时间一个个翻，很麻烦，现已绕开）。
- **首页接入 Gal 资讯**：打开 App 即可浏览最新 Galgame 动态。
- **正式接入 NextMoe 数据源**：账号快捷登录同步迁移为 **NextMoe·未萌** 快捷登录；聊天室支持 NextMoe 表情包。
- **游戏库正版导购**：网页社区游戏库新增游戏详情页，接入 **DLsite 正版链接** 与 **Steam 正版链接**（通过 Steam API 显示实时价格）。接入 NextMoe 分销链接，流量好的话后续会在社区发放 DL 正版游戏优惠券。
- **忘记密码 / 找回密码**：支持自助找回账号。
- **游戏时长编辑**：支持手动编辑游戏时长记录。
- **展厅玩法扩展**：3D 游戏展厅与多人在线展厅持续建设中，本版本新增音乐间（离线展厅可播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐），并支持共同观影等多人互动玩法。
- **多人在线展厅（重磅）**：全新网页端多人 3D 展厅上线！和朋友一起在线逛街、聊天、互动，包含：
  - 影院：共同观影、点播排队、投票换片、管理员管理（强制播放/跳片、远程灯光等）；
  - 音乐间：播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐，附赠一台古典音乐播放机；
  - 钓鱼等小游戏与更多互动玩法；
  - 离线展厅同步升级音乐间。
- **3D 游戏展厅**：以"逛博物馆"的仪式感重新设计，游戏以实体盒子陈列在虚拟 3D 房间中。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **UI 全面焕新**：整体视觉语言与配色体系全面重设计，界面更现代、更统一，观感焕然一新。
- 注册 / 登录页交互逻辑全面优化。
- 首页、游戏库按钮样式与配色统一化，UI 细节全面打磨。
- 手柄适配继续完善。
- 融合 GalToolbox 能力。
- 软件内更新默认源切换至 **GitCode**。
- 鲲 Gal 域名变更同步。

## 🛠 问题修复

- 修复好友列表"离线用户仍显示正在游玩"的 bug（根因为游戏时长未成功回传形成记录闭环）。
- 修复聊天室图片只缓存一半的问题。
- 修复验证码无动画反馈的问题。
- 修复共存版无法扫描添加文件的问题（初始库默认缺失生成项）。
- 修复游戏时长相关的若干功能 bug。
- ONS 游戏：视频播放改为**长按 2 秒跳过**（原为点击跳过，避免误触）。

## 📌 说明

emulators.latest_body:
## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

### Original Xbox: the Performance core

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

releases.name: Xenra v0.4.5
releases.body:
## Xenra 0.4.5 (pre-release)

The biggest performance update yet, on both consoles.

### Performance and Compatibility cores
Every game, Original Xbox and Xbox 360, now has two cores. Performance is the default; switch any game from its menu in the library.

### Original Xbox
- New Performance core, integrated with Xenra's controls, display options and in-game menu. Most games run at full speed; Forza Motorsport 12 -> 30 fps.
- Compatibility core updated to the latest xemu, with the upstream graphics accuracy fixes (lighting, vertex shaders, textures, surfaces, timers).
- Crash and stability fixes across the renderer, audio and save states.

### Xbox 360
- Major GPU overhaul: Forza Horizon 2 10 -> 30 fps, Halo 3 up to 2x faster.
- Game fixes including Forza Motorsport 4, Need for Speed: Most Wanted, Gears of War 3, Rise of the Tomb Raider and Crysis 3.
- Synced with the latest Xenia Edge.
- Fixed textures and objects disappearing for a frame.
- GTA V boots again with its title update installed.
- Custom GPU drivers can run the GPU at full clocks.

### App
- Fixes across the library, settings, save states and the setup wizard.

### Known issues

releases.body:
# Xenra 0.4.0

[![Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Support_on_Patreon-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.4.0** brings a main-thread responsiveness pass, custom Vulkan driver support for Exynos (Mali) devices, experimental temporal frame generation, FATX save streaming, and the consolidation of Xenra into a single free build.

---

## Upgrade Notice

* **Install Direct:** Install Xenra 0.4.0 directly over your existing Green installation. Do not uninstall first, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.
* **Gold Edition Discontinued:** Gold is retired as of 0.4.0. Installing Green (`Ali.Xanite.green`) will install alongside Gold. Gold data remains intact on your device, but a one-time setup (selecting BIOS, game paths, and granting storage permissions) is required on Green.

---

## Highlights

### Interface & Responsiveness
* **Touch & D-Pad Navigation:** Touch target resolution defers to `ACTION_UP` without walking full view trees. D-pad navigation eliminates ~170 filesystem probes per press for instant library scrolling.

releases.name: Xenra v0.3.6
releases.body:
# Xenra 0.3.6

[![Gold Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Gold_Version-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.3.6** introduces major compatibility, performance, and usability improvements, including GTA V gameplay, frame generation across both Xbox generations, improved GPU handling, save importing, and crucial Xbox 360 fixes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Upgrade Notice:** Install Xenra 0.3.6 directly over your existing installation. **Do not uninstall the previous version**, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.

---

##  Highlights

###  Gameplay & Performance
* **GTA V:** Resolved the `NetDll_select` scheduling issue that caused the black-screen hang. GTA V now reaches gameplay at ~25 FPS in initial testing.
* **Frame Generation:** Added frame generation support for both Original Xbox and Xbox 360, featuring **1.25×**, **1.5×**, and **2×** performance modes.
* **Core Performance:** Optimized compiled-code synchronization and streamlined several frequently executed code paths.

###  Graphics & System Settings

releases.name: Xenra v0.3.5
releases.body:
Xenra 0.3.5 introduces direct game data management, Xbox 360 System Link support, and targeted rendering optimizations across both Xbox generations.

Buy gold version here:
https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership

---

## Game Data Management

Access the dedicated **Game Data** menu by long-pressing any title in your library:

* **Xbox 360 Patches & Mods:** Direct installation of `.patch.toml` files (with Title ID verification) and `.xex` plugins via `plugins.toml`.
* **Xbox 360 Saves:** View saves grouped by profile; import and export ZIP archives.
* **Original Xbox Saves:** Direct FATX hard disk image integration. List, import, export, and delete saves with synchronized `UDATA` and `TDATA` handling.

---

## Performance & Rendering

* **Render Pipeline Optimizations:** Refined render-target handling and GPU synchronization eliminate unnecessary render passes, improving frame rates on mobile hardware.
* **Faster Rendering Path:** Fixed an underlying bottleneck, allowing default `gpu_upstream_conformance` to drop from 15 to 14. Existing configurations migrate automatically.

## Changes since `build-deps-winsteam-runtime32-r2`

- fix(release): use portable Windows Steam asset name [skip ci] (c5fc06ed)

- fix(steam): enforce library deadlines in native XHR [skip ci] (9f84d92b)

---

**Note**: This build is **unsigned**. Sign the HAP with a valid device/release profile before installation; developer mode alone does not sign it.

Built from commit `c5fc06e`.
## 2.0.0：OHOS Wine / Windows Steam 主线

- main 汇合此前全部历史修复，默认采用原生 ARM64 OHOS Wine 与 FEX；Box64 保留为可选兼容后端。
- HmosDeck 与 Windows Steam 游戏库、启动入口保留；移除 Linux Steam、GNU Proton 产品界面与运行载荷。
- 包含 Steam 启动和可选社区请求的超时处理、原生 XHR 期限、SHM 上传及 GPU staging 访问修复。
- CI 与本地使用同一组构建、来源、运行时闭包和产品边界检查；配套发布 Windows Steam 离线导入包。
- 离线包沿用已在 Mini 导入的固定内容，应用启动前更新匹配的辅助模块。ZIP 无需解压，不含账号、游戏或存档。

本发布先冻结现有运行时；FEX/Proton 的完整上游升级在独立后续分支开展。
Steam 登录、库界面和输入已有 Mini 验证；界面仍有卡顿，游戏性能与长期稳定性不作扩大承诺。
GitHub HAP 为未签名包；安装前须使用匹配设备或发布权限的签名。

releases.name: Windows Steam runtime32-r2 build dependency
releases.body:
Immutable Windows Steam runtime32-r2 offline import package used by VintagePomeloPro 2.0.0.

The existing ZIP is reused byte for byte. It contains client resources and the pinned runtime dependencies; no account, login cache, games or saves are included. VPP upgrades its exact stopped helper from the application's bundled resources before normal launch.

Archive: Steam-Windows-离线导入包-20261011.zip
Size: 332748238 bytes
SHA-256: 8108462833063f0a35c224c0cc42fee236f2a9a8dcf76935533d25a817c2d434

All 6981 ZIP members, CRCs, member checksums and the helper upgrade identity were verified against the current 2.0.0 Mini test package. This release is a pinned build dependency, not a new application release.

# 1.4.4 更新说明

## Steam 下载

- 修正下载专用扫码授权，通过 Steam Client 的 CM 会话获取下载授权；应用内账号登录继续保留独立流程。
- 修正 PICS 的 `appinfo` 包装层解析，补齐受限内容资料访问令牌及大型资料获取，解决“depot 无可用 manifest”。
- 支持 Steam 返回的中国 CDN 类型和主机，并遵循服务器的 HTTPS 要求。
- 支持加密 manifest 文件名，兼容 Base64 中的换行和空白，解决扫码授权后仍无法完成下载的问题。

releases.name: Ymir v0.4.0
releases.body:
# Ymir v0.4.0
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/54fead6/)

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

releases.body:
# Ymir v0.3.2
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/584dcc1/)

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

Performance got another huge boost in multiple avenues with this version. First, thanks to @SternXD, you can now offload audio processing tasks to another CPU core, freeing up the emulator thread to focus more heavily on the SH-2s and general system logic. This alone can boost performance by up to 25% and possibly more, depending on how much work is put on the SCSP DSP.

## Changes

- **Older processors without AVX (#432).** Windows and Linux PCs whose processor has no AVX can now start the game. Examples are 1st-generation Intel Core i5/i7 and the Pentium or Celeron of that time.
  - **What was wrong:** the game closed straight away with an "illegal instruction" error (`0xC000001D`) on these processors. It had only been built for processors with AVX.
  - **What changed:** the download now holds a second copy of the game built without AVX. The launcher checks your processor and picks the right copy by itself, so there is nothing to set.
  - **What to expect:**
    - The game runs slower on such old processors.
    - It still needs a processor with SSE4.2, so Core 2 and Phenom II processors can't run it.
    - On Windows, PCs from that time often have graphics cards without Direct3D 12 or Vulkan. Choose **Launcher › Graphics › Direct3D 11 (experimental)** on those.
  - The Windows and Linux downloads are about 17 MB and 19 MB bigger. Android, macOS and iOS are unchanged.

For #432

Everything else is the same as [v0.10.68](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/Free-Riders-Recompiled/releases/tag/v0.10.68).

releases.body:
## Changes

- **Dolphin Resort water ski above 60 Hz (#410).** With **Test options › Gameplay › Race step rate** above 60 (for example 120 or 144):
  - **What was wrong:** on the Dolphin Resort water-ski tow, the racer turned round and rode backwards behind the boat. The camera then looked at the racer's face and swung low beside them.
  - **What changed:** the tow now behaves the same at every frame rate, so the racer rides behind the boat facing forward and the camera stays behind them. At the default 60 Hz nothing changes.

For #410

Everything else is the same as [v0.10.67](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/Free-Riders-Recompiled/releases/tag/v0.10.67).

## Validation

- **Windows x64 package, #410: Dolphin Resort Expert water ski with Super Sonic (unmanned, both Super Sonic options on), at Race step rate 144 and 60:**
  - Super Sonic rides behind the boat facing forward at both rates; the camera stays behind him.

releases.name: v0.10.67 — Hold to skip story scenes and movies
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Skipping story scenes and movies now needs a hold (#426).** A tap or an accidental touch no longer skips anything:
  - **Story scenes** (for example in World Grand Prix) skip only while you **hold** START, or keep your finger on the screen on Android, until the circle fills. Let go early and the circle drains and the scene goes on.
  - **Movies** skip when you hold START, A, B or Back for half a second. A quick tap, or Android's back swipe, no longer ends them.
  - The startup logos (ESRB, SEGA, Sonic Team) still skip with a press.

For #426

Everything else is the same as [v0.10.66](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/Free-Riders-Recompiled/releases/tag/v0.10.66).

## Validation

- **Windows x64 package, #426: Eggman's opening World Grand Prix scene, from an empty save, with movies on:**
  - A short START tap (0.2 s): the scene plays on to its end.
  - START held for 1.2 s: the SKIP circle appears and fills about halfway, then drains when START is let go, and the scene plays on.
  - START held for 2 s: the circle fills and the scene is skipped.

releases.name: v0.10.66 — CPU difficulty for Free Race
releases.body:
## Changes

- **New: CPU difficulty (#420).** The launcher has a new option, **General › Gameplay › CPU difficulty**, with four levels:
  - **Newbie** and **Easy:** the computer racers can no longer ride far above their top speed, so they fall behind. Newbie holds them back more than Easy.
  - **Normal (original):** the original game. This is the default.
  - **Hard:** the computer racers keep pace with you and can pass you. If you break away from them, the ones behind you speed up to catch up.
  - It only changes the computer racers. Your own racer is the same at every level.
  - It only applies to an offline **Free Race**. Story, the other modes and online races stay as the original.
  - It works at every Race step rate, from 60 to 144 Hz.
- **Build:** if GitHub's copy of ONNX Runtime (used for camera motion) is gone, the build now downloads it from our own pinned mirror.

releases.body:
# v0.5.1

Uma versão de segurança. Um jogo aberto no emulador podia ler, sobrescrever e apagar arquivos
fora da própria pasta. Agora cada jogo enxerga só o que é dele, e os saves de todos os jogos
passam a ficar num lugar só.

Bugs corrigidos:

- **Um jogo não alcança mais os arquivos do computador.** Um `.mod` aberto fora de um pacote,
  direto de uma pasta como `Downloads`, podia mexer nos arquivos ao lado dele: ler, trocar o
  conteúdo e apagar. Num pacote `.zip`, podia apagar arquivos do próprio jogo. Nenhum jogo da
  biblioteca faz isso, mas um `.mod` de origem desconhecida faria. Agora:
  - o jogo só lê o que veio com ele, e não consegue alterar nem apagar esses arquivos;
  - tudo o que o jogo grava vai para a pasta de saves do emulador;
  - atalhos (links simbólicos) dentro da pasta do jogo são ignorados;
  - um save state alterado à mão não reabre arquivos fora do que o jogo alcança.
- **Os saves de todos os jogos ficam juntos**, em `saves/mod/`, uma pasta por jogo, como no
  console. Um jogo que usa o save de outro, como o Zeebo F.C. com os bonecos do Zeeboids,
  continua encontrando o que precisa

# v0.5.0

O Ultimate Chess 3D, o Alice no País das Maravilhas, o Rally Master Pro e o menu do Quake voltam a
funcionar, e a água do Bóia Cross ganha a cor do console. Carregar um save state e usar o rewind

* New features for mod developers:
  * Added optional dependency functionality, which allows mods to run different code based on the presence of another mod. See [this section of the template mod toml](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/mod.toml#L42) and [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L37) for more details.
  * Added exports to get the return value of a function from within a return hook. See [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L11) for more details.
  * Hooks and callbacks are now run in an order determined by the order of mods in the mod menu. Regular hooks and callbacks are run from top to bottom, while return hooks are run in the reverse of that order. Reordering mods after starting the game does not affect this ordering.

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]  
> There's currently a known issue where installing mods by dragging them into the main menu instead of the mods menu might lead to mods being disabled or crashes. Until this issue is resolved, it is recommended to drag mods to the game window while in the mods menu rather than the main menu. 

Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

* Modding support has been added. Mods can be installed by dragging them onto the game window or by using the "Install Mods" button in the mod menu before starting the game. You can find many mods on the Thunderstore page at https://thunderstore.io/c/zelda-64-recompiled/. More info can be found in the readme.
* Texture pack support has been added. Texture packs are managed with the same menu as mods and installed in the same way. Some texture packs can be found on the thunderstore page linked previously.
* MacOS is now supported via a Metal renderer. Thanks @dcvz and @tanmaysachan!

releases.name: v1.1.1
releases.body:
**Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.**

**NOTE: There are known rendering issues with AMD RDNA3 integrated GPUs on Windows (e.g. Ryzen Z1 or Radeon 780M). Use the workaround in https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/Zelda64Recomp/issues/289 or wait for AMD to fix it in a driver update.**

- The ocarina now accepts DPad inputs (#311)
- Analog camera improvements:
   - When aiming inside of a deku flower, Link will follow the camera (#306)
   - When rolling as Goron, the camera will automatically switch to auto mode when the spikes come out (you can touch the right stick again to make the camera free again) (#306)
   - The Wart boss fight will now start if you look at the boss with the analog camera (#308)
- Added a workaround for an AMD driver bug affecting the usage of a 64 bit framebuffer on RDNA3 GPUs on DX12. These GPUs will default to Vulkan until AMD fixes their issue. (#314)
- Added an automatic file backup system for the config files to prevent file corruption (#335)

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
**Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version. :)**

**NOTE: This update is known to cause rendering issues with AMD RDNA3 GPUs on Windows (e.g. RX 7000 series and Ryzen Z1). Use [the workaround mentioned here](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/Zelda64Recomp/issues/289) or wait for AMD to fix it in a driver update.**

* Added an analog "free" camera in the style of later entries in the series. Moving the right stick will allow you to freely rotate the camera, and pressing the Target button or going through an entrance will switch back to the normal camera.
* Improved motion blur effect at high framerates by using a high precision internal framebuffer (won't be enabled on machines with less than 1GB of VRAM).
* Implemented N64 noise dither (affects the motion blur scenes).
* Extended Dawn of the X Day screen to account for faster load times to match console timings.
* Added a configurable scaled deadzone option to the menu. (#257)

# PanProbe 1.3.2

Vulkan conformance and performance probe for the Mesa PanVK driver on Mali GPUs (mali_kbase). It loads the bundled driver, the system Vulkan driver or an imported `.so`, shows what the driver reports, and runs **41** on-device tests.

Bundled drivers:
- `rc5` slot (default): [Mesa PanVK 26.3.1](https://github.com/zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android/releases/tag/panvk-kbase-v26.3.1), `26.3.0-devel (git-795ca7ff3e, p0175, 2026-10-31)`, build 122i, universal Mali v6-v14 (v15 not fully supported).
- `rc4` slot: the RC4 driver (`panvk-kbase-v0.1.0-rc4`), for A/B runs.

Package `dev.zenithblue.panvktest`, versionName 1.3.2, versionCode 21. It updates 1.2.7 and 1.3.x in place.

## What is new since 1.2.7

- Bundles build 122i (26.3.1) in the default slot; the `rc4` slot keeps RC4 for A/B runs.

emulators.latest_body:
**Nixport v1.2.304-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> Published by hand: built and signed with the same key as v1.1.299-alpha and
> v1.0.267-alpha (upgrades install over them without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.1.299-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Single-player pad model** (replaces v1.1's player slots): exactly one physical
  pad feeds the game at a time. The pad you touch takes over automatically
  (last-active wins); the session drawer offers "use this pad" to pin a choice for
  the session. The effective pad and the on-screen controls merge into one player.
- **Fix: intermittent directional input**. After opening a menu or losing focus,
  sticks / D-pad / triggers now reach the game immediately at their current position —
  no more "only X works in the load screen" or "the first press does nothing".
  The old "stay blocked until centered" gate is gone (keys only).
- Rumble now always lands on the effective pad (Xbox-protocol pads don't expose
  motors to Android — enable "phone vibration" as the fallback).
- On-screen stale-state fix: a closed overlay can no longer pin the virtual stick
  over the physical one.

releases.name: Nixport v1.1.299-alpha
releases.body:
**Nixport v1.1.299-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> **The project is still being prepared.** This build was published by hand: the
> tag points at the current remote `main`, and the APK is built and signed with
> the same machine and key as the local v1.0.267-alpha release (upgrades install
> over it without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.0.267-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Player slots**: Player 1 = on-screen controls + one selected physical pad, merged.
  The in-game drawer (Input tab) now lists every physical pad under "Physical gamepads" —
  set one as Player 1, assign pads to Players 2-4, or unassign them. An explicit choice is
  remembered across sessions.
- **First input wins**: with no explicit choice, the first pad that actually produces
  input becomes Player 1. Phantom devices (e.g. HyperOS's `uinput-xiaomi`) no longer eat
  Player 1 and silence your Bluetooth pad in-game — the main fix of this build.
- **Rumble return path**: a game's rumble request travels back over NXP2 v3 and drives the
  pad's own motors (falls back to the phone's motor when the pad has none).

releases.name: Nixport v1.0.267-alpha
releases.body:
**Nixport v1.0.267-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> **The project is still being prepared.** The source code is not public yet — it will be open-sourced in [NixPort/nixport](https://github.com/zFitness/nixport) once the release is ready. What you get here today is the documentation plus a runnable APK.

**Install:** download `nixport.apk` from this release and install it on an ARM64 Android phone (Android 9 / API 28 or newer). The APK ships the Linux environment inside it and unpacks it on first run.

If the app is already installed, update from inside the app (Home). Note that this build is signed with a different key than the CI-published ones, so it may require uninstalling the previous build first.

**SHA-256 of `nixport.apk`:**
`9541187e23d823f1e883ad002c002093791437fc740544e370addbd9c1208817`

**Size:** 281,440,841 bytes

`nixport.json` next to the APK carries the same metadata (commit, build time, size, SHA-256) and is what the in-app updater reads.

> **Release candidate.** This is the first test build of 1.3.0. It adds a lot of new features, and most of them have passed automated checks so far, with them being tested by me personally but NOT all of them. Please report anything that breaks on the issue tracker, with your platform and what you were doing.

## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and the `course-*` files together.
Tracks that use the new wind or CPU aggression settings save a newer settings block that 1.2.x cannot read. Tracks that do not use them stay readable by older builds. Keep your backup if you might go back to 1.2.x.

## New: G-Diffuser Companion (Windows and Linux)

The Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux arm64 downloads now include the Companion, a separate desktop program in the `companion` folder inside your G-Diffuser folder. It builds the files G-Diffuser loads and checks every input before it builds. It never edits your settings, saves or stores.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.3 - Course Editor Hotfix
releases.body:
## Fixes
- Correct complete-course snapshot content binding so metadata-only edits do not reuse an incompatible retained snapshot.
- Handle terminal disk-write refusals without trapping Course Edit in its save wait loop.
- Fix the host editor's remaining 64-node admission ceiling. The supported total remains 127 nodes, including forks.
- Restore Content Library layout previews for supported tracks above 64 nodes.
- Adapt native load, overwrite, and delete confirmations to long filenames while keeping normal-size text and the Yes/No controls in place.
- Size the Course Edit information panel dynamically to fit the track title, length, and node count.

## Save compatibility — read before updating
Close the game and back up the complete installation save/state set before updating, not only the cartridge `.sav` file.

This release writes version-2 `.gcs` snapshots and still reads version 1. Older builds cannot read version-2 snapshots or packages that contain them. Before downgrading, restore the complete matching pre-upgrade save/state backup. Keeping old snapshots alone is not sufficient.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix
releases.body:
## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.1 - The Small Improvements and Fixes Update
releases.body:
## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and `course-elements.gdxs`, `course-forks.gbs`, and
`course-settings.gks` together. Do not open snapshot-backed saves in an older executable.
The new, extended tracks that go above the original 64 node limit are not compatible with the original Expansion Kit or older tools.

## Course Edit

- Widen the native course information panel at a fixed size. Keep full 20-character names on
  one row and fit three-digit node counts without moving the buttons below it. Dynamic sizing
  is deferred.

- Raise the combined main-path and alternate-path control-point ceiling to **127**. Geometry,
  jump, effect, decoration, and junction budgets still apply; 127 points is not a guarantee
  that every layout fits.
- Add complete, content-bound save snapshots for extended courses and complete course/cup
  package sharing. Missing or mismatched required snapshot data is rejected rather than
  silently loading a truncated course.
- Keep both paths selectable after editor reload and save/reload. Show stored branch nodes

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.

## New platforms

emulators.description: 任天堂 Switch 与 Switch 2 模拟器，C++ 编写，实验性。
emulators.latest_body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 316 (5a66c89)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 228 (be1f4d9)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 177

Built from nx2 9fbffe253b plus 11 pull requests that merged into nx2 after it (the test/all-in-one-3 branch at be1f4d9c84). Build 177 was 87d84d513c. That's 152 merged changes, 69 of them from community contributors.

> **The first launch of each game after updating takes longer.** A lot of shader code changed in this release, so caches are partly rebuilt once: the compute precache runs its pass once more (#1620), pipelines that an older cache saved with the wrong texture type are rebuilt (#1443), NVIDIA on Linux fills a new, larger driver cache folder (#1301), and the LSFG shader cache rebuilds (#1625). Later launches should be fast again. If a second launch of the same build still rebuilds most shaders, send the log from Help → Report a Bug (Ctrl+F12): we're looking into reports of this.

### Big fixes

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 177 (87d84d5)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 160

Built from nx2 87d84d513c. Build 160 was 2eb5f08. That's 86 merged changes.

> **The yuzu name is gone.** The build system, source folders, Qt frontend, translations, emulator libraries and docs now say Lichii instead of the name inherited from yuzu. Your settings, saves and shader caches are kept: config keys, data folders and cache formats don't change, and the few on-disk names that still carry the old name (the shader cache's file magic, the save-size file inside saves, the import path for yuzu data) stay as they are. The program files are still called `lichii`, `eden-cli` and `eden-room`. On macOS the app's bundle id changed, so macOS asks for camera and input permission again (#1541, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1544, #1582).

### Big fixes

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 160 (2eb5f08)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 150

Built from nx2 2eb5f081c8. Build 150 was 17baed7. That's 30 merged changes.

> **New look.** Lichii now opens in the new **Lichii Dark** theme, and a short **What's new** window explains what moved. You can reopen it from **Help → What's New**, and the old themes are still in the settings.

### Big fixes
- **Yoshi and the Mysterious Book: the 3D world renders.** Three shader forms the game uses were rejected, which left the world black. Built on ggonzalospineli-ops' #1189 and FrsrG's #1284, with ALD/OUT from MythosOfs (#1363).
- **The Duskbloods network test: boots to its menus.** It no longer aborts on memory, and its shader forms are supported. By cerroverb (#552, #851). It still stops at its online checks. It also always uses reactive flushing, gets the DLSS replacement (#828, #637), and has a 3D colour-target clear fix (#638).
- **Ocarina of Time: the guard house freeze is fixed** by a built-in Texture Pool x2 patch (#1313).
- **Mario Kart World: characters and karts are lit correctly.** Read-only compute bindings are sized from their size word (#1333).

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.1.0 DEV
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.1.0 DEV

New audio, rendering, and Android startup fixes are here. Huge thanks to
[Andrew Nakas](https://github.com/andrewnakas) and contributors for the underlying
work, and [AlanConstantino](https://github.com/AlanConstantino) for integrating
it and testing on Retroid Pocket 6 in [PR #123](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/pull/123).
Alex McHugh's Skate3Recomp and ReXGlue/Xenia remain the foundation of this port.

## Download

Most players want **Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk**. Install over your existing
main app. Do not uninstall first. Android will ask you to approve the update.
Your extracted game files stay in place.

[Download the main APK](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0/Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk)
or [get the separate QA Build](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0-qa1/Skate3-Mobile-QA.apk).
The debug APK is for users of the separate developer app.

Older QA and developer builds used the main app's update address. Install the
matching v2.1 APK once, without uninstalling. From this version onward, each
app receives updates for its own package only.

## What changed

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile QA Build
releases.body:

This candidate uses the same native libraries as the main v2.1 APK.

Thanks to Andrew Nakas and contributors for the fixes and AlanConstantino for

Install **Skate3-Mobile-QA.apk** over your existing QA app without uninstalling.
It does not replace the main app. Older QA builds need this one manual update

## Português

Versão QA com as correções de áudio, renderização e compatibilidade da v2.1.
Usa as mesmas bibliotecas nativas do APK principal.

Instale **Skate3-Mobile-QA.apk** por cima do aplicativo QA atual, sem desinstalar.
Não substitui o aplicativo principal. Esta atualização manual é necessária uma
vez para que o QA antigo passe a receber suas próprias atualizações.
Nenhum arquivo comercial do jogo está incluído.

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 7
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 7

This QA build targets startup hangs on the AYN Thor and Retroid Pocket 5.

- Android now keeps the boot frontend and startup movies on the complete emulated presentation path.
- Native Vulkan pipeline compilation waits until the game has actually queued world content.
- A false boot-time gameplay signal can no longer switch the following EA movie into native loading mode.
- A four-second watchdog completes only the first continuously stuck frontend movie. Later career movies are not affected.
- The stable app and stable update channel remain unchanged.

Use the System Driver first. Fully close the QA app between attempts and test at least five cold launches. On a successful test, confirm that you reached gameplay. On a failed test, attach the launcher diagnostics and full log to the existing device issue.

The APK includes no game data.

## Português do Brasil

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6

This QA build targets an intermittent early-boot hang reported on the Retroid Pocket 5.

The failed QA 5 diagnostic showed a live audio thread but no first presentation, native pipeline creation, scene target, or crash. The guest render thread stopped immediately after its first offscreen 2D captures.

QA 6 tightens the boot capture boundary:

- Only the four verified 2D vertex layouts and three supported primitive types are accepted.
- Individual and per-frame 2D payloads have conservative size limits.
- Invalid transient draw state is rejected before reading guest memory.
- The first twelve guest frames now log capture begin and completion markers.

Install QA 6 over the previous QA app, keep the System Driver selected, fully close the app between attempts, and test at least five launches. Attach diagnostics from any failed launch.

The stable app and stable update channel are unchanged. The APK includes no game data.

## Português do Brasil

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5

This is an opt-in diagnostic build that installs over earlier **Skate 3 QA** builds and preserves QA app data.

## RP5 intermittent black-screen fix

QA 4 proved that the Retroid Pocket 5 can render the Quality profile's 1280x720 scene target, but testers reported that startup only succeeded roughly half the time.

The QA 4 profile copied Performance's visible feature settings, but one internal pipeline gate still used the profile number. Quality therefore compiled optional outline, spline, and shadow shader families even though those features were disabled. Cold and partially warmed shader caches could take different startup paths.

QA 5 fixes the mismatch:

- The 1280x720 Quality target remains enabled.
- The pipeline builder now follows the active lean-scene flag instead of assuming every Quality profile needs the full optional PSO set.
- Renderer installation applies the same defensive lean-feature guard.
- The startup log must report `lean Android set` for this QA Quality profile.
- Stable v2.0.17 and its update channel remain unchanged.

## RP5 test

1. Install QA 5 directly over QA 4.
2. Keep the System Driver selected.

- About 40 GB free during setup (about 19 GB after)
- Your own game dump, version **1.4.3**: either the decrypted RomFS + ExeFS, or the base game (XCI/NSP) + the 1.4.3 update NSP + `prod.keys`

1.7 updates often. Now you don't need a new instance for every build: instance card → **⋮** → **Update the game**. Mods, saves and settings stay where they are. Side menu or bottom bar → **Workshop**: RimWorld's Workshop with Steam's own search and filters. Tap **↓** on any mod or collection, then **Download**. No Steam login needed.

## English

**New**
- Upscaling to your screen resolution now uses AMD FSR 1 instead of GSR: a cleaner, sharper picture (#44). With sharpening on, it sharpens after upscaling, at the screen resolution.
- Experimental: SGSR 2, a temporal upscaler. It builds the picture from several frames at your screen resolution, for finer detail on edges and distant objects. Two options: at the normal 3D resolution, or at 75 % 3D resolution for more FPS.
- The gear (⚙) has one choice "Upscale to screen resolution": Off / FSR 1 / SGSR 2 / SGSR 2 at 3D 75 %. If you had the old upscale box on, you get FSR 1.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `DOOM-Mobile-v0.5.6-arm64-android10.apk`.

**Новое**
- Масштабирование до разрешения экрана теперь работает через AMD FSR 1 вместо GSR: картинка чище и чётче (#44). С включённой резкостью она применяется после увеличения, уже на разрешении экрана.
- Экспериментально: SGSR 2, временной апскейлер. Собирает картинку из нескольких кадров в разрешении экрана — тоньше детали на краях и вдали. Два варианта: при обычном разрешении 3D или при 75 % для большего FPS.

releases.body:
Faster drawing on Mali and PowerVR.

## English

**Improved**
- Mali and PowerVR phones: the lighter way of drawing from the test build 0.2.11-test4 is now in the release (#4). The GPU skips saving and reloading parts of the frame nobody needs and waits less between drawing steps. Testers on Helio G99 and Dimensity 7050 went from about 30 to 45–60 fps. Nothing changes on Snapdragon (Adreno).
- Everything from 0.2.22 stays: camera zoom-out, LAN play, the newer drivers.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.23-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Улучшено**
- Телефоны на Mali и PowerVR: более лёгкая отрисовка из тестовой сборки 0.2.11-test4 теперь в релизе (#4). Видеокарта не сохраняет и не перечитывает ненужные части кадра и меньше ждёт между этапами отрисовки. У тестеров на Helio G99 и Dimensity 7050 было около 30 fps, стало 45–60. На Snapdragon (Adreno) ничего не меняется.
- Всё из 0.2.22 на месте: отдаление камеры, игра по локальной сети, новые драйверы.

releases.name: v0.2.22
releases.body:
Camera zoom-out, smoother frame delivery.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Camera zoom-out" (100–140 %, changes live): moves the camera back to show more around the hero, at the same angle; the interface keeps its size (#31). 100 % = as on the Switch, about 120 % = as far as on the PC. More of the world on the screen means more GPU load.

**Improved**
- Frames are handed to the screen on a separate thread, so the game's main graphics thread has more time for the next frame. This helps most where the CPU is the limit (a hot phone, slower CPUs). If this ever makes the game crash, the port switches it off by itself after the second such crash.

releases.name: beta 0.4
releases.body:
new update fellas:D this one brings more optimization and bug fixes

Mobile Odyssey 0.4 (beta)

There are two APKs. odyssey-0.4.apk is for most phones (ARMv8.2 or newer). odyssey-0.4-armv8.0.apk is for phones with older processors (ARMv8.0 or 8.1), and the launcher tells you if you need it. Both install over 0.3, and your save and settings stay

added Frame generation: makes an extra frame after each real one, so the game shows 60 frames a second while running at 30. It looks smoother but with the latency of 30. You can set it to Off, On or Auto in the launcher or the in-game menu. Auto only turns it on when your phone can't hold 60 but can keep up with frame generation. The motion comes from the game's own camera and objects, so the extra frames line up well with the real ones. This ran pretty well for me but might be troublesome for older phones, so use Fast quality for it to run a bit better.

Frame generation also has a quality setting. High gives Mario, enemies and other moving objects their own motion. Fast follows only the camera and is meant for slower GPUs

releases.name: beta 3.0
releases.body:
Beta 0.3

This update focuses on speed. On my Galaxy S24 Ultra (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3) Cascade now runs at about 58-60 fps, a pretty good improvement from about 44 in 0.2. On a tester’s Xiaomi with a Dimensity 8300 (Mali-G615) it runs at about 40 fps, fairly stable, with no graphical issues. Your results will likely be different, since it depends a lot on your phone.

What’s new:

Mali phones should see one of the biggest changes: the GPU doesnt sit idle waiting for the CPU anymore, so the game uses about 1 GB less memory now

A new “Preparing graphics” progress bar on game starts, instead of the frozen Joy-Con screen. (as always this will take a hot second if its your first launch, give it a minute to build the cache, and any launch after that should be MUCH faster.

the new Steady game speed:D, replacement of the original 30 fps option,now its  an option that keeps the game at normal speed at ANY fps below 60 fps. This means you can run the game at any fps and the game will NOT run in slow motion, as long as you enable it.
(its still recomended that you cap the fps to something you can consistantly hit)

releases.name: beta 0.2
releases.body:
the second release, big imrpvoement for the 60 fps mode, and Mali phones finally look right.

**Performance (my S24 Ultra, phone's own driver)**
- 60 fps mode: 60 fps in small and medium areas, 40-45ish in some heavy areas
- 30 fps mode: full speed, holds 30 most of the time

**What's new**
- Much better fps in the 60 fps mode in my tests, though the picture gets softer when the game lowers its render size
- Mali visual errors fixed on the one phone we've tested so far (thanks u/CAPELINI_W). Other Mali phones are untested
- New default settings on fresh installs. They run faster but make the phone warmer

**Updating from 0.1?** Install it over 0.1. Your old settings stay, so to get the speedup set these in Graphics: Presentation **Mailbox**, CPU boost **Always**, Custom scale **100%**, Anti-aliasing **FXAA**, Sharpening **75%**. The first start rebuilds the shaders, so expect one slow load.

You still need your own copy of the game (1.0.0) and `prod.keys`.

Thanks to u/zzzarathustra-dev ([Power Moon Recomp](https://gitlab.com/zzzarathustra-dev/power-moon-recomp)) and peiikai ([LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)) for the findings and optimizations we borrowed.

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.15
releases.body:
- Restored the original pre-WebView native Android launcher and its `javac`/`d8`/`aapt2` packaging, removing the rejected Compose/Web presentation stack without changing game settings, drivers, mods, saves, touch editing, updates, or the diagnostic-tour gesture. A native **Diagnostics** screen retains read-only logs and factual About/device information.
- Matched SDL2 Java and native sources at 2.30.9 and added source, compiled-class, native-library provenance, and signed-APK byte checks for the reported startup version mismatch. The corrected artifact subsequently reached gameplay in user testing; controlled performance and broad-device outcomes remain separate questions.
- Added default helicopter **DESCEND** (`V`), an independent numbered **123** touch pad, and **ABC** paged PC keyboard input through SDL. Existing custom-layout indices and Extra buttons behavior are preserved. Added optional fixed Landscape/Reverse recovery while keeping Auto orientation by default.

releases.name: heroes-v-0.8.1-dev-eda317d2
releases.body:
# Heroes V for Android 0.8.1-dev

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1.

- Added original loading artwork, launcher shortcuts for each edition, and frame-rate caps at the screen refresh rate or one-half or one-third of it.
- Added optional army split buttons for moving one creature, splitting a stack in half, or distributing it evenly. Improved recruitment number entry, first-load console focus, and scaled hero and construction layouts.
- Fixed profile creation, shadow redraw after deferred textures load, OpenGL ES MSAA depth and stencil, and font sampling with bicubic filtering and FSR.

Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code: 14.

This APK was built before the town army row fixes in the release source commit. The later fixes are present in the source.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.8-dev
releases.body:
Speeds up AI turns and dense OpenGL ES map views, improves graphics and saves, and restores optional DXVK/Turnip rendering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.8-dev` / code `13`, signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.7-dev:

- Enable **Fast AI turn** by default. AI estimates avoid repeatedly serializing and checksumming the map's object-name table during rollbacks. Restored entries are checked; a mismatch disables the shortcut for the process. The original path is used after the first network socket opens. Find the switch under **Settings > Additional > Controls**, between Split zones and Order confirmation. This speeds up calculations, not hero animations or AI difficulty.
- Grow the OpenGL ES upload ring when consecutive frames outgrow it, avoiding repeated per-draw allocations in dense adventure views.
- Move common DLL code into `libhomm5_common.so`, saving about 43 MB after all three engines have been unpacked. Add native vertex, lighting, battle-grid and byte-compatible deflate paths.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.7-dev
releases.body:
Adds native battle route previews, optional order confirmation and contextual alternative-attack tips, and fixes save-list refresh and repeated streaming audio. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.7-dev` / code `12`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.6-dev:

- Preview movement paths and destination cells before issuing a battle order. Paths follow the original prepared command, preserving obstacle detours, terrain height and flight paths. Strike and Return shows separate outgoing and returning lanes. Route previews are enabled by default and work independently of confirmation.
- Add optional battle order confirmation. Taps and gestures select movement, melee attacks, shots or spells; a separate button above the right-side action panel executes the selected order. Wait and Defend retain their immediate buttons. Confirmation is disabled by default.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.6-dev
releases.body:
Fixes Sanctuary-related AI turn stalls and improves touch controls, camera handling, interface scaling and audio buffering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.6-dev` / code `11`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.5.1-dev:

- Prevent the reproduced AI turn stall with Quick Combat enabled when a hero is sheltered in a Sanctuary. Exclude that hero from quick resolution while preserving the global setting and other heroes' behavior.
- Cancel spell or creature-ability targeting with a two-finger tap, including over the interface. On the adventure map, the same gesture stops a moving hero.
- Restore the original camera with a three-finger tap in adventure, battle, deployment and town, including over the interface. Deployment accounts for the current phase and player side.
- Skip the town camera flyby with the first tap on the town view, without selecting a building.
- Show the native attack or shot icon above the damage and retaliation forecast, including when the ordinary touch cursor is disabled.
- Correct the font scale of new multiplayer-list rows after filter changes.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.5.1-dev
releases.body:
Fixes profile creation freezes and duplicate Android Recents cards. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.5.1-dev` / code `10`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.5-dev:

- Wait for actual GPU completion during the original graphics autodetection in all three editions, preventing permanent freezes when creating a profile. The original calibration and its measured results are preserved.
- Keep the launcher and all three game editions in one Android task. Remove stale edition tasks from earlier builds so Recents shows one card and returns to the latest open game. Edition processes, settings and saves remain separate.
- Add regression checks for the GPU calibration barrier, edition mappings and legacy task cleanup.

Requirements: Android 8.0 or later, ARM64, OpenGL ES 3.2 and supported original game files supplied by the player. Heroes V 1.6 and Hammers of Fate 2.1 use a complete GOG Gold installation; keep Tribes of the East 3.1 separate.

releases.name: v0.1.5
releases.body:
- Mali GPUs: the game now gets an NVIDIA card instead of an ATI one, which fixes the too-dark ground and shadows (#13). If you made `sporere.ini` with `fake_gpu` for testing, you can delete it.
- Holding the stick no longer blocks the camera: other fingers work while the stick is held (#22).
- **Cheats** button in the menu: opens/closes Spore's cheat console (type with ⌨, e.g. `addDNA`).
- Tribe and civilization: hold a finger until it buzzes, then drag — drags with the left button (place buildings from the palette). A quick drag still moves the map, hold and release is still a right click (#23).

`spore.apk` — Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones). `spore-vk11.apk` — older GPUs with Vulkan 1.1 only.

releases.name: v0.1.4
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Backspace on the on-screen keyboard works (it did nothing when the field already had text from the game, like a planet name).

**New**
- Space: an LMB button. With it on, holding a finger holds the left mouse button instead of flying: beams, abduction, terraforming tools. Turn it off to fly again.
- The FPS counter can be moved in Settings → Layout and has a dark outline, so it reads over the game's UI. By default it sits inside the picture, not under the camera cutout.
- Screen 16:9 / Safe area: the bars at the sides are black (pixels off on OLED screens).

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Space stage: the ship flies now. Hold a finger where you want to go, or push the stick (it sends the arrow keys in space). The cause was a bug in how the game code is translated for Android, so other odd behaviour may be gone too.
- Galactic Adventures is detected again: the menu item is back, and the game no longer closes on start after its options were saved.
- Settings → Screen 16:9 and Safe area no longer squash the picture.
- The settings panel fits on short screens.
- Adreno 7xx: `enable_tp_ubwc_flag_hint=1` is on by default (flicker in screen recordings). `turnip_features` in `sporere.ini` sets `FD_DEV_FEATURES`.
- The game is also found one folder deeper (`Spore/SPORE/...`).

**New**
- Your own Vulkan driver: put a `.so`, or a `.zip` from Adreno Tools driver releases, into `Spore/driver/`.
- Logs: on every start the last run's logs are copied to `Spore/logs/`. Attach them when you report a bug.

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Older phones (Snapdragon 6xx and other Cortex-A53/A73 chips) no longer fail on start with `libmain_v80.so not found`.
- Saves now live in `Spore/UserData` next to the game files, so any file manager can reach them. Old saves move there on the first start. If some save files can't be read (for example, another app copied them in), the game lists them instead of closing.
- The on-screen keyboard types into the game (planet names and other text fields).
- Adreno 8xx: the newer bundled Turnip is tried first and UBWC is off by default. This fixes the noise instead of the picture. `turnip_debug` in `sporere.ini` sets `TU_DEBUG`.

**New**
- Settings → Screen: Full / 16:9 / Safe area. Safe area keeps the image clear of the rounded corners and the camera cutout. It applies after a restart.
- Editor: ▲/▼ buttons act as the mouse wheel. Tap a part, then press ▲/▼ to resize it.
- Space: the WASD stick is shown by default. W/S fly forward and back.

releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body:
**Which APK**
- `spore.apk`: for GPUs with Vulkan 1.3 (most phones, Adreno 6xx and newer, Mali G7x and newer).
- `spore-vk11.apk`: for older GPUs whose driver only has Vulkan 1.1 (older Mali, PowerVR). New and barely tested: please report how it goes.

You still need your own copy of Spore (GOG 3.1.0.22) in `Internal storage/Spore`, see the [README](https://github.com/VinTeRuS/spore-re#installing).

**Fixes**
- Black screen on Adreno 8xx (8 Elite / 8 Elite Gen 5): the bundled Turnip driver wasn't recognized there and the port fell back to the stock driver, which hangs (#2).
- Space stage: you can fly now. Hold or drag a finger to fly toward it, two fingers turn the camera, +/- buttons change altitude (#3).
- Crash on start after copying a save into the app's folder (#1).
- Game language: Settings -> Language (all languages of the GOG release). By default it follows the phone's language, before it was always Russian.
- Phones that ran the app at a 30 Hz screen refresh now ask for the fastest mode, so the 60 FPS limit can actually reach 60.

**Also since 0.1.0**
- Tribe and civilization: drag moves the map, two fingers turn the camera, hold a finger to give an order.
