releases.name: 0.2.5-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
A small update.

### Fixed

- **A texture that the game uses twice in one draw is loaded once.** It used to be prepared
  twice when it was out of date. This only happens while an area loads, a few times each, so
  loading does slightly less work. Frame rates in play are unchanged.
  - Checked in Circle Tower, Denerim's market, Orzammar's commons, the ruined temple of the
    Urn and Lothering's chantry, on the AYN Thor.
  - The fix comes from the Xenia Edge emulator project.

### Installing

- **From 0.2.0-alpha to 0.2.4-alpha:** the launcher installs this update under **Launch Dragon
  Age**. No Build again is needed. Your saves, game data and settings stay.
- **From 0.1.9-alpha or earlier:** the launcher installs it too, and then shows **Build again**.
  Choose it once (about eight minutes).

releases.name: 0.2.4-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### Faster

- **Up to 7% more frames a second, with nothing to set.** The renderer copies less between its
  render targets: when a draw is about to cover an area completely, the old picture there is no
  longer copied in first. The picture is unchanged.
  - At the King's Camp, the game went from 42.0 to 44.8 frames a second.
  - With FSR 3.1 Balanced, it went from 34.0 to 35.3.

### New: Eco shading

**Options -> Visual -> Eco shading** trades a little sharpness in the 3D scene for speed: the
scene's colours are worked out once for each two pixels (**Light**) or each block of four
(**Strong**). It is off by default and takes effect from the next start.
- **The HUD, text and the edges of leaves and grass stay sharp.** So do shadows and the
  post-processing.
- **Light** looks all but the same as off. **Strong** softens fine textures such as stone
  and cloth.
- **It needs a GPU driver with variable-rate shading.** The Thor's own driver has it. On a
  driver without it, the option changes nothing.

**Measured on the AYN Thor: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740), Android 13**, the system's driver:

| Eco shading | FSR 3.1 off | FSR 3.1 Balanced |
|---|---|---|

releases.name: 0.2.3-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### New: other Vulkan drivers (experimental)

You can now run the game on a Vulkan driver package other than your handheld's own: the
Adreno driver packages (`.zip`) made for AdrenoTools, as Android emulators use. This is an
experiment, closed away by default (issue #4).
- The handheld's own driver is never changed, and choosing **System** puts everything back.
- The game is tested on the system's driver. Another driver can be faster, slower, draw
  wrongly or not start.

**Loading a driver package:**
1. Put the driver package (`.zip`) somewhere on your handheld, for example in Download.
2. In the launcher, open the **Visual** tab and set **Experimental** to **Show**.
3. On **Import a driver package**, choose **Choose…** and pick the `.zip`. It is imported and
   chosen under **Vulkan driver**.
4. Close the app completely and open it again: a driver takes effect from the app's next
   start.

To go back, set **Vulkan driver** to **System** (from the next start too), or use **Remove
the chosen driver**, which deletes the package and what the app kept for it.

releases.name: 0.2.2-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### Changed

- **Much better standby battery.** You can close the lid or lock the screen with Dragon Age
  open and come back to almost the same charge. On the AYN Thor, an hour of closed-lid standby
  with the game open took the battery from 100% to 99%.
  - Before, about half the times you closed the lid during play, the game kept a whole CPU core
    busy until you came back. That core now waits with the rest of the game.
  - The app also stops its background work while the game is put away: the sound, the second
    screen and the on-screen controller.
  - The launcher open on its own now uses no CPU at all.
- Playing is unchanged: the same frame rate, and the game picks up where you left it.

### Measured: CPU while the screen is locked

On the AYN Thor, as a share of one CPU core:

| With the screen locked | 0.2.1-alpha | 0.2.2-alpha |
|---|---|---|
| In play | up to 94% (about half the times) | under 2%, every time |
| At the title screen | 29% | 1.4% |
| The launcher, no game started | 7.7% | 0% |

### Installing

- **From 0.2.0-alpha or 0.2.1-alpha:** the launcher installs this update under **Launch Dragon

releases.name: 0.2.1-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### New

- **On-screen controller size**, on the Game tab of Settings: from 50% to 150% (100% as
  before). Smaller shows more of the game; bigger is easier to hit. Controls near an edge move
  in as they grow, so none is cut off. It changes at once, in the game too.
- **Adjust on-screen controls layout**, on the Game tab: drag each on-screen control - the
  buttons, the D-pad, the sticks - where you want it. **Done**, small at the top, saves the layout
  and takes you back to the settings (the controller's A, B or Start does too); **Reset** puts
  everything back where it started. The game waits while you place them, and nothing you touch
  reaches it.

### Changed

- **The launcher and the settings are on tabs:**
  - **Launcher** - Launch, your files, Build, Saves, Mods and About (before the game only).
  - **Visual** - frame rate, resolution, upscaling, frame generation, post-processing and the
    rest of the picture.
  - **Audio** - Headphones and Volume boost.
  - **Performance** - Heat guard and the Performance tab/overlay.
  - **Game** - button prompts, intro logos, the autosave, the second screen, the on-screen
    controller and the cheats.

releases.name: v0.1.10
releases.body:
Character list fix for modded classes, game folder on an SD card.

## English

**Fixes**
- The game closed when you chose "Change Character" or "Manage Characters" in the main menu while one of your characters was of a class added by a mod. Now both screens open; such a character shows the Outlander's portrait in the list.

**New**
- The game folder can now be on an SD card or a USB drive, not only in Download on internal storage. The app looks for `Download/Torchlight2Mobile` (and `Torchlight2Mobile` at the root) on every storage, internal first. You can also pick the folder yourself under **Game folder** in the ⚙ menu, or on the error screen when no game files are found. A card is slower than internal storage, so levels load longer from it. Thanks to danjaniell for this one!

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.10-arm64-android10.apk`.

releases.body:
# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders, SDL3.dll and vcruntime140.dll beside it. If you're updating, unzip over your old folder; your saves and settings stay.
- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over the previous version. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Many more controllers on Windows.** PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro, 8BitDo and most other controllers now work over USB or Bluetooth, read through SDL3, alongside Xbox ones. Buttons go by position: the bottom face button is A (cross on a PlayStation controller). With more than one connected, they all control the game.
- **Aiming with the stick.** Where the game uses the Wii Remote's pointer, the right stick now moves it slowly near the middle, for aiming, and much faster at full tilt, for turning.

## Known issues

- The Wii Remote speaker, pointer and Nunchuk aren't supported; the game doesn't need them.

## What's new

- **Bring your Wii or Dolphin save.** On the save files screen, Options > Gameplay > Import Wii save takes a Wii's `data.bin` straight from its SD card, the files in Dolphin's save folder, or a zip of them. The save you had is kept beside it, in a `data before import` folder. **Export Wii save** writes your save as a zip, to import on another PC or phone or unzip into Dolphin.
- **Skip movies.** Hold + (P, or Start on a controller) to skip a story movie.
- **Smoother on Android.** Scenery the game keeps several copies of is now drawn from one: on an AYN Thor, graphics memory fell from about 320 MB to 185 MB, and stutters (frames over 20 ms) from 20–40 to 5–9 in a two-minute run.

releases.name: v1.1: download the APK
releases.body:
**Download the APK, pick your ISO, play.** No PC needed any more.

1. Install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) on your device.
2. Put an ISO of your own **USA** disc of *Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII* on the device.
3. Start the app and tap **Import from ISO…** on the *Game folder* page (keep the bundled Turnip driver if the GPU driver page comes up). When the import is done, tap **Start game**.

**The first start takes a few minutes, with the progress on screen** (times from the AYN Thor): about 45 s of *Loading…*, about 45 s of *Preparing shaders* (the game waits; hold START + BACK for 2 s to skip), then about 3.5 minutes of *Compiling the remaining shaders* in the corner of the title, where you can already play (starting the game pauses it until the next start). Attached: a 2-minute video recorded on the AYN Thor, both screens at 60 fps, in 1080p and a smaller 720p version. Screen recording costs some frame rate, so judge performance by the README's numbers, not by this video.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.5-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4.1-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; compatible Adreno devices can use Turnip.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.3-dev
releases.body:
The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 0.2-dev
releases.body:
The second release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 adds optional texture conversion, more flexible touch controls, OpenSpy compatibility and save/profile fixes.

### Changes

- Added optional ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion in the launcher, including games played directly from stored ZIP archives. Original packages are retained; runtime DXT decoding remains available for cache misses and mods.
- Added a touch layout editor to move, resize and hide individual controls. Hold the on-screen Pause button to open it; a short tap opens the original pause menu.
- Expanded touch settings with a fixed joystick, weapon tap/swipe selection, separate weapon bar/wheel sizes, control visibility, movement while holding primary fire and horizontal gyro reversal.
- Added OpenSpy service and authentication compatibility, and fixed a registry-call crash during online play.
- Prevented startup defaults from overwriting saved profiles and campaign progress before sign-in. Fixed creation of save directories beneath virtual ZIP folders.

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.0
releases.body:
A launcher you can use from the couch: game art, controller navigation and a
full-screen mode.

- **Launcher:** game art on the library cards and the game page (the
  user's own ES-DE media, else the console port's image from libretro's
  thumbnail server, fetched once); the board, year, publisher and status as
  icons; on narrow screens (a tablet held upright) the sidebar becomes an
  icon rail and the content gets the width. Refresh reloads the art.
- **Launcher:** controller navigation: the d-pad or stick moves between
  controls, A plays the focused game, X opens its page, B goes back. While
  a controller is in use the focused control stands out (the others fade)
  and stays in the middle of the page as it scrolls.
- **Launcher:** full-screen mode: the button by the logo slides the menu
  away and the library takes the width. A controller switches to it; left
  from the page's edge or Y shows the menu over the page, and going back to
  the page hides it.
- **Launcher on Android:** runs at the display's fastest refresh rate
  (90 Hz on the test tablet); the games keep 60.

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.0
releases.body:
Two optional settings are available under **Graphics** in the Android launcher. Both default to off. Select **Play** to save them and fully restart the game to apply changes.

- **Low graphics** caps shadows at the 512 setting, reduces objects rendered into distant shadow maps, limits anisotropic filtering to 2×, and disables real-time reflections and radial blur.
- **Reduced output resolution (75%)** scales each side of the final Vulkan output to 75% of the window, including the HUD. Use it independently of Low graphics. The HUD may look softer at this setting.

Build was checked in gameplay on **POCO F5 (Adreno 725)** with both switches enabled. The log confirmed real-time reflections were skipped and the game rendered at 1800×810 in a 2400×1080 window. This release uses the same tested native library. Performance and compatibility on Mali still need device testing. If you try it on Mali, please include your device model, graphics settings and `log.txt` with feedback.

Android 10 or newer, ARM64 and Vulkan. Version **0.3.0 (code 16)** uses the existing package and release signing key.

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.2.9
releases.body:
**23 additional gameplay options in Options → Game Settings.** Android 10 (API 29) or newer, ARM64 and Vulkan. Version **0.2.9 (code 15)** uses the existing Android package and release signing key.

Open **Game Settings** from the main menu or pause menu. Highlight a patch to read its description at the bottom of the screen. Names and descriptions are available in all six in-game menu languages. The 23 new switches default to off, and settings are saved when you leave Options.

## Gameplay patches

- **Movement and gauges.** Snowboard air control, Wall Push Fix, Sonic's Action Gauge and Tails' Flight Gauge.
- **Sonic and Homing Attack.** Steering during Tornado Attack and after Homing Attack, restored homing flips and gravity, faster repeated Homing Attacks for Sonic and Shadow, and two options for Sliding Attack speed and duration.
- **Shadow.** Exit vehicles at any time, use standard Homing Attack in place of Chaos Attack, extend Chaos Blast range, and restore the Chaos Boost jump and Chaos Spear flips.

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.2.8
releases.body:
**New in-game Game Settings menu with two gameplay patches.** Android 10 (API 29) or newer, ARM64 and Vulkan. Version **0.2.8 (code 14)** uses the regular Android package and signing key, so it can update v0.2.7 in place.

## What we changed in the Android port

- Added **Options → Game Settings** to the main menu and pause menu. Both patches have independent switches, localised in the six languages supported by the in-game options menu.
- Enabled both options by default. Existing settings are read from the same keys in `config.toml`. Changes take effect without restarting and are saved when you leave Options.
- Exposed the existing **Max Speed Air Control** patch and backported **Wall Jump Fix** from the original MarathonRecomp.

## Gameplay patches and credits

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.2.7
releases.body:
**Separate on-screen D-pad and three fixes from the original MarathonRecomp.** ARM64, Android 10 (API 29) or newer, Vulkan. Version **0.2.7 (code 13)** uses the same signing key and can update v0.2.6 in place.

## Changes

- **Separate D-pad.** The on-screen D-pad works alongside the left analog stick, so you can move and switch Sonic’s gems at the same time. Move or resize it under **Controls → Arrange touch controls**. Existing layouts keep their saved positions and get the D-pad in its default position. Thanks to **foxyexe143** for reporting the missing separate control.
- **Radical Train progression.** The mirror can open when Sonic already has the Bounce Bracelet but the mission’s shop-purchase flag is missing. The Android port limits the check to the mirror’s Lua event. Original fix by **Isaac Marovitz (IsaacMarovitz)**. [PR #462](https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp/pull/462) · [commit b91b317](https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp/commit/b91b317372e47c3bf477ef723b41200d1954fb78)

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.2.6
releases.body:
**Three fixes ported from the original MarathonRecomp.** ARM64, Android 10 (API 29) or newer, Vulkan. Installs over v0.2.5 and keeps your saves. Version **0.2.6 (code 12)**, same signing key.

## Changes and upstream credits

The original fixes were developed in **[sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp](https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp)** by **[squidbus](https://github.com/squidbus)** and **[Hyper (hyperbx)](https://github.com/hyperbx)**. This release brings their work to the Android port; the original authorship and license notices are preserved.

- **ImGui pointer events:** prevent queued pointer positions from receiving the viewport transformation more than once across frames. By **squidbus** — [PR #412](https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp/pull/412), [commit 1248d2d](https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp/commit/1248d2d8d71329ccef76f973c4b3a00a977ed571).

releases.name: OpenSmash Android 0.1.0 (pre-release 2)
releases.body:
Android pre-release of OpenSmash Ultimate, built from commit 9a6f980 on the android-port branch.

**This APK does not contain the game.** Set up the game from your own Switch files on the device: base game (.nsp or .xci), update 13.0.4 / 13.0.5, prod.keys, and optional add-on content (.nsp or .xci). The port is still under test; most devices have not been tried.

What is new since pre.1:
- Setup and add-on import accept .xci as well as .nsp.
- Controller panel: both volume buttons together open it over the launcher and the game; it connects Switch 1 Pro (Bluetooth Classic) and Switch 2 Pro (through Procon2 Bridge).

Requirements: arm64 Android with Vulkan 1.3 (a custom Turnip driver can be installed from the launcher). See docs/ANDROID.md.

Install: enable installing from unknown sources, then open OpenSmash.apk. It is signed with a debug key, so updates need the same signing key.

SHA-256 of OpenSmash.apk: `6923df236a54c58d9d308ef726efb5f099bf0e8d95dad692c6c2bfdab2b8b5d5`

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.7
releases.body:
- 触控（Android）：修复物品栏滑动与触控按键冲突——从仅落入按键隐形热区（拇指扩大的判定范围）的位置开始的滑动，现改为驱动物品栏或狩技面板；可见的按键区域仍保持原优先级（#9）。
- 狩技面板（Android）：修复第三行点击识别在画面密集时丢失——每帧猎技部件不再受 32 片上限影响，行按游戏坐标预分组，触控区域与显示同步（#9）。
- 应用图标更换为狩技／武器类型徽章面板（Windows、Linux、Android 及更新器），矢量源 `extras/icon/mhgu-relink.svg`。
- 游戏代码库自 0.2.6 起无变化，兼容 ID 仍为 `3bfb26af6be3424a`；旧 `libmhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.dll` 继续可用。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.6
releases.body:
- 奖励箱（结算画面）：修复「按住 A 连续发送」在 0.2.5 中失效——初始化钩子在版本合并时丢失，现已恢复接线。结算界面按住 A 逐件把奖励送入道具箱，松手即停，单点仍只送一件，走游戏原生按键。
- 集会所村庄任务：补上离开集会所／酒场时释放村庄任务文本包的每帧检查（uScheduler 更新处，0.2.5 合并时同样丢失）。此前从集会所或酒场开村庄任务，文本包会被带进任务，导致帕利科半透明白模、地形变黑并在换区时崩溃（2026-11-13 报告，仅中文版）。
- 兼容 ID 更新为 3bfb26af6be3424a：`libmhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.dll` 需随本版用 `tools/build_game.py`／`build_game_windows.py` 重新生成，旧游戏代码库会被启动时明确拒绝。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.5
releases.body:
- 内置 Forge 升级到 2.0.0：新增 NVN 回调/纹理接口、按内容校验资源，并保留旧 1.5.1 资源。
- 自动跑步（Android）：收刀动画结束前不注入 R，修复勇气风格特殊纳刀/收刀期间被判定为收刀而触发自动 R；新增“完全收刀”判定，读取游戏在动画结束后才清除的状态字节。已完全收刀时按住 Y（道具键）不会拦截跑步；村庄、集会所等没有猎人对象的场景恢复可用。
- 右摇杆：修复显示右摇杆后无法转视角（原生相机处理被误跳过）；默认隐藏且隐藏时不接收触摸，放出来后按原生右摇杆转动镜头。
- Android 控制页新增“手柄按键提示”（Switch／Xbox／PlayStation）：默认 Switch 使用游戏原版，Xbox 与 PlayStation 由本程序重绘游戏内提示纹理（面键字母/图形、LB/RB/LT/RT、L1/R1/L2/R2）；手柄与键盘提示统一为黑字白底，提高对比度。设置菜单的“Button icons”仍单独控制自身图标。
- 设置菜单重新分区：显示、画面与音频、控制、网络、杂项、菜单选项按用途分组（音频、语音聊天、画面、HDR、手柄、键鼠、触控布局、镜头、集会所、跨平台、外观、通用、存档、应用）；`加号 + 减号` 与确认键归入菜单选项，Android 存档导入/导出移到“存档数据”。
- 汉化统一：Hub 统一为“集会所/集会所服务器”，怪物生命统一为“体力/体力倍率”，并统一道具、回避、作弊码、低配模式、标签页、涂瓶、猎人等级等术语；修正缺失文件提示的占位符顺序、RyuLdn 口令、跨平台说明和 Android 导入界面的“金手指”残留。
- 狩技触屏锁定：右摇杆型狩技点按注入的短暂轴输入不再被当作手动视角，锁定跟随不会中断；物理右摇杆仍按原意暂停跟随。
- Forge 插件回调串行化：`forge_onNvnRender` 在呈现线程、其余回调在更新线程，统一加锁避免 Forge 2 插件跨线程竞态；文件适配器导出名也纳入回归断言。
- Android 内置 Forge 2.0.0 资源按内容校验修复：长度相同但内容损坏的文件也会重写；补充西语“暂停调和”，并约束 Forge 纹理视图拷贝大小。
- 调和一键连续：触屏点击一次“调和”后连续进行，再点原来的调和位置可随时暂停，已开始的一次正常完成；连续过程中不反复显示“调和／停止”确认框，保留原生结果动画。首次新配方的结果确认自动衔接；未手动暂停时，材料不足或数量已满会停止并关闭弹窗，返回配方列表。取消、停止、导航、切换菜单、布局编辑或切后台立即撤销自动输入，保留原生按键和物品数量判定。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.4
releases.body:
MHGU Relink 0.2.4

同步上游与超宽屏更新。

## 主要变化
- 同步 MHGURecomp 0.17.5：5.1 环绕声、奖励箱按住 A、Android UI 线程修复、相机/菜单/网络与 16:10 HUD 修复。
- 超宽屏：画面比例预设（16:10、16:9、21:9、64:27、43:18、24:10、32:10、32:9、自定义），HUD 位置 16:9/21:9/32:9/Edges，相机比例同步，宽屏菜单整组布局，Forge 自由绘制映射。
- Android 同样开放画面比例与 HUD 位置，适合 21:9 / 21:10 带鱼屏；保存后重启游戏生效。
- Rust hub：Hunter Search 与普通 Hub 分列表，新增 `-list-search-max`（默认 6）与 Web 设置，避免 Hunter Search 挤掉 Join Hub 的位置。
- AutoR：改为安卓主线的过边缘 R 手势；收刀时滑过 1.60 倍摇杆半径按住原生 R，回推到 1.45 倍以内停止。
- 布局编辑器：地图手柄缩小为 260×260，任务内外均可编辑；窄屏提示文字不再越界崩溃。
- 清理陀螺仪残留代码与测试。

## 下载

- Windows：`mhgu-relink-0.2.4-windows-x86_64.zip`
- Linux（Arch 系）：`mhgu-relink-0.2.4-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`
- Linux hub：`mhgu-hub-0.2.4-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`
- Android：`mhgu-relink-0.2.4-android.apk`

发行包不包含游戏代码。请使用你自己的 MHGU 1.4.0 `exefs` / `romfs` 生成 `mhgugame` 库；Android 需要匹配的 `libmhgugame.so` 和 `.id`。

完整的 0.2.4 变更见仓库 `CHANGELOG.md`。

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev adds experimental native Vulkan rendering, touch construction improvements, and a smaller APK.

## Rendering and compatibility

- Select Native Vulkan alongside DXVK in the launcher. Compatible devices are offered Native Vulkan on their first DXVK launch. If the native renderer crashes, the launcher reports the problem and selects DXVK for the next launch. Native Vulkan uses FSR 1 for upscaling.
- Use PanVK with either renderer on supported Mali devices. Import a custom driver from a ZIP or an ARM64 `.so`, or restore the bundled driver. Fix yellow-tinted snow and buildings under PanVK, fullscreen display artifacts on the Lenovo TB373FU, and missing scout portraits and a stray temperature-indicator arc on Mali-G615.
- Fix bundled Turnip selection and support the Qualcomm system driver on compatible Adreno 830 devices. Improve Vulkan upload synchronization and surface recovery, DXVK fullscreen handling, and diagnostics for stalled frame presentation.

## Touch controls and interface

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Android ARM64 update focused on memory controls, graphics settings, driver management, and crash diagnostics.

## Changes

- Add Auto, Normal, Reduced, and Minimum memory modes. Automatic selection adapts to available device RAM without overwriting saved graphics preferences.
- Show a one-time low-memory warning when Android reports 7.5 GiB of RAM or less.
- Add model detail and building model quality controls, with both defaulting to their lowest levels. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Improve geometry simplification and graphics profile handling, and show output resolution in pixels and percentages.
- Restore normal city updates and rendering while paused by removing forced update suppression and frozen-frame reuse.
- Support landscape and reverse landscape only, including gamepad attachment and the crash monitor.
- Bundle one shared purple-turnip T30 driver for GPU checks and gameplay, with Mesa license text and driver provenance included.
- Add Turnip release browsing and downloads with byte progress and cancellation. Cache verified downloads for offline reuse and allow removal of unused external drivers while preserving the active driver.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Launcher compatibility update for Frostpunk for Android.

## Changes

- Keep the launcher usable when the device or selected renderer cannot run the game.
- Show insufficient Vulkan versions and missing GPU features in the Play card instead of a forced-exit dialog, including when game files are not yet installed.
- Preserve renderer selection and the compatibility checks that guard game startup.
- Update the APK to version `0.1.1-dev`, version code `3`.

## Installation and requirements

Download **Frostpunk-0.1.1-dev.apk** and its **.sha256** file from the assets below.
Install the APK, then select your supported Steam PC game folder or compatible stored ZIP in the launcher. Existing installations can be updated with the same Android signing certificate.

Running the game requires Android 11 or newer, a 64-bit ARM device, a compatible Vulkan 1.3 GPU and driver, and the player's own supported Steam PC game files. Adreno uses Turnip; supported Mali and PowerVR configurations use system Vulkan. An incompatible device can still open and use the launcher.

No original game files, extracted assets, saves, or game-data ZIPs are included in this release.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.1-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Frostpunk ARM64 port for Android with touch controls and Vulkan.

- Native ARM64 execution through static recompilation and a native host runtime.
- D3D11 rendering through DXVK, Turnip on Adreno, and supported system Vulkan on
  Mali and PowerVR.
- Localized GPU compatibility checks before launch.
- Touch camera controls, building placement, roads, keyboard input, and in-game
  port settings when the matching UI resources are present.
- Folder import and direct reads from compatible stored ZIP archives.
- On-device DXT-to-ASTC preparation, quality checks, and launch after conversion.
- PC snow and terrain by default, independent Switch graphics groups, and texture
  quality selection.
- System-language defaults, guarded 200% UI scale, and saved-setting preservation.

Requires Android 11+, compatible ARM64 Vulkan 1.3 hardware, and the supported Steam
PC game files supplied by the player. Original game files and optional extracted
assets are not distributed here. Device and scenario coverage is incomplete;
performance and long-session stability vary. Clean-clone APK reproduction is not
yet provided.

APK: `Frostpunk-0.1-dev.apk`

Package: `com.frostpunk.staticrecomp`

releases.name: LibertyDroid 1.0.0
releases.body:
Primera versión de LibertyDroid: port nativo y no oficial de GTA IV y Episodes from Liberty City (Xbox 360) a Android, con launcher propio.

**Descarga:** `LibertyDroid-1.0.0.apk`, en los archivos de esta versión. El APK trae el código de los juegos recompilado a ARM64, pero no sus datos: para jugar hace falta una copia legal propia del juego, que se importa como ISO desde el launcher. Los requisitos y los pasos para compilarlo están en el [README](https://github.com/Jauidev/LibertyDroid#requisitos).

## Qué incluye

- Launcher nativo: importar ISO, elegir juego, perfiles gráficos, drivers en Adreno, copias de partidas, controles y cinco idiomas.
- Recompilación estática de los dos juegos a ARM64 y kernel de Xbox 360 reimplementado.
- Renderizador nativo Vulkan para Mali y Adreno, con Turnip cuando el driver del móvil no basta.
- Sombras estabilizadas al conducir, luces locales en GTA IV y fuentes vectoriales.

## Limitaciones

- Solo admite las ISO de la versión USA, sin actualizaciones.
- El APK es una compilación de depuración, firmada con una clave de desarrollo.

---

releases.name: v0.1.10-beta — automatic app.elf patching
releases.body:
﻿## Changes

- The launcher now checks and applies all 41 supported pp.elf patches automatically when it resumes, after Relinker, and before game startup.
- Patch application verifies the full signature set before writing; 	ools/patch_app_elf.py --check provides a read-only verification mode.
- Added a signature-checked ARM64 LZ4 block decoder hook while preserving the game wrapper and guest allocation behavior.
- Added optional Vulkan robust buffer/image access handling for Mali and per-submit fence tracing for graphics diagnostics.
- Added read-only ELF inventory and profile-correlation tooling with documented limits.

APK: Mewgenics-0.1.10-beta.apk (versionCode 11).

releases.name: v0.1.7-beta - Mali BC texture fallback
releases.body:
## Changes in v0.1.7-beta

- Query Vulkan format support and decode BC1–BC7 texture uploads on devices without support for the source BC format.
- Keep hardware BC sampling unchanged on GPUs that support the requested format.
- Set Android package version to 0.1.7-beta (versionCode 8).
- Include the generated Android manifest when building the signed APK.

The BC fallback is based on the Mali-G720 crash report. Runtime verification on the affected device is still needed.

releases.name: v0.1.6-beta - Mali & MediaTek GPU Support
releases.body:
### Changes in v0.1.6-beta:
* **MediaTek & ARM Mali GPU Support:** Fixed startup crashes on MediaTek (Dimensity, MT6899, etc.) and ARM Mali GPUs (Mali-G720 / Immortalis). Relaxed desktop Vulkan feature requirements (sampleRateShading, depthClamp, drawIndirectFirstInstance, shaderClipDistance) in SDL_GPU backend and enabled compatibility with core Vulkan 1.1+ drivers.
* **Native SDL_GPU Vulkan:** Renders directly on both Qualcomm Adreno and ARM Mali/MediaTek GPUs.
* **Touchpad & Touch fix:** Fixed pointer coordinate translation and mouse simulation.
* **Native PRX Shims:** Native ARM64 implementations for ImeDialog, SaveData, AudioOut, Mouse, VideoOut, UserService, SystemService, Random, Rtc, WebBrowserDialog, NetCtl.

releases.name: v0.1.5-beta - AnyPS5 Mewgenics Android Port
releases.body:
## v0.1.5-Beta

- **Native SDL_GPU Vulkan:** Fixed a Turnip Mesa WSI crash; rendering now runs directly on the Adreno 830 GPU.
- **Audio and stable 60 FPS:** Added a native AAudio backend (48 kHz stereo), a hardware audio clock, and VSync.
- **Color correction:** Enabled a native RGBA swapchain and 1080p buffers; colors now render correctly.
- **Touch controls:** Touch hover shows cat stats without accidental dragging. Long press (350 ms with vibration) picks up and moves a cat; a tap clicks, and two fingers trigger right-click.
- **39 built-in patches:** 1080p canvas, cutscene fix (SWF Atlas 4096), and native TLSF `lzcnt`/`tzcnt` instructions (+17% CPU performance).
- **Glaiel Runtime:** Added a native ARM64 library with GON and libtess2.

# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |
| ADPF-цель / `uclamp.min` | — | — | 8 мс / 512 | 8 мс / 1024 |
| Лимит FPS | 30 | — | — | — |

releases.name: v1.1.5
releases.body:
## Что нового

### Linux — новая платформа
- Порт игры на Linux (x86-64 и aarch64): X11 и Wayland, рендеры OpenGL ES, Vulkan и Zink. Клавиатура, мышь с захватом
  (Ctrl+Alt+M — отпустить или захватить), геймпады с вибрацией и горячим подключением, звук.
- Свой лаунчер `me1-launcher`, повторяющий Android-версию: выбор папки игры, автоподбор настроек под видеокарту,
  графика, моды, DLC, переменные окружения, журнал запуска. До первого кадра игры показывается экран загрузки.
- Разумные значения по умолчанию: Vulkan на дискретной видеокарте, разрешение рабочего стола, без ограничения FPS,
  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

### Сборка
- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.
- Сами находят `msvcr80`, `msvcp80` и `d3dx9_31`: в папке игры, префиксах Proton и Wine, на разделе Windows или
  достают из установщиков `vcredist_x86.exe` и DirectX. Версии DLL проверяются, заглушки Wine отбрасываются.

## Changelog

### Android performance (ADPF)
- Recover from hint-report failures: a failed `APerformanceHintSession_report` now closes the session and clears `attempted`, with the same 60→3600 cycle backoff as session-creation failures. Previously one report failure permanently disabled ADPF.
- Retry session creation indefinitely instead of disabling after 3 transient failures.
- Cross-thread acquire/present cycle validity (window + wall clock only); repeated acquire keeps the earliest start; index is correlation-only.

### Artifacts
- `D2R-Android-port-reportfix-e379477.apk`: standalone ARM64 NativeActivity APK (`--game-run`).

releases.name: v0.6.99
releases.body:
## Changelog

### Android performance (ADPF)
- Retry hint-session creation indefinitely instead of disabling ADPF after 3 transient failures. Runtime log previously showed accepted=0 for all cycles because a permanent `hal_unsupported` flag killed the session; now it backs off (60→3600 cycles) and retries.
- Repeated acquire within a frame keeps the earliest start; index is correlation-only.
- Cross-thread acquire/present cycle validity (window + wall clock only).

### Artifacts
- `D2R-Android-port-adpf-retry-<short sha>.apk`: standalone ARM64 NativeActivity APK (`--game-run`).

releases.name: v0.6.98
releases.body:
## Changelog

### Android performance (ADPF)
- Fix performance-hint cycles never being reported on Android: acquire runs on the guest thread while present/WSI runs on the recording thread, and the old cycle predicate invalidated on thread-ID mismatch, so ADPF never received a report. Cycle validity now depends only on the window + wall clock.
- Repeated acquire within a frame keeps the earliest start instead of invalidating the cycle; acquire index is correlation-only (present clamps slot >=4 to -1).

### Artifacts
- `D2R-Android-port-adpf-e451cd6.apk`: standalone ARM64 NativeActivity APK built with the fix (`--game-run`).

releases.name: v0.5.12-alpha
releases.body:
## English

**Status:** Playable menus, paddock/garage, and on-track driving on ARM64 Vulkan (`-O3 + ThinLTO`); fixes blown-out bloom / pitch-black 3D scenes caused by `exp_adjust` texture fetch exponent bias and eliminates MSAA resolve log spam.

### Changes
- **SPIR-V texture `exp_adjust` fix (`spirv_translator_fetch.cpp`):** Extract the 6-bit signed `exp_adjust` (bits 13:18) from fetch constant **word 3** instead of **word 4** (which holds `LOD bias` and erroneously scaled non-zero-LOD-bias textures by `2^±bias`, causing extreme bloom blowout and black scenes on track).
- **Automatic shader/pipeline cache invalidation:** Bumped `SpirvShaderTranslator::Modification::kVersion` (`12` → `13`) so existing `.vk.xpso` caches rebuild automatically on update.
- **Resolve log spam fix (`draw.cpp`):** Downgraded `Incorrect resolve sample selected` from `REXGPU_WARN` to `REXGPU_DEBUG` when `gpu_cap_msaa` caps main-scene MSAA to 1x, eliminating per-frame I/O overhead.

---

## Русский

releases.name: v0.5.11-alpha
releases.body:
## English

**Status:** Playable menus and 3D car/track rendering on ARM64 Vulkan; testing shader/bloom/shadow fixes (`readback_resolve`, sRGB gamma RT, `VkRenderPass`, MSAA cap, persistent pipeline cache) and new F1 2012 Paddock launcher.

### Changes
- **Persistent Vulkan shader & pipeline cache on Android:** Added `Seek(0, SEEK_SET)` after `OpenFile(..., "a+b")` in `pipeline_cache.cpp` (fixes Android bionic EOF positioning so cached pipelines reload on startup).
- **Safe main-scene MSAA cap (`gpu_cap_msaa`):** Caps MSAA to 1x on wide render targets (`pitch >= 1024`) while preserving 4x MSAA EDRAM clears for shadow maps and depth pre-pass.
- **EGO Engine / Adreno defaults:** Enabled `readback_resolve=some`, switched `gamma_render_target_as_unorm16=false` (sRGB), and `vulkan_dynamic_rendering=false` (`VkRenderPass`) by default, with all toggles exposed in settings.
- **F1 2012 Paddock Launcher:** Added animated carbon/telemetry backdrop (`F1BackdropView`), top navigation tabs (**Home / Graphics / System**), driver/device status chips, and racing-red Play button.

- **Guardia de calor**: ahora lee el estado térmico del teléfono cuando este no informa cuánto margen térmico queda; antes no pausaba nunca.
- **Arreglo del enlace**: la preparación ya no se cae al enlazar el juego en el teléfono.

- **Reloj al 100%**: un botón en Ajustes → Android que le pide al teléfono correr a su frecuencia máxima y dice exactamente qué permitió el teléfono. En un teléfono sin root el botón informa y apunta al modo de juego del teléfono o a `adb shell cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true`.
- **Aviso de refresco**: los ajustes avisan cuando los cuadros por segundo están por encima de los de la pantalla (esas imágenes nunca se ven y le roban la GPU al juego).
- **Nota sobre los drivers propios**: los ajustes explican que se puede instalar un driver Vulkan propio (Turnip) para el Adreno, que arregla errores gráficos y puede ir más rápido.
- **Guardia de calor**: ahora lee el estado térmico del teléfono cuando este no informa cuánto margen térmico queda; antes no pausaba nunca.
- **Arreglo del enlace**: la preparación ya no se cae al enlazar el juego en el teléfono.

releases.body:

### Русский

- Первый публичный APK для Android ARM64 с лаунчером NHL Legacy 2027.

Полный импорт ISO подтверждён пользователем на Lenovo Y700 (`TB321FU`, Android 15); все 20 файлов дополнительно проверены независимым чтением. Полное прохождение и совместимость со всеми GPU не подтверждены. Возможны просадки FPS и неверная поза вратаря в отдельных повторах.

First public release of Rush5, a launcher and touch-control layer for the ARM64 Android port of GTA V Legacy.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.17.1 public alpha

# BluBox 360 0.17.1 Alpha

## Online Name Sync Update

BluBox profile names and BluBox online names now stay together.

### New

- Added **Edit Name** directly inside Friends & Online.
- Your BluBox profile name is now also shown as your online name.
- Changing the name from Friends & Online updates the active BluBox profile.
- Your BluTag automatically changes its name part to match the new profile name.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.17.0 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.17.0 Alpha

## BluBox Social Update

BluBox 360 now has the first Friends & Online beta on Android.

### New

- Friends & Online screen in the BluBox side menu.
- Every local BluBox profile gets its own shareable BluTag.
- Copy your BluTag from the social screen.
- Add friends by BluTag.
- Friends are kept separately for each BluBox profile.
- Remove friends from your list.
- Online presence control with Online, Away and Offline states.
- Online Beta on/off control.
- Existing profiles, saves, achievements and game library stay separate from the social data.

### Online beta status

This alpha is the first social-system test. Friend entries and presence settings are stored locally on the Android device. Internet friend syncing, remote friend requests, game invites and emulator multiplayer are not live yet. Those features need a BluBox online service/backend before they can work between separate devices.

This release does not sign into Xbox Live and does not pretend to be Microsoft's Xbox network.

releases.name: BluBox 360 macOS 3.0.2 Preview
releases.body:
## BluBox 360 macOS 3.0.2 Preview

This Mac preview fixes the update experience and keeps the 3.0.1 Xenia launch hotfix.

- Adds **BluBox 360 > Software Update…** inside the app.
- Shows your installed version, the latest available Mac version, status, and release notes.
- Shows an in-app update banner when a newer Mac preview is available.
- Checks for a newer Mac preview automatically after launch.
- Adds **Update Now** for future Mac updates.
- Downloads the Mac ZIP from GitHub Releases and verifies it against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before installing.
- Replaces the existing app in place when macOS permits it, so the older version does not need to be uninstalled first.
- If macOS requires extra permission, BluBox opens the DMG so you can drag the new app over the old one and choose **Replace** instead of uninstalling.

**Preview warning:** this remains experimental macOS emulator software. CI verifies the app, bundled engines, launch sanitizer, signatures, update payload checksums, and startup self-tests. It does not prove that every Xbox 360 game boots or runs correctly.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.3 focuses on easier updating and safer sustained performance on Android handhelds such as the AYN Thor.

## Check for updates

- Added a **Check for updates** button under **Settings > App**.
- Automatic update checks keep the existing 15-minute cooldown.
- A manual check runs immediately and ignores the automatic cooldown.
- Manual checks now confirm when BluBox is already up to date.
- Manual checks show an error message if GitHub cannot be reached instead of silently closing.

## Smart Heat Guard

- Low Heat Mode remains available and still avoids maximum-clock requests.
- BluBox now checks Android thermal status and thermal headroom when a game launches.
- When Android reports thermal pressure, BluBox uses the low-heat launch preset even if Low Heat Mode was switched off.
- A 60 FPS target can be reduced to a 30 FPS safety ceiling when the device is already approaching thermal throttling.
- Shader creation is reduced to one worker under thermal pressure to lower sustained CPU load.
- Fable II keeps its existing 24 FPS safety ceiling.
- The existing severe-heat protection remains enabled during gameplay.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.16.2 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.16.2 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.2 is the Flat Cover Library Update, focused on making the game library cleaner and easier to browse.

## Flat cover library

- Flat front-cover artwork is now the default library style.
- Removed the plastic Xbox 360 case frame from game covers.
- Removed the green case border around cover artwork.
- Covers display the artwork itself without a fake box around it.
- Increased cover size so artwork is easier to see on handheld screens.
- Improved spacing between games for a cleaner library layout.
- Recently Played uses the same flat-cover style as the main library.
- All Games uses the same flat-cover style for a consistent look.

## Existing features

- HD+ graphics mode remains available.
- Retail cover import support remains available.
- Profiles, achievements, save-game progress and second-screen features remain included.
- Permanent BluBox signing and SHA-256 verification remain enabled.
- The updater fixes introduced in 0.16.1 remain included.

## Update notes

BluBox 360 is still in public alpha development. Back up important profiles and save data before installing a new alpha build.

Version: 0.16.2-alpha

releases.name: Ametrine 1.0
releases.body:
The first release of Ametrine, a PS2 emulator for Android built on the [ARMSX2](https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2) core.

## Features

- Game library from a folder you pick, with favorites, search and play time
- Global settings with per-game overrides
- Touch controls you can rearrange and resize, and physical controllers
- Save states, memory card manager, cheats, input macros
- Backup and restore of settings and saves
- Custom Vulkan drivers (adrenotools) on Adreno GPUs
- Optional: ask Google Gemini about the current screen (needs your own API key)

## Requirements

- Android 10 or later, arm64-v8a, 4 KB memory pages (16 KB page devices are not supported yet)
- A BIOS dumped from your own PS2. Ametrine does not include any BIOS or games.

## Files

emulators.latest_body:
The first release of Ametrine, a PS2 emulator for Android built on the [ARMSX2](https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2) core.

## Features

- Game library from a folder you pick, with favorites, search and play time
- Global settings with per-game overrides
- Touch controls you can rearrange and resize, and physical controllers
- Save states, memory card manager, cheats, input macros
- Backup and restore of settings and saves
- Custom Vulkan drivers (adrenotools) on Adreno GPUs
- Optional: ask Google Gemini about the current screen (needs your own API key)

## Requirements

- Android 10 or later, arm64-v8a, 4 KB memory pages (16 KB page devices are not supported yet)
- A BIOS dumped from your own PS2. Ametrine does not include any BIOS or games.

### 🛠️ 关键修复与技术细节 (Technical Improvements)

#### 1. 解决 Android 16 启动闪退 (SIGABRT Crash Fix)
- **底层根因**：Android 16 严格限制了 Bionic 的 FORTIFY 安全检查，并在 16KB 页表模式下对系统调用参数实施强校验。原生 `ntdll.so` 和 `wineserver` 在执行 `open64(O_CREAT)` 时缺少 `mode_t` 导致 libc 直接调用 `abort()`。
- **修复方案**：
  - 二进制 Patch `ntdll.so` 与 `wineserver` 中的 `__open64_chk` 和 `__fcntl64_chk`。
  - 保障 48-bit 虚拟地址空间兼容及 `mmap32` 内存预加载机制，保证在 Android 16 内核下平稳分配内存。

#### 2. 解决窗口关闭/刷新后黑屏有声音 (Black Screen Fix)

releases.body:
WinCore 5.0.0 — Compatibility Suite

WinCore 5.0.0 introduces a major expansion of the WinCore Compatibility Center, bringing 50 diagnostic and compatibility tools for Windows games running through Winlator.

What's New

Compatibility Center

- 50 numbered compatibility and diagnostic actions.
- Windows executable and game-folder inspection.
- Local compatibility database.
- Advisory compatibility profiles.
- Wine, Box64, and graphics configuration recommendations.
- Per-game profile history and JSON import/export.

GTA IV Diagnostics

- GTA IV profile setup.
- Executable and component checks.
- Save-data filename inspection.
- Compatibility summaries and troubleshooting information.

Device and Performance Diagnostics

- RAM and thermal snapshots.
- CPU timing information.
- Launch-readiness checks.
- Android controller and audio-device inspection.

Logs and Troubleshooting

- Wine and Box64 log filtering.
- Missing-DLL pattern detection.
- Custom compatibility rules.
- Folder and component checks.
- Diagnostic reports.

Branding

- Updated WinCore green four-panel application icon.
- Matching WinCore logo across branding resources.

Technical Information

- Version: 5.0.0

releases.name: WinCore 4.0.0
releases.body:
WinCore 4.0.0 — App Icon Issue

WinCore 4.0.0 was released without the intended WinCore app icon because of an error during the GitHub release/build process. The supplied artwork was not correctly integrated into the APK, leaving the release without the proper WinCore branding.
This issue was addressed in WinCore 5.0.0, which includes the updated green four-panel app icon and logo, with automated checks confirming the branding resources were included.

releases.name: WinCore 3.0.0
releases.body:
WinCore 3.0.0 expands Android device-profile customization with per-game and per-container CPU profile overrides, configurable Box64 mappings, and automatic chipset-family detection.

This release introduces adaptive launch safety for low-memory and severe thermal conditions, an optional live session monitor, JSON device-profile sharing, and appearance reset.

Existing Winlator container management, game shortcuts, graphics settings, controller support, and compatibility diagnostics are preserved.

Note: CI verifies the build and APK integrity. Actual game compatibility and performance have not been verified on physical devices.

releases.name: WinCore 2.0.0
releases.body:
WinCore 2.0.0 introduces automatic chipset-family detection for common Dimensity, Snapdragon, and Exynos devices, with selectable device profiles applied through Box64 when launching Windows programs.

This release also adds eight app-wide accent color options and three interface sizes: Compact, Standard, and Large. Existing Winlator containers, shortcuts, settings, controller navigation, and read-only compatibility diagnostics are preserved.

Note: chipset-to-profile mappings are baseline defaults and have not been benchmark-verified.

releases.name: Winlator Hybrid DXVK v12.7.0-beta.7
releases.body:
**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 7 (ветка v12.7)**

**По умолчанию — на скорость и FPS**
- Вывод кадров X-сервера получил высокий приоритет (как интерфейс системы) — кадры не ждут за фоновой работой.
- DXVK компилирует шейдеры не больше чем на половине ядер (2–4 потока) — быстрые ядра остаются игре, меньше просадок при новых эффектах.
- Лог DXVK — только предупреждения и ошибки (подробный тратил ресурсы в каждой игре); причина отказа графики по-прежнему попадает в отчёт.

**Лучшее из аналогов**
- «Апскейл как FSR» (идея DroidDeck) в «Графике»: игра рисуется в 720p или 540p, картинка растягивается с настоящей резкостью CAS — больше FPS почти без потери чёткости.
- «Сбросить настройки игры» — вернуть рекомендуемые после экспериментов (идея GameNative: профиль игры по умолчанию).
- «Поделиться логами» — журнал запуска и последний отчёт в Telegram/почту одной кнопкой.

Всё из бет 1–6: ровные 30–60 FPS по такту экрана, Vortek по умолчанию, починка «Студии», журнал запуска. Подпись — единый ключ (SHA-256 b79d7958…).

releases.name: Winlator Hybrid DXVK v12.7.0-beta.6
releases.body:
**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 6 (ветка v12.7)**

**Снова ровные 30–60 FPS — и теперь привязаны к экрану правильно**
- Убраны тормоза беты 5: без лимита кадры опять «не чаще 60» (в бете 5 игра пыталась рисовать до 120 кадров на 120-Гц экране и перегружала видеокарту).
- «Авто 30–60» снова по умолчанию: первые 15 с и загрузки не учитываются, 10 с замер, затем ставится самый высокий ровный лимит (60 / 45 / 40 / 30), который игра держит 90% времени, и частота экрана, кратная ему.
- Кадр выдаётся точно по настоящему такту экрана (а не просто по таймеру) — кадры не «съезжают». Опоздавший кадр по-прежнему отдаётся сразу, без лишнего ожидания.
- Игра просела на 4 с — лимит на ступень ниже (не ниже 30). 30 с держит ровно — пробуется ступень выше; не удержала — тихо назад.
- Убраны кнопки, которые ничего не меняли: ручной выбор частоты экрана и дубль лимита FPS в «Графике». Лимит — в «☰ ▸ FPS».

Всё из бет 1–5 на месте (починка «Студии», Vortek по умолчанию, журнал запуска). Подпись — единый ключ (SHA-256 b79d7958…).

releases.name: Winlator Hybrid DXVK v12.7.0-beta.5
releases.body:
**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 5 (ветка v12.7)**

**Исправлено: вылет игры после изменений в «Графика»**
- Причина: старая «Студия графики» при «Сохранить и применить» затирала настройки контейнера — ставила Box64 «Ультра-Турбо» (StrongMem=0, BigBlock=3) и FSYNC (Unity падала, старт замедлялся), включала DXVK 2.4.1 (на Mali/Vortek не запускается), а ползунок FPS лишь ставил потолок в DXVK.
- Теперь вместо неё простое окно «Графика и FPS»: частота экрана (системная / 60 / 90 / 120 Гц — что поддерживает телефон, сразу), лимит FPS (сразу), разрешение игры, шейдеры (выключены по умолчанию). Box64, переменные и DXVK это окно больше не трогает.
- Уже испорченные настройки чинятся автоматически при запуске игры (появится сообщение 🔧).
- 90/120 Гц теперь действительно поднимают потолок кадров: синхронизация кадров идёт на частоте экрана, а не на жёстких 60.

**Быстрее старт**
- Подробный оверлей больше не заставляет Wine опрашивать видеокарту при каждом окне (на Vortek это тормозило).
- DNS для игр — без IPv6 и с коротким таймаутом.
- Журнал запуска: «окно игры через N с / первый кадр через M с» — в «Загрузки/Winlator-logs/startup.txt» и в «Производительности».

releases.name: fexdroid 0.3.108-alpha (experimental: native ARM64 Steam)
releases.body:
**Experimental build 0.3.108-alpha, not for general use.** Built from `e370fb1` (branch `steam-arm64`) on 2026-09-29. The regular build is at [apk-latest](https://github.com/cobrabm12/fexdroid/releases/tag/apk-latest).

What is new here:

- **Valve's native ARM64 Steam client** instead of the translated one: Settings › Game › "Native Steam client (experiment)" › Start. It downloads about 1 GB from Valve, installs apart from the regular Steam and asks you to sign in again. Games cannot be started from it yet.
  - Tested on a Xiaomi (Dimensity 7200, Android 16) up to 0.3.107: the client installs itself, runs and starts its web helper, then refused the web helper's connection because `lsof` was missing. 0.3.108-alpha has an `lsof` for native programs; with it the client draws its sign-in window on a PC. Not yet confirmed on a phone.
- **Frames straight from the game** (Settings › Performance, off by default): the game's picture skips the X server. Tested with vkcube only.
- The way every program of a session is started has changed. The regular Steam still starts with it (tested on the same Xiaomi).

releases.name: v0.8.0
releases.body:
## New here? Install Tessera in 3 steps

Tessera runs Linux desktop apps (GIMP, LibreOffice, Firefox, VS Code and thousands more) on your Android phone, each in its own window. No root needed.

1. **Download [tessera-v0.8.0.apk](https://github.com/daryan044/tessera-linux/releases/download/v0.8.0/tessera-v0.8.0.apk)** (also listed under **Assets** at the bottom of this release; the "Source code" files are not the app).
2. **Open the downloaded file and install it.** Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager: allow it. It may also warn that the app isn't from Google Play; Tessera can't be on Play by design.
3. **Open Tessera → Setup → install Debian** (a few GB of free space), then pick apps in the **Store**.

Needs Android 7 or newer on a 64-bit (arm64) phone. Tessera is in alpha: if something doesn't work, Setup → **Copy diagnostics** and [open an issue](https://github.com/daryan044/tessera-linux/issues).

---

### What's changed in 0.8.0

This release is mostly your reports and requests. Thank you, all of you; you're named next to what you asked for.

> New to Trierarch? Start from the [tutorial index](https://github.com/Beauty114514/trierarch-app/blob/v0.5.1/docs/en/README.md) and follow it step by step.

> [!WARNING]
> **Known Issue (proot users):** When Arch Linux rolls out a KDE update, KDE may stop working due to an outdated patched KWin version. **Please check that the KWin version in your Linux environment matches the version in this release before downloading.** If the release version is outdated, please wait or notify the developer to compile and provide an updated package, or compile it yourself using the provided patch if you are able to.
>
> **Note on Asset Updates:** Releases are only published for main app updates. When other assets (such as Mesa or KWin) are updated, no new release will be created; instead, the files will be updated directly under the current latest release.

## Highlights

- Fixed a possible black screen on first Wayland desktop launch by reattaching the Surface after a successful native host start.
- PRoot Hyprland is supported for the first time: `libaquamarine-compat.so` and a sample profile are provided, and dmabuf/EGL clients such as kitty work normally.

releases.name: Trierarch 0.5.0: A Complete Reset
releases.body:
0.5.0 is a reset of Trierarch, not a simple continuation of 0.4.x.

> [!WARNING]
> **Known Issue (proot users):** When Arch Linux rolls out a KDE update, KDE may stop working due to an outdated patched KWin version. **Please check that the KWin version in your Linux environment matches the version in this release before downloading.** If the release version is outdated, please wait or notify the developer to compile and provide an updated package, or compile it yourself using the provided patch if you are able to.
>
> **Note on Asset Updates:** Releases are only published for main app updates. When other assets (such as Mesa or KWin) are updated, no new release will be created; instead, the files will be updated directly under the current latest release.



This release drops the previous complex, verbose UI and moves control to CLI tools. In addition to the PRoot container, it adds two new runtimes, chroot and DroidSpaces, and provides Mesa drivers and hardware acceleration for both rooted and unrooted setups.

This is a major update. Read the tutorials to learn the new workflow before configuring anything:

releases.name: Trierarch 0.4.1
releases.body:
## Trierarch 0.4.1 (2026-04-16)

### Added
- **GPU acceleration (UNIVERSAL):** cross-chip GPU acceleration mode (host-side VirGL; guest OpenGL via **virpipe**; guest Vulkan via **Venus**). Existing **VIRGL** / **VENUS** preferences migrate to **UNIVERSAL**.

### Fixed
- **Keyboard:** fix soft keyboard mapping for `_` / `^` and improve Backspace handling for IMEs that use `deleteSurroundingText()`.

### Developer Note
I originally planned to work on a **higher-performance GPU acceleration path** and an **integrated Winlator**, but I ran into many **pitfalls** and **unclear bugs**. So I’m pushing this interim update to smooth out daily usage and keep things moving while I continue to tackle those bigger issues—just so you know **I haven't disappeared!** 👻

Full changelog in the repo: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Beauty114514/trierarch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: Trierarch 0.3.0
releases.body:
## Trierarch 0.3.0 (2026-04-04)

### Added
- **In-app terminal** (Termux-style) for the proot shell, with bundled monospace fonts, **Appearance**, and packaged font licenses.
- **Multi-session terminal:** per-session PTY and tabs from the orb (switch / add / remove); sessions use ids **1, 2, …**.
- **Display on session 0:** startup script runs on a dedicated shell so the desktop and terminal tabs no longer share one PTY.

### Changed
- **Terminal** screen respects **status bar** and **soft keyboard** insets.
- **Pointer:** separate scroll scaling for **physical wheel** vs **two-finger** gestures; **faster** touchpad cursor (finger × 2.5).
- **Glass/orb UI:** menus and settings sheets **size to the window**; orb grouped under **Common**, **Desktop**, **Terminal**.

### Fixed
- **Touchpad two-finger (Wayland):** avoid stray **left-button** / stuck behavior when the second finger cancels hold-drag timing, and keep **simulated touchpad** state correct after **two-finger tap → right click**.
- **View Settings (Wayland output):** **Scale** had no effect and **Resolution** vs **Scale** did not behave distinctly (only changing resolution drove UI size).

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

releases.name: v2.5.14
releases.body: **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/compare/v2.5.13...v2.5.14

releases.name: v2.5.13 — CurseForge and release notes
releases.body:
## What's new

- **CurseForge browsing works again.** The API key the app shipped with had been revoked, so every request came back `403 Forbidden`, and the mod and modpack lists were simply empty. A new key is in place (still encrypted in the build, never in the source).

- **The notes screen shows releases instead of the repository README.** It was pointed at a repository that has since gone private, so it came up blank — and release notes are what belongs there anyway. It now lists the ten most recent releases with their notes.

releases.name: Pocket Foundry 0.9.3-beta.2
releases.body:
**Beta, for testing.** Install it by hand, or turn on Include prereleases for Pocket Foundry in Obtainium. It updates to the release once that's out.

Play your own copy of Factorio on Android: the official Linux ARM64 build, run without emulation on the phone's GPU.

**Install:** open `pocket-foundry-0.9.3-beta.2.apk` on the phone (Android 10 or later) and import the Linux (arm64) .tar.xz from [factorio.com/download](https://factorio.com/download). Pocket Foundry then asks before downloading a driver for your GPU from pocket-foundry-drivers: Turnip on Adreno 6xx or newer, experimental builds on some Mali and Xclipse GPUs, Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues) or the CPU elsewhere. Without downloads it plays through Phone's Vulkan (experimental) or an imported one. The app holds no part of Factorio: you bring your own copy. A new version installs over the last and keeps the game and saves; from 0.8, 0.9 installs as a new app next to the old one and brings its saves, mods and config over.

releases.body:
Play your own copy of Factorio on Android: the official Linux ARM64 build, run without emulation on the phone's GPU.

**Install:** open `pocket-foundry-0.9.apk` on the phone (Android 10 or later) and import the Linux (arm64) .tar.xz from [factorio.com/download](https://factorio.com/download). Pocket Foundry then asks before downloading a driver for your GPU from pocket-foundry-drivers: Turnip on Adreno 6xx or newer, experimental builds on some Mali and Xclipse GPUs, Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues) or the CPU elsewhere. Without downloads it plays through Phone's Vulkan (experimental) or an imported one. The app holds no part of Factorio: you bring your own copy. A new version installs over the last and keeps the game and saves; from 0.8, 0.9 installs as a new app next to the old one and brings its saves, mods and config over.

**Updates:** Pocket Foundry doesn't check for them itself. Add it to [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium) with this repository's link, and Obtainium installs each new version. Coming from 0.8, remove the old Pocket Foundry in Obtainium and add it again: 0.9 is a new app.

# 🆕 What's new

## Native renderer for State of Decay

✅ **State of Decay now runs on the native renderer by default**, like Dragon Age: Origins since 0.1.1. On a Galaxy S25 Ultra, with the frame cap off, it reaches 115–127 fps where Xenia's emulation gave about 39, with shadows and HDR lighting.
✅ **The phone builds its shaders too**: when you add the game and on every **Update game**, from the game's own files. Nothing from the game is downloaded or shipped with the app.

✅ **Coming from 0.1.1:** Use **Update game** (⋮ on the game's card) on each game once. State of Decay gets its new profile and builds its shader library for the native renderer; the game files, saves and settings stay.

releases.body:

# 🆕 What's new

## Native renderer for Dragon Age: Origins

✅ **Dragon Age: Origins now runs on a new native renderer by default.** It draws the game's frames directly with Vulkan instead of emulating the Xbox 360's graphics chip, and it is much faster: on a Galaxy S25 Ultra, at the same spot with the frame cap off, it reaches 110–190 fps where the emulation gave 42–55. With the usual 60 fps cap the phone stays only warm.
✅ **The phone builds the shaders itself.** The renderer needs the game's shaders translated for Vulkan: the launcher does it on your phone when you add the game and on every **Update game** (about 10–15 seconds on an S25). Nothing from the game is downloaded or shipped with the app.

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-8
releases.body:
**省流：** 新增设置内的中英文切换，默认中文；修复观片台长按拖选和启动兼容问题，补齐性能测试、处理队列及大图尺寸提示。

内部安装版本码递增为 **128**，沿用原发布签名。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

- 设置中选择中文或 English，立即更新界面，保留当前照片、配方与编辑；重启后记住语言。胶卷、风格和参数搜索支持中英文名称。修复启动时过早访问 Activity 主题导致的崩溃，并回归首次启动与已有状态恢复。
- 观片台长按按实际触点选中照片；松手不再撤销选择。跨行拖选提前消费移动事件，避免首个大幅垂直移动被滚动抢走；保留普通滑动、边缘自动滚动和双指缩放。
- 性能测试直接在设置里显示首次预览、换风格、导出和建议。系统不允许读取峰值 RSS 时，增加独立的阶段采样 PSS 增量，注明可能漏掉峰值，并说明尺寸建议未按峰值内存筛选。采样放在计时渲染段之外，不替换内存准入规则。
- 处理队列在空闲时显示正确状态，区分已保存与已取消；明确重启后保留最近 30 条已结束记录，清除记录不会删除相册照片。工作尺寸和缩图提示说明设置、GPU、内存的共同上限，保留用户原尺寸选择。
- HEIF 主图 EXIF 尺寸与实际输出一致；外部文件重复打开走现有 Activity，文件提供器的异步读取可取消。JNI 在取消检查完成前继续持有显示像素，避免失败路径提前释放。
- `.spklook` 导入统一限制解压总量，未知条目、重复条目和目录内的附带数据也计入预算，避免跳过条目时继续无限解压；正常风格、色表与缩略图格式保持兼容。

11 月 14–15 日 Xiaomi 13 Ultra / Android 16 的候选版本实测覆盖中英文重启、观片台拖选、批量导出、JPEG / TIFF / HEIF、后台保存、取消重试及 24 MP 合成输入。该设备实测单缓冲上限 128 MiB，大图实际工作尺寸为 3547×2364；不是全尺寸 24 MP 成片。最后一个实测候选为 `c4a45e5`，本次新增 PSS 采样和队列文案在手机拔出后以云端回归验证，尚未再次安装真机。

发布由完整云端构建、JVM / 界面回归、RAW 与 Vulkan 数值检查、原发布证书和 16 KiB 对齐检查把关。既有实测数据见 [扩展真机记录](docs/ALPHA8_EXPANDED_DEVICE_2026-11-14.md)，最终审计与发布验证见 [Alpha 8 发布记录](docs/ALPHA8_RELEASE_2026-11-15.md)。

releases.body:

- 新导入 LUT 使用分段 ProPhoto 编码及更精确的插值烘焙；历史缓存按原样读取。新的本地缓存把渲染表和分享用原表放在同一次原子提交中，避免两份文件保存到不同版本。

审查范围、云端回归和 APK 检验边界见 [Alpha 7 记录](docs/ALPHA7_AUDIT_2026-11-14.md)。此前研究记录：[完整帧与外部文件](docs/EXPORT_ROUTING_FIXES_2026-11-13.md)、[LUT 精度](docs/EXPERT_COLOR_RESEARCH_2026-11-13.md)、[保存与预览](docs/SAVE_FAILURE_AND_PREVIEW_SCHEDULING_2026-11-13.md)、[RAW 算法优化](docs/RAW_ALGORITHM_OPTIMIZATION_2026-11-13.md)。

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-6
releases.body:
**省流：** 不选胶卷也能只用滤镜保存图片，自定义组合保存得更完整；RAW 少占一些内存，测光和曲线少做重复计算。界面保持原样，未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

内部安装版本码递增为 **126**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 滤镜和胶卷自由搭配

- 胶卷选“无”后，数字调色和 LUT 继续生效，可通过原有保存入口导出图片。胶卷、相纸和数字调整按用户现有选择组合，不增加模式或范围控件。
- “存为风格”和“分享当前风格”记录当前完整选择，包括明确的无胶卷状态、物理细调、效果开关及记住的强度；重新套用时不再漏掉这些设置。局部蒙版留在当前照片，RAW 白平衡、裁切和边框不进入可复用风格。
- 新版 `.spklook` 写出 version 2，并继续读取旧 version 1 文件。旧应用不能保证还原 v2 的全部新语义；自定义配方基于已有胶卷、相纸及参数，每张图仍使用一个物理方案和一个数字调色层 / LUT。

### RAW 少复制，计算少重复

- 对满足条件的整数 RAW，将解码结果直接转换到工作尺寸，避免先创建完整的浮点中间图；最终 Bitmap 分配前释放已用完的原始存储。
- 对严格兼容的整数 LinearRaw 子集，一次性处理直接接管已有像素存储，减少一份整图复制。浮点精度路径、黑白点及方向处理保留原有约定，并检查取消和失败时的存储状态。
- 同一次显示计算只准备一次曲线；自动测光和场景亮度统计复用已完成的精确分区，减少重复选择工作。逐项对照保留原有数值结果，没有更换胶片光谱、默认显影或成像公式。
- 吸收上游 Sony Huffman 解码缓存索引保护，保留合法索引的既有计算；尚未用真实问题 Sony 原片完成复现验收。

### 验证范围

本轮分项云端验证包含 172 项 Release JVM 测试、3 项原有界面风格保存 / 导入测试、完整 LibRaw 的 ASan / UBSan 检查、ARM64 JNI 编译，以及测光和场景统计的 1460 项数值对照；真实 Vulkan 胶片与印放对照输出保持一致。发布仍须通过整包构建、原生回归、签名证书及 16 KiB 对齐检查。

**未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。** 云端的耗时及内存改善不等于手机整张导出同比提速，也不保证所有 RAW 都降低峰值。新 RAW 仍默认线性显示，递归模糊、交互色表及完整外存分块实验继续默认关闭。

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-5
releases.body:
**省流：** 修复异常像素被当成正常照片保存，出错后重建引擎重算。未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

这次集中处理社区 [#17](https://github.com/Dear-Ded/Spektralab-X/issues/17) 反馈的窄条画面、黑块和紫色色块。暗房里算坏的底片，不能盖个“保存成功”就交卷。

内部安装版本码递增为 **125**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 修复异常像素被放行

- 修复浮点 RGB 中的 NaN、正负无穷在转成整数时丢失错误信息的问题。这些值原来会变成黑色或偏色像素，alpha 和文件结构却仍然正常；只要局部还有画面，旧的纯色检查就可能放行。
- 现在在整数转换和结果缓存前扫描全部 RGB 通道，记录首个异常像素的位置和通道；同时检查扫描工作组是否完整执行。异常结果停止交付，不进入后续保存。
- 导出前还会核对 RGBA16 布局及每个有效像素的 alpha，拦截未完整写入的结果。普通 Bitmap 导出、胶片 JPEG 4:4:4 和 RGBA16 TIFF 共用这项检查。

### 出错后重新开一间暗房

- 异常帧重试先重建 GPU 引擎，丢弃出错引擎的缓存和池状态，再降低工作尺寸重算。修复原来降档后仍沿用同一个引擎的问题。
- 第二次仍异常时停止保存，并替换异常引擎。诊断信息保留原始错误、像素坐标或缺失工作组数，便于后续定位。
- 正常照片的成像计算保持原有路径；新 RAW 继续默认线性显示，递归模糊等实验模式仍默认关闭。

### 验证与后续反馈

云端真实 Vulkan 故障注入中，旧实现接受的 18 组异常全部被新实现拒绝；Android 17 / API 37 原生检查同样通过。6709×4475 的尾部异常、漏工作组检查，以及 26 张胶片卡片、切图、释放缓存和独立大图导出的 33 帧回归均通过。正常输出全像素哈希保持一致，Android JNI 的 sRGB、Display P3 与原生 4:4:4 JPEG 保存及解码通过。

**未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。** Android 模拟器使用软件 Vulkan；Adreno 840 / HyperOS 4 的实际运行记录请继续通过“设置 → 复制诊断信息”反馈。

技术记录：[异常 RGB 与恢复修复](docs/ENGINE_FINITE_OUTPUT_RECOVERY_2026-11-12.md)、[RGBA16 与导出验证](docs/ENGINE_FEEDBACK_RECOVERY_2026-11-12.md)。

### 校验 / Verify

```

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-4
releases.body:
**省流：** RAW 读取保留更多原始精度，修正部分 DNG 的亮度刻度，镜头校正可及时取消。未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

相对 `0.2.00-alpha-3`，内部安装版本码递增为 **124**，保留原发布签名，可覆盖安装。新 RAW 仍默认线性显示，主页保持原样。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

已经注意到社区反馈的部分意见，将在最近的版本中进行优化和修复。

### RAW 读取和取消

- 保留浮点精度的 LinearRaw 读取支持多个未压缩 float32 RGB 条带，兼容独立的 SHORT/LONG 偏移与长度、文件内乱序存放及不足整块的末条带；原有单条带输出保持逐字节一致。
- 每次只读取一行，先检查条带计数、容量、重叠和文件范围；取消或读盘失败保留上一份有效结果。两云精度、故障与内存对照及 Android JNI 编译通过，尚非完整 RAW 分块或手机实测。
- 在同一严格 LinearRaw 子集内，Deflate 压缩（Predictor 3）的 float32 RGB 条带现在也能保留浮点精度，避免进入整数兼容转换；负通道、高光与白平衡沿用原有计算。流式解压检查完整校验尾、输出长度和条带边界，坏流或取消不发布半份结果。
- RAW 镜头畸变、暗角校正及其临时通道复制过程中也检查取消，工作线程汇合后再退出，保留上一张有效照片；未取消时的像素和元数据保持一致。双云及 Android 编译记录见 [镜头校正验证](docs/ENGINE_RAW_LENS_CANCELLATION_2026-11-12.md)。
- 修正部分整数三通道 LinearRaw DNG 在均匀非零黑点下的亮度刻度：扣黑后按白点减黑点归一化，避免整幅偏暗。保留源元数据及既有 Bayer、浮点和非均匀黑点策略；仍默认线性显示。见 [双云及 Windows 验证](docs/ENGINE_LINEAR_RAW_BLACK_2026-11-12.md)。

### 引擎实验，默认关闭

- 增加默认关闭的 Vulkan 递归模糊边界实验，修正画面边缘的递归收尾；默认图像仍走原算法。双云 Vulkan 合成对照及 ARM64 编译见 [实验记录](docs/ENGINE_IIR_BOUNDARY_2026-11-12.md)，尚未切换手机默认算法。
- 新增独立的大半径实验模式，用相邻状态差值减少递归计算的精度损失，实验半径支持到 sigma 1024；保留旧默认和原实验输出。CineStill 高分辨率薄图及独立数值对照见 [验证记录](docs/ENGINE_IIR_LARGE_RADIUS_2026-11-12.md)，仍待手机和完整大照片验收。
