releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.4-beta
releases.body:
Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.3-beta
releases.body:
Fourth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. Menu elements that never showed up before (e.g. the Co-op / Vs. tombstone) are back.
- "storage texture has no committed guest pages" crash.

### Performance and heat
- Draw recipes now work for the menu (repeated draws reuse their recorded setup).
- Box64 spin-waits sleep (`PAUSE=3`, WFE) instead of spinning: less CPU load for the same frame rate.
- The driver's two threads wake each other only when one actually waits.

### Requirements
- Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU only; Android 11+ recommended. Tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.2-beta
releases.body:
Third beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over v0.1.1-beta, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **⚙ Settings tab**: graphics, controls, language and help in one place.
- **Touch layout editor**: drag the controls, resize one or all, hide or add buttons (right stick, R3), opacity, reset.
- **Profile name input**: the game's text input now opens the phone's keyboard (the name used to be a fixed default).
- **Resolution**: Auto (screen proportions, no taller than the game's 1080p frame), Screen, 720p; image on a wide screen: Fit / Fill / Stretch.
- **Logs for a bug report (zip)** at the bottom of Settings: game log, logcat, device info and the reason of the last crash, no root needed. Attach it to an [issue](https://github.com/SFEZSergey/ReplantedAndroid/issues/new/choose).

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.1-beta
releases.body:
Second beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted**. Installs over v0.1.0-beta (same signing key, game data and settings are kept).

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **Launcher in English** by default (follows the phone language; English / Russian can be chosen in "Language").
- **GPU driver** setting: the built-in Turnip, the phone's system Vulkan driver, or your own driver package (an adrenotools `.zip` with `meta.json`, as used by Yuzu/Eden/Winlator). If the chosen driver fails to load, the built-in Turnip is used.
- **Game language** setting: the languages the game is translated into (read from the dump: English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil)), or "System" — the phone's language if the game has it, English otherwise. The game itself has no Russian translation.
- The APK is now signed with **v2 + v3** signatures, so it installs on MIUI / older Android versions that rejected v0.1.0 ("There was a problem parsing the package").

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.0-beta
releases.body:
First public beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted**.

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.
- **An Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU.** The bundled Turnip driver only works on Adreno.
- 8 GB of RAM and a fast CPU recommended (tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite).

### How to run
1. Install the APK.
2. "Папка дампа" (dump folder) → pick the dump folder (the one with `eboot.bin`).
3. "Импорт и запуск" (import and run) — the first time, copying and preparation take a few minutes; afterwards the button is "Играть" (play).

### What works (Snapdragon 8 Elite)
- Intros and title screen — 60 FPS; main menu — ~37–43 FPS; levels — ~48–53 FPS.
- Sound, gamepad, touch controls (a virtual gamepad; the eye button hides it).
- FPS limit 60/45/30 and "GPU turbo" in the launcher.

### Known issues
- Strong heating during long sessions → the phone lowers its clocks and FPS drops. For long sessions use the **45 FPS** limit.
- The menu is slower than levels (the driver is still single-threaded).
- A rare crash while a level loads — just restart.

releases.name: ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1 — Despliegue Móvil Autónomo 1-Tap
releases.body:
# Notas de la Versión — ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1 (Oficial)

## 🚀 Resumen de la Versión 1.1 (2026-11-02) — Despliegue Móvil Autónomo 1-Tap (Cero PC / Cero Cables)

**ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1** introduce la arquitectura de instalación completamente autónoma para smartphones y tabletas Android, eliminando al 100% la necesidad de ordenadores, cables USB y depuración ADB:

1. **Preset Soberano Embebido:** La APK incorpora la preconfiguración oficial de Project Jaina en español (`Project Jaina - Datos del Juego`), con la URL directa de Internet Archive precargada y botón de acción directa `[Descargar Juego]`.
2. **Streaming por Rangos HTTP 206:** Integración con el motor de streaming nativo de WoW-Imito (`RemoteZipChannel` + `PublicZipInstaller`), desempaquetando los 16.23 GB directamente en el almacenamiento interno sin requerir duplicación de espacio (ahorro de 16 GB en el teléfono).
3. **Resistencia a Caídas y Descarga en Segundo Plano:** La descarga corre mediante `ForegroundService` con `WakeLock`, permitiendo apagar la pantalla o minimizar la app sin interrumpir la transferencia, con capacidad de reanudación automática ante pérdidas temporales de conexión Wi-Fi.

## ProjectJaina-Imito v1.0 — Lanzamiento Oficial para JainaCore (WoW 3.3.5a ARM64 / Android 12+)

Cliente móvil de alto rendimiento optimizado para teléfonos, tabletas y consolas portátiles Android (Snapdragon, Dimensity, Odin 2, Retroid, Razer Edge).

### Novedades & Características:
- **Motor de Emulación:** Box64 v0.4.5 + Wine 10.10 con parches de estabilidad gráfica.

- **Controles Integrados:** Soporte dual para pantalla táctil (Touch UI) y mandos físicos por Bluetooth/USB (ConsolePortLK).
- **Conectividad Multi-Reino:** Preconfigurado para Reino 1 JainaCore (Vanilla Cap 60), Reino 3 WanitosGYM (ICC Cap 80) y Túnel Remoto Global Playit.
- **Seguridad:** Alineado a 4 bytes y firmado digitalmente con Esquema v3 de Android.

releases.name: RE:DROID 0.2.1-re
releases.body:
First release: Resident Evil HD Remaster (Nintendo Switch) on Android, built on the Eden v0.2.1 core with its own launcher.

**You need your own copy of the game** (`.nsp` or `.nsz`) and the `prod.keys` of your own Switch. The APK contains no game data, keys or firmware.

- Core cut to what this game calls; no network permission; Vulkan only.
- Engine mods built in: 60 fps, lighter shadows, scene resolution 960×720 / 1280×960 / 1600×1200, door skip.
- Turnip render-target fixes (Adreno): 60 fps at 1600×1200 on an Adreno 650 with Turnip from Mesa 27.
- Touch controls built from the game's actions, layout editor, combo keys; Switch mods manager; driver import.
- Chris's campaign played through to the ending on a Retroid Pocket 5.

Install: `adb install redroid-0.2.1-re.apk` (or open the file on the device), then Game files → keys, game, Validate.

Needs a 64-bit ARM device, Android 7.0+, Vulkan 1.1. Signing certificate SHA-256: `95:94:49:F0:61:54:15:F9:F8:41:DB:01:AF:EB:CF:DE:5F:36:CD:E1:69:A0:8B:1D:A9:54:6E:48:3F:98:81:56`.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.2.0
releases.body:
## Novità per gli amministratori

- **Cambia nome utente**: dalla lista utenti. L'utente viene disconnesso e accede di nuovo con il nuovo nome; salvataggi, console e amici restano invariati.
- **Salvataggi di un giocatore**: per ogni gioco puoi scaricare il salvataggio del giocatore oppure sostituirlo (o crearlo) con un file .sav, anche esportato da DeSmuME o da un altro emulatore. Prima di caricare viene chiesta conferma, con un avviso se le dimensioni non corrispondono al salvataggio attuale. La versione sostituita resta nella cronologia del server, e se il giocatore stava giocando su quella vecchia all'uscita gli viene chiesto quale tenere.

## Altre modifiche

- I dati locali (ROM in cache, copie dei salvataggi, stati salvati) sono legati all'account e non più al nome utente: dopo un cambio di nome restano al loro posto. Alla prima apertura vengono spostati automaticamente.

## Requisiti

Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato (commit `7d2701c`). Con un server precedente l'app funziona, ma le nuove funzioni di amministrazione non sono disponibili.

releases.body:
## Correzioni

- Il controllo degli aggiornamenti parte all'avvio anche se il server non è raggiungibile, e l'avviso compare anche nella schermata di accesso.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.1.0
releases.body:
## Novità

- **Aggiornamenti dall'app**: NDS Station controlla da solo se c'è una nuova versione (all'avvio, oppure da Impostazioni → Aggiornamenti), scarica l'APK, lo verifica e lo installa. Android chiede conferma; partite, salvataggi e impostazioni restano. La prima volta va consentita l'installazione di app da NDS Station.
- **Audio in avanti veloce**: il suono non si spegne più. Resta al tono originale (voci ed effetti naturali, la musica avanza a salti) a volume un po' più basso. In Impostazioni → Audio puoi scegliere anche "Accelerato" o "Muto".

## Installazione

Scarica `NDSStation-2.1.0.apk` sul telefono e aprilo. Si installa sopra la versione precedente senza perdere i dati. Dalle prossime versioni l'aggiornamento avverrà dall'app.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.0.1
releases.body:
Prima versione per Android di NDS Station, con le stesse funzioni del client Windows 2.0.1.

## Funzioni

- Libreria del server con ricerca; ROM scaricate e tenute in cache.
- Emulatore melonDS con tasti virtuali su schermo, touch sullo schermo inferiore, controller fisici, pausa, avanti veloce e stati salvati.
- Salvataggi sincronizzati con il server; se un altro dispositivo ha salvato un progresso più recente, all'uscita scegli se sovrascriverlo.
- Stessa identità di console di PC e telefono: la lista amici Nintendo WFC resta valida.
- Lotte e scambi online tramite Nintendo WFC, anche tra giocatori sulla stessa rete di casa.
- Pannello di amministrazione.

## Requisiti

- Android 8.0 o superiore (arm64 o x86_64).
- Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato.

## Installazione

Scarica `NDSStation-2.0.1.apk` sul telefono e aprilo (va consentita l'installazione da origini sconosciute). L'APK è firmato con una chiave di sviluppo: per aggiornarlo in futuro usa sempre gli APK di queste release.

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.10
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.10

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A crashed game's log can be sent from the device, and Xbox titles run missed code through an interpreter instead of
stopping on it.

- **Share the last game's log** (Settings › Advanced). The in-game « Share log » reads the game's own process, so a
  crash took the log with it. The launcher now writes what the game's last run logged, how its process ended (native
  crash, Java exception, not responding, killed…) and the crash's backtrace into one text file, ready to send. It holds
  no game data.
- **Xbox: an x86 interpreter behind the lifted code** (XBA-303). Code the Prepare missed is interpreted (dispatch
  misses, SEH, save states), and one self-healing round collects every miss.
- **Xbox rendering on GLES**: fixed function on the GPU by default, more texture stage modes, vertex data streamed
  through rings, shader programs compiled off the draw path, with a « Shaders 12/304 » badge while they compile.
- **XMV movies** are read from a disc image in place.

**Known problems**

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.9
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.9

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

**A retail Xbox 360 game plays on a computer for the first time.** One title, dumped from its owner's disc, now runs from
its logos through its menus into battles (measured up to 1,200 billion guest instructions) with no missing system call,
no draw the renderer refuses, and no guest code left to the interpreter. All of it was measured on Linux. **Nothing was
tried on a handheld yet**: whether it starts, draws, sounds or keeps up on the AYN Thor is unknown.

- **The startup crash is fixed.** `VdInitializeScalerCommandBuffer` wrote its NOPs over the caller's stack, so the game
  returned to address 0 a few frames in.
- **Memory and GPU match the console.** The 4 KB physical view starts one page in, as on the console. The GPU's scratch
  registers reach memory, `WAIT_REG_MEM` suspends an indirect buffer, and the display interrupt reports the vblank.
  Predicated (tiled-rendering) packets run for the selected bin only. Threads keep the affinity they ask for.

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.8
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.8

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

The Xbox 360 takes a large step towards real games. **No retail game has run on it yet**: everything below is tested on
our own homebrew and synthetic data, on a computer, and nothing has been tried on a device.

- **Prepare fits on a handheld.** Translating a large game peaks at about 240 MB of memory instead of 3.9 GB (measured on
  a computer, with 24 MB of game code).
- **Far more of the system is there.** 820 of the 887 xboxkrnl functions now answer, 333 of them with an explicit refusal
  (USB, network, console keys). DPCs, APCs, timers, queues and locks really run, and they are part of save states.
- **Sound.** XMA music and voices are decoded by FFmpeg's libavcodec, shipped as separate LGPL libraries. Its source is
  attached to this release.
- **Graphics.** Texture queries, line loops, quad strips, polygons, immediate indices, packed mip tails, MSAA, stencil in
  depth resolves, eDRAM aliasing, more memory export formats.
- **Keys.** Prepare tries the player's key file, then the keys this build carries. The Key file button stays for a game

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.7
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.7

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

GameCube games draw correctly on Adreno phones: the picture is complete, steady and fast.

- **Missing surfaces.** GX's cull mode was the wrong way round, which removed the faces a game wanted to keep: floors
  and walls came out black.
- **A picture that jumped back.** About twelve times a second the window showed an older picture, or black. A game's
  last draw could leave colour writes off, and the window's present now sets the state it depends on.
- **Stray triangles and speed.** Vertex, index and uniform data stream through persistent, fence-protected buffers
  where the driver has `GL_EXT_buffer_storage`. Other drivers keep the previous path.
- **A driver crash at present.** GX textures no longer announce mip levels they do not have, and the window no longer
  samples through the game's last samplers.

Tested on a Galaxy Z Fold8 (Adreno 840) with Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones, at full speed with 1x and close to it
with 2x internal resolution.

**Known problems**

- 4x internal resolution is too heavy for that phone in 3D scenes (about 60 % speed).

## v11.5.1 摘要

功能、真机验收与已知限制见 [v11.5](https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/releases/tag/v11.5)。

---

## What's Changed

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/compare/v11.5...v11.5.1

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again).

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0.1.1 is a small update after 1.0.1: fixes for what you reported, the PS1 filter you asked for, and quick items on the main screen.

#### Fixes

- **"Gather everything in one press" closed the game** ([#71](https://github.com/khorne-hub/4u-native/issues/71)) at gathering points with more than one use and when carving, with the European version of the game whose code had been built with 1.0: that code lacked the places in the game that 1.0.1 added, and the option called a wrong one. The app now fills them in by itself, with no rebuild, and if one were ever missing the option would do nothing instead of closing the game.
- **The monster's name on the health bars** didn't show on phones: it is now read from the game's files the way the game reads them.

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again).

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0.1 fixes problems you reported after 1.0 and adds some of your suggestions. Its first fixes were also tried on our phones (Mali-G57, Mali-G52 and Adreno 830); the rest only on a PC so far: where a line says "should", please tell us how it goes on yours (the Discord or an issue, with the log).

- **PowerVR GE8300, GE8320 and other PowerVR Rogue GPUs:** 1.0 closed at every start after the first one: it built the shaders you had already seen in the background, and this GPU's driver crashes when shaders are built in two places at once. These GPUs go back to how 0.1.9.2 built them: one at a time, when they first show up, with nothing in the background. That should end the closes; the short stutter the first time an effect shows up is back to 0.1.9.2's. PowerVR BXM GPUs keep 1.0's way (Discord).

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again). Your touch layout becomes control profile 1.

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0 was tried on a PC and on our phones (Mali-G57, Mali-G52 and Adreno 830), but not every part of it on a phone: where a line says "should", please tell us how it goes on yours (the Discord or an issue, with the log).

**New in 1.0**

- **A new settings menu:** six sections down the left, **Controls**, **Graphics & Audio**, **Gameplay**, **Multiplayer**, **Mods & Cheats** and **System**, with **Credits & Licenses** under them. Each section's page has its main options, and the rest is one level down (**Touch controls**, **Controller**, **Screen and HUD**, **Advanced**, **Join a room**...). Each row's explanation is behind its **?**. Your options keep their values; only their places changed: **Display** is now **Graphics & Audio**, **Screen and HUD**; the **Comforts** are in **Gameplay**; **Menu Options** is **System** (with **Your game** for the folders, **Import save**, **Export save** and **Share log**).

### English

Install over 0.1.9.1: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are.

- **Combined buttons on a controller:** each combined button can go on a controller's button (L3, R3, SELECT, Guide, Misc, the paddles or the touchpad). Gear, **Controls**, **Controller**: a **Combined buttons** row shows there while a controller is connected. A player's suggestion on Discord.
- **More in the log for slow phones** (#43): `log.txt` now tells how the game's list of shaders is coming along while it is built and how long it took, and has a performance line once a minute.
- **The single-screen mod** is made for the USA game in English: with the game in another language its menus overlap (#30). The README says so now.

**Installed it from another website** (apkvision or the like) and Android says "App not installed"? That copy was signed by someone else, and Android only installs the official APK over the official one. Your save comes with you:

1. In the old app: gear, **Menu Options**, **Export save**, and choose a folder such as `Download`.
2. Uninstall the old app.
3. Install the APK from this page.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.43
releases.body:
## Arceus Native v0.43

### Mali (Arm's own driver): invisible characters and Pokémon (#47, #51, #54, #57, #58)
The player, Pokémon, NPCs and swaying trees are posed by a step that writes their moved vertices into memory before they're drawn. On Arm's own Mali driver that step wrote nothing: the driver doesn't let vertex shaders write to memory, so those models came out empty. Its self-test (in your log since v0.35) showed it plainly: vertex shader writes, nothing; compute shader writes, all of them.

v0.43 does that step another way on such drivers: each vertex is drawn as a single point into a hidden image, then a compute shader copies the results into place. It turns on by itself when your log says `transform feedback captures: as points into colour targets`.

Tested on a Galaxy S25+ with the new way forced on: characters, Pokémon and NPCs drawn, animations right, no crash. **It hasn't run on a Mali phone yet:** please tell us whether your characters are back, and attach `Download/PokemonLegendsArceus-log-previous.txt`.

### Also
- Nothing else changes on Adreno, Xclipse or PowerVR. `DM_VK_TF_POINTS=0` in env.txt turns the new way off, and `1` forces it on any GPU.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.42
releases.body:
Install over your current version: saves and setup stay.

**Fixed**
- **A crash in the engine's own code on some phones** (#46). Some of the game's threads have a stack of only 16 KB, and the engine's code ran on it when the game called into it; on some phones that ran past the end. It now runs on the thread's own larger stack.
- **A GPU crash ("device lost") now counts as a crash.** The next start then offers the safe options, instead of failing the same way every time.

Everything from v0.41 is included (the startup vertex check, the 1440p lockout fix, the Adreno model test).

Tested on a Galaxy S25+: no crashes, the vertex check passes.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.41
releases.body:
Install over your current version: saves and setup stay.

**Fixed: the game closed at every start with 1440p on.** v0.40's Graphics → Resolution → 1440p made the game run out of its own memory for render targets, which is sized for 1080p. v0.41 ignores that setting and hides it, so if you picked 1440p, just install this and play. Real 1440p needs that memory area enlarged too; it's off until then.

**New: a vertex check at every start.** Before the game draws anything, the engine draws two small test squares off-screen and checks their shape. They use per-draw vertex sizes, the way older Qualcomm drivers got wrong (stretched, exploding polygons, #34). If the shape comes out wrong, the engine switches to its safe vertex mode by itself and notes it in the log (`vertex canary`). It takes a few milliseconds.

**New test for exploding polygons on older Adreno phones** (#46): ☰ → Model tests (Adreno) → **Copy shared data on the GPU**. Restart the game after turning it on, and tell us whether the polygons are fixed.

Everything from v0.40 is included.

APK SHA-256: `269455191dbeaed6509f394f35cdc273ec6212b5dd85869fc955d9fa782bfbfd`

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.40
releases.body:
Install over your current version: saves and setup stay.

**New (all off by default, in the ☰ menu)**
- **Widescreen** (Display → Picture → Widescreen): the game's camera made as wide as your screen, so it fills the whole screen with nothing stretched. The HUD stays 16:9 in the middle. From the next start.
- **1440p** (Graphics → Resolution → 1440p): the game renders at 2560x1440 instead of 1080p in TV mode. Sharper, but heavier on the GPU: fewer fps and a warmer phone. From the next start.
- **Barriers between passes** (Performance): Auto, Fewer or Every pass. On Xclipse, Mali and PowerVR, v0.39 put a full barrier before every pass to fix flickering shadows, which costs frame rate there (#48). **Fewer** gets the speed back; shadows may flicker again.

**Fixed**
- **Controls stopped working mid-game** until a restart (#49). When the phone got hot and Graphics Auto switched to handheld mode, the game's controller changed under it. The controller now stays the same for the whole session.

releases.name: Galar Native v0.94
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.94

### A steadier 30 fps with Graphics on Auto (#289 #300)
With Graphics on Auto, the game now starts at 85 % of its full 3D resolution (about 900p) and settles from there:
- It holds 30 for a calm minute: it goes up to the full resolution.
- It falls short of 30: it goes down to 720p.
- The phone gets hot: it goes down to 720p, and no lower for heat alone. Only a frame rate under 30 goes lower.

Before, the game started at full resolution and slower phones spent minutes under 30 before it stepped down. Under 30 the game also runs slower than normal, which looks like slow motion. If you picked a 3D render scale by hand in the menu, your choice is kept and Auto doesn't change it.

**Slow motion with the 60 fps option (#299):** if your phone can't reach 60, set Frame rate to 30. With 60 selected on a phone that runs at 20, the game plays at a third of its speed.

### Fewer missing objects while new shaders build

releases.name: Galar Native v0.93
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.93

### Fixed: crashes on game threads with tiny stacks
Some of the game's threads have very small stacks (16 KB). Our handling of the game's system calls ran on those stacks, and on some phones (when Android was tracing) it ran past their end and crashed. That handling now runs on a stack of its own. The same fix is in Arceus Native v0.42, where a player hit this crash twice.

### Fixed: a "device lost" now counts as a crash (#280)
When the graphics driver gave up ("device lost", seen on a Mali-G68), the game closed but the next start didn't know it had crashed. So the automatic safe start, which turns off risky features step by step on Arm's Mali driver, never stepped in. Now it does.

### No setup needed
Same shader translation as v0.87–v0.92: install and press Play.

Tested on a Galaxy S25+: field, walking and menus, no crash, locked 30 fps.

### Install
Install **GalarNative-v0.93.apk** over your current version. versionCode 93.

Signed with the official key `SHA-256: a5f49b44b6181758d82504f3beb0851c92093f454c792b49688728130673a070`.

releases.name: Galar Native v0.92
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.92

Install over v0.90 or v0.91: **no new setup needed**, saves and setup stay.

### New: 3D render scale
☰ → Graphics → **3D render scale**: Auto, 90 %, 80 %, 75 %, 66 % or 50 %. The game draws its 3D smaller (text and menus stay sharp), so it runs cooler and faster. It changes at once while you play. Auto works as before: what your Graphics setting gives, lowered by itself when the phone gets hot. A percentage you pick is kept.

### Fixed: controls stopped working mid-game
When the phone got hot and Graphics Auto switched the game to handheld mode, the game's controller changed under it and every button and the stick stopped until a restart (seen in Legends: Arceus, #49 there). The controller now stays the same for the whole session.

Everything from v0.91 is included (the faster shader setup). Neither change has been played on a phone yet; tell us if anything's off.

releases.name: Galar Native v0.91
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.91

### Faster shader setup (#262)
Most of setup's shader time wasn't the translation, it was files. Setup kept its working files in `Android/data/…/files/setup_work`, where Android passes every file through a slow storage layer: on a Galaxy S25+, 10,000 small files took 26 s to write there and 0.5 s in the app's private storage. Setup writes about 130,000 of them.

- The shader steps' working files now go in the app's private storage. It's the same storage chip, so setup needs no more free space than before. `setup.log` and the unpacked game stay where they were.
- Packing the shaders compresses on every core at a faster setting, with the same result: 194 s → 7 s on a PC.

This applies to a full setup and to the automatic shader update. On a PC limited to 8 cores, translating all 38,501 shaders now takes about 9 minutes and packing about 15 seconds. These changes were tested on a PC; phone timings will follow.

### No setup needed
Same shader translation and engine as v0.88 to v0.90: install and press Play.

### Install
Install **GalarNative-v0.91.apk** over your current version. versionCode 91.

releases.name: Galar Native v0.90
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.90

### The automatic shader update now says what it is (#276, #278, #279)
When a new version changes how shaders are translated, the app updates them by itself from what your first setup unpacked, with **no files needed and your save kept** (since v0.86). But its screen looked like a full setup ("Step 4 of 6", a "Set up again" button), so many players thought they had to set up again. Now every progress line starts with **"Updating the shaders for this app version: your files aren't needed and your save is kept"**, and the button reads **Updating the shaders**.

### No setup needed
Same shader translation and engine as v0.88 / v0.89: install and press Play.

## Galar Native v0.94

### A steadier 30 fps with Graphics on Auto (#289 #300)
With Graphics on Auto, the game now starts at 85 % of its full 3D resolution (about 900p) and settles from there:
- It holds 30 for a calm minute: it goes up to the full resolution.
- It falls short of 30: it goes down to 720p.

Before, the game started at full resolution and slower phones spent minutes under 30 before it stepped down. Under 30 the game also runs slower than normal, which looks like slow motion. If you picked a 3D render scale by hand in the menu, your choice is kept and Auto doesn't change it.

releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

releases.name: v0.2.5: Fix continuous phantom dodge/evade & SixAxis decouple
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.5

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras

- **Continuous Phantom Dodge/Evade Fixed / Corrección de esquiva/dash continuo fantasma (Fixes #13, #15, #18):**
  - **IHidServer IsSixAxisSensorAtRest (cmd 82):** Implemented Horizon OS nn::hid::IHidServer command 82, returning isAtRest = true. Previously, unhandled command 82 returned false, tricking the game into detecting constant controller movement and triggering endless motion-controlled evades/dashes.
  - **SixAxis Angular Velocity Decoupling:** Restricted right-stick gyro motion aiming simulation exclusively to Persona 5 Royal (Darts minigame). In NieR, the right stick controls the camera; feeding stick inputs into the virtual gyro was generating violent angular velocity spikes that triggered unwanted evade maneuvers when looking around.
  - **Versión oficial v0.2.5 (versionCode 7):** Se corrigió la esquiva automática e incontrolable del personaje al implementar el comando IPC IsSixAxisSensorAtRest y desacoplar la simulación giroscópica del stick derecho de la cámara.

releases.body:
## Fixed: the failed ports

The separate profiles package had broken the ports: the patches of an
imported profile never reached the build, and the port failed - FINAL
FANTASY RESONANCE's allocator cut was missing, its Unreal allocator
reserved 38 GB of address space, and the port died. Fixed: the imported
profile reaches the rewriter now, in every port and every runtime
rebuild.

## New game: Catherine: Full Body

The Korean / Chinese v0 release of Catherine: Full Body is playable, at
a held 30 fps as on the Switch, verified on device. Import the profiles
package again after the update (the environment check's "manage" box),
or the game is not in your layer.

Also in the APK: a game that compiles its own shaders at boot can be
ported on the phone; anime intros no longer freeze and movies no longer
end on a black screen; the builds page says when your profiles package
is older than this build's.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复：移植失败

独立档案包导致移植失败：导入档案里的补丁没有进入构建（《最终幻想 共鸣》
缺了分配器裁剪，预留 38 GB 内存闪退）。已修复：导入的档案现在能正确送达
改写器，每次移植和运行库重建都会用到。

### 新游戏：凯瑟琳 Full Body

《凯瑟琳 Full Body》韩版/中文 v0 发售版可玩，稳定 30 帧（与 Switch 一致），
真机验证过。更新后请重新导入档案包（环境检查里的"管理"），否则手机上没有
这个游戏。

APK 里还有：开机自编着色器的游戏支持手机移植；动画开场不再定格、影片不再

## The app no longer carries the game profiles

The profiles are half a gigabyte of shader tables, and every release
copied them again. This build carries none of them. After the update,
import the profiles package once: Settings → the environment check, or the
profiles row's "manage" box, which can fetch this build's own package for
you (the download is digest-checked). The package is the release's second
file. It lives outside the app's own storage, so future updates never
touch it.

**Packs built with this version need this app to run** - the pack no
longer carries the runtime inside; the app keeps one runtime per game and
builds it when the game page opens. The games already on your phone keep
working.

### New
- The game page checks and rebuilds the game itself; a failure shows the
  reason with a retry. The "update runtime" chore is gone.
- Tapping a game resumes it or refuses it - no more wrongly greyed-out
  cards.
- Pin a game to the home screen from its detail panel; the shortcut opens
  through the launch gate and greys out when the game is deleted.
- A port can be exported as one folder and taken to another phone; the
  same game can be in the library twice.

## Changelog

### New games

- **13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim (Asia)** - the Chinese release (the Japanese and Korean ones too); it installs beside the western one, so both play on the same phone. Tested on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C: the port runs, the Chinese text and the cutscenes play, the save menu works, 58-59 fps at 1440p.

### New

- **The port shows what it is doing.** The rewriter's own progress lines reach the screen while the port runs, so a working port is not mistaken for a stuck one (a player sat 75 minutes in a run that needed about three, and gave up). The log bundle's device snapshot gives every relevant process's CPU time and age - the two numbers that tell a working process from a stuck one.

## Changelog

### Before you update

- **The player API moved to revision 6 (the game's mode).** A data pack made with an older one is marked as needing a runtime update. "Update runtime" in the library rebuilds it in place: the game does not have to be ported again, and your saves are kept.
- **The host changed with this release.** The upstream line's work is in the host, so the update brings the new engine fixes and the new tools with it. A pack that is not updated keeps running on the host it was built with.

### New

- **The file managers see the app's own folders.** The runtime rootfs, the tools, the hosts, the saves, the drivers and the logs show up as one root: the player can read, create, rename, move and delete there without a computer. The switch is in Settings, About ("File manager access"), on by default, and it takes effect at once, without a restart.

### Before you update

The app asks now instead of ending the road: "continue with the current profile" rebuilds the runtime in place, so the game does not have to be ported again and your saves are kept.
- **The external display needs the new runtime.** The row in the drawer shows up after "update runtime" rebuilt the pack's host. Nothing else changes.

emulators.latest_body:
## Fixed: the failed ports

The separate profiles package had broken the ports: the patches of an
imported profile never reached the build, and the port failed - FINAL
FANTASY RESONANCE's allocator cut was missing, its Unreal allocator
reserved 38 GB of address space, and the port died. Fixed: the imported
profile reaches the rewriter now, in every port and every runtime
rebuild.

## New game: Catherine: Full Body

The Korean / Chinese v0 release of Catherine: Full Body is playable, at
a held 30 fps as on the Switch, verified on device. Import the profiles
package again after the update (the environment check's "manage" box),
or the game is not in your layer.

Also in the APK: a game that compiles its own shaders at boot can be
ported on the phone; anime intros no longer freeze and movies no longer
end on a black screen; the builds page says when your profiles package
is older than this build's.
